## Visiting OrangeTwist Reno: Frequently Asked Questions

_The questions Reno clients ask most before their first visit to our South Virginia center, from finding us to what we offer on site. If yours is not here, bring it along when you book a You Review._

Getting here Treatments at this center Booking and your visit The Reno area

### Where is OrangeTwist Reno located?

We are at 6629 S Virginia Street, Suite C, Reno, NV 89511, in the Commons Shopping Center off Virginia Street and Sierra Center Parkway, in the same center as Total Wine and David’s Bridal.

### How do I get to OrangeTwist Reno by car?

The Commons sits along South Virginia Street near Interstate 580. From the 580, exit toward South Virginia Street and Sierra Center Parkway. We share the center with Total Wine and David’s Bridal.

### Is there parking at the center?

Is there parking at the center?Yes. There is free parking throughout the Commons Shopping Center, and ride-share drop-off is easy at the center entrance.+

### Can I reach OrangeTwist Reno by public transit?

Yes. RTC RIDE Route 1 and the RTC RAPID Virginia Line run along South Virginia Street with stops near the center, and the RTC Transfer Center at Meadowood Mall is a nearby hub. Ride-share drop-off is straightforward.

### What is the nearest airport?

Reno-Tahoe International Airport (RNO) is about fifteen minutes north by car, which keeps the center within easy reach for clients traveling in.

### What are your hours?

Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM. Saturday, 8 AM to 5 PM. Closed Sunday. Call the center on (775) 787-8877 to check same-day availability.

### What treatments does OrangeTwist Reno offer?

Our Reno center covers injectables, facials, body contouring, laser, and skin tightening. That includes Botox and wrinkle relief; dermal filler for lips, cheeks, nasolabial folds, and oral commissures; microneedling using SkinPen; Clear + Brilliant resurfacing and BBL photofacial; laser hair removal; Ultherapy for skin tightening; CoolSculpting Elite and CoolTone for body contouring; Hydrafacial; and lymphatic drainage massage. A complimentary You Review helps match the right option to what you are after.

### Who performs treatments at OrangeTwist Reno?

Treatments are delivered by licensed medical providers and estheticians. Injectables are led by our nurse practitioner, Janette McDougall, NP, alongside our registered nurse, Jacqueline Hernandez, RN, who leads laser and body contouring. Facials and skin treatments are delivered by our esthetician, Sophia Hill. All medical treatments are performed under medical supervision.

### Is there anything I would need a different OrangeTwist center for?

Most core treatments are available here. A few device-specific treatments run only where the equipment is installed elsewhere in the OrangeTwist network. If you are after something specific, ask at your You Review and we will point you in the right direction.

### How much do treatments cost in Reno?

Pricing depends on the treatment and whether you are a member, with member pricing across the menu. Prices are shown up front, and your provider walks you through the options at your complimentary You Review with no pressure to book on the day.

### What is a You Review?

A You Review is our complimentary consultation. You sit down with a provider, talk through what is on your mind, and leave with a clear plan and honest pricing. There is no obligation to book anything on the day.

### Do I need an appointment, or can I walk in?

We recommend booking so we can match you with the right provider and a time that suits. Same-day appointments are often available, so call (775) 787-8877 if you are hoping to come in soon.

### Can I book on my lunch break?

Many of our treatments, like Botox, a Hydrafacial, or a quick filler top-up, fit inside a lunch hour. Let us know your window when you book and we will plan around it.

### Is the Reno center good for first-timers?

Yes. A lot of our Reno clients are booking their first treatment. The You Review exists for exactly that, so you can ask questions and decide at your own pace.

### How do I book?

Book A You Review online, call the center on (775) 787-8877, or email reno@OrangeTwist.com.

[Book A You Review](/book-now)

### Which areas does OrangeTwist Reno serve?

The South Virginia location is convenient for clients across south Reno, central Reno, and Sparks, and easy to reach from the wider Truckee Meadows.

### Where can I get Botox or a Hydrafacial in south Reno?

OrangeTwist Reno is on South Virginia Street near Sierra Center Parkway, minutes from Meadowood Mall, which makes it an easy stop close to home.

### What is around the center?

We sit in the Commons Shopping Center near Total Wine and David’s Bridal, alongside its shops and dining, so a visit pairs neatly with errands.

1.  ### Highly Skilled Providers
    
    True experts in their craft, our licensed providers are continuously trained in the latest techniques, treatments, and technologies.
    
2.  ### A Welcoming Experience
    
    Our treatment shops are bright, modern, and welcoming, with a team that’s as approachable as they are skilled.
    
3.  ### A Personalized Touch
    
    No two clients are the same — and we treat them that way. We start every journey with a full [You Review](#) so we can understand your unique goals and how to achieve them.

## A Different Kind of Weight Loss Program

TwistOff is OrangeTwist’s medical weight loss program. It combines FDA-approved GLP-1 medications with ongoing provider oversight, nutritional support, and a treatment plan built around your individual goals, health profile, and lifestyle.

-   Provider-supervised throughout
-   FDA-approved medications
-   Ongoing support and monitoring

## What is medical weight loss and how does it work?

Medical weight loss is a clinically supervised program that combines prescription medication with structured support to help eligible clients achieve and maintain weight loss. At OrangeTwist, the program is built around GLP-1 receptor agonists, the class of medications that has changed the landscape of weight management over the past five years.

GLP-1 medications work with the body’s natural appetite and satiety signaling. They slow gastric emptying, reduce cravings, and increase the feeling of fullness after eating. The result, for eligible clients, is a sustainable reduction in caloric intake without the constant willpower load that traditional dieting demands.

TwistOff offers two tiers reflecting the two main GLP-1 medications: TwistOff (Semaglutide, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy) and TwistOff+ (Tirzepatide, the active ingredient in Mounjaro and Zepbound). Eligibility, dosing, and protocol are determined by your provider at your You Review.

Prep 101

## Your Treatment Timeline

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201120%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## You Review

Your TwistOff journey starts with a provider-led You Review. The provider will discuss your health history, current medications, and weight loss goals. If you are clinically eligible, they will walk through the program structure, the medication options, and what to expect at each stage.

![Concern Treatment 14](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20933%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Onboarding

Once enrolled, your provider will start you on the appropriate medication and dose. You will receive guidance on self-administration, what to expect in the first weeks, and how to manage common side effects. Nutritional and lifestyle support is built into the program from day one.

![Concern Treatment 46](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201120%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Ongoing Care

You will check in with your provider on a monthly basis. Dosing is adjusted as needed based on your response, tolerance, and progress toward your goals. The medication is self-administered as a weekly injection.

![Concern Treatment 10](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201709%202560'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Maintenance and Transition

As you reach your target weight, your provider will work with you on a maintenance plan. This may involve continued medication at a reduced dose, a transition off medication with ongoing lifestyle support, or a tailored protocol based on your specific clinical picture.

## Realistic, not transformational.

Most clients on GLP-1 medications see meaningful weight loss over several months. Individual results vary based on starting weight, medication tier, lifestyle, and clinical profile. Your provider will set realistic, evidence-based expectations at your You Review.

Common side effects in the first weeks include nausea, mild gastrointestinal upset, and changes in appetite. These typically ease as your body adjusts and dosing is calibrated. Your provider will monitor and adjust your protocol throughout the program.

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About TwistOff and GLP-1 Medications Consultations and Eligibility Program Structure and Pricing Results and What to Expect Safety and Side Effects

### What is TwistOff?

TwistOff is OrangeTwist’s provider-supervised medical weight loss program. It combines FDA-approved GLP-1 medications with ongoing provider oversight, nutritional support, and lifestyle guidance. There are two tiers: TwistOff (Semaglutide) and TwistOff+ (Tirzepatide).

### What is the difference between TwistOff and TwistOff+?

TwistOff is built around Semaglutide, the GLP-1 medication with the longest clinical track record. TwistOff+ is built around Tirzepatide, a dual GIP and GLP-1 agonist that has shown stronger average weight loss outcomes in clinical trials. Your provider will recommend the right tier based on your clinical profile and goals at your You Review.

### What are GLP-1 medications?

GLP-1 receptor agonists are a class of medications originally developed for type 2 diabetes that have since been approved for chronic weight management in eligible clients. They work with the body’s natural appetite signaling, slowing gastric emptying and reducing cravings.

### How does TwistOff compare to Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, or Zepbound?

Ozempic and Wegovy are brand names for Semaglutide. Mounjaro and Zepbound are brand names for Tirzepatide. TwistOff and TwistOff+ deliver the same active ingredients through licensed pharmacy partners as part of a provider-supervised program with ongoing support.

### Is TwistOff a prescription program?

Yes. TwistOff is a prescription medical program. Eligibility is determined by a licensed provider at your You Review based on your health history, current medications, and clinical profile.

### Do I need a consultation before starting TwistOff?

Yes. Every TwistOff client starts with a provider-led You Review. The provider will assess your eligibility, discuss your health history and goals, and recommend the right tier and protocol if you qualify.

### Who is eligible for TwistOff?

Eligibility is determined by a licensed provider based on clinical criteria, including your BMI, weight loss history, current medications, and overall health profile. Some health conditions and medications may make GLP-1 medications unsuitable. Your physician will walk through eligibility transparently at your You Review.

### What should I tell my physician at the You Review?

Bring a complete picture of your health: current medications, past medications, known allergies, history of any thyroid, pancreatic, gallbladder, or gastrointestinal conditions, pregnancy or family planning, and any previous weight loss medications. The more your physician knows, the better the plan.

### Is the TwistOff You Review complimentary?

The initial You Review is complimentary. Once you are enrolled in the program, ongoing physician check-ins and medication costs are part of the program structure. Your physician will walk through the full cost picture transparently at your You Review.

### How much does TwistOff cost?

Pricing depends on the tier, dose, and program structure. Your provider will walk through exact pricing at your You Review before anything is agreed. TwistOff includes the medication, monthly provider check-ins, and ongoing program support.

### How is the medication administered?

Both TwistOff and TwistOff+ are self-administered as a weekly injection. Your provider will walk you through self-administration during onboarding. The injection is subcutaneous (under the skin) and most clients find it straightforward after the first dose.

### How often will I see my provider?

Monthly check-ins are part of the program structure. Your provider will adjust your protocol based on how you are responding, your tolerance, and your progress toward your goals.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from TwistOff?

Most clients begin noticing changes in appetite and eating patterns within the first weeks. Visible weight loss typically begins within the first one to three months. Individual results vary based on starting weight, medication tier, lifestyle, and clinical profile. Your provider will set realistic expectations at your You Review.

### How much weight will I lose?

Individual results vary significantly. Clinical trials have shown meaningful average weight loss for both Semaglutide and Tirzepatide over a 12 to 18 month period. Your provider will discuss what to realistically expect for your specific situation.

### Do I need to follow a specific diet on TwistOff?

There is no required diet, but TwistOff includes nutritional guidance as part of the program. GLP-1 medications work best alongside balanced nutrition and an active lifestyle, and your provider will discuss what works for your routine.

### What happens when I reach my target weight?

Your provider will work with you on a maintenance plan. This may involve continued medication at a reduced dose, a transition off medication with ongoing lifestyle support, or a tailored protocol based on your clinical picture. Decisions are made one client at a time.

### What are the side effects of GLP-1 medications?

Common side effects, particularly in the first weeks, include nausea, mild gastrointestinal upset, constipation or diarrhea, and changes in appetite. These typically ease as your body adjusts and as dosing is calibrated. Your provider will monitor side effects at every check-in.

### Who should not take GLP-1 medications?

GLP-1 medications are not recommended if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy, have a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma, have a history of pancreatitis or certain gastrointestinal conditions, have multiple endocrine neoplasia syndrome type 2, or have other clinical contraindications determined by your provider. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### Are GLP-1 medications safe long-term?

GLP-1 medications have been used clinically for over a decade for type 2 diabetes, and the more recent weight management indications continue to be studied. Your provider will discuss what is currently understood about long-term use as part of your You Review and ongoing care.

### Can I stop TwistOff if I want to?

Yes. You can stop the program at any time. Stopping medication is a clinical decision that your provider should be involved in, particularly around dose tapering and maintenance planning. Open conversation about stopping is welcomed at any check-in.

### What if I have a bad reaction or side effect?

Contact your OrangeTwist provider immediately. Most early side effects ease with time and dose adjustment, but any concerning symptom should be discussed with your provider. The program includes ongoing provider access for exactly this reason.

### How do I know my provider is qualified?

All TwistOff programs at OrangeTwist are supervised by licensed provider with specific training in medical weight management and ongoing supervision by our Medical Advisory Board.

Why OrangeTwist

## Science, warmth,  
and actual impact

We’re not a typical med spa. We’re a team of nurses, injectors, aestheticians, and operators who take the craft seriously — and who genuinely love what they do. You’ll work with cutting-edge technology, real patients with real goals, and colleagues who push you to grow.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20933%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Medical-grade craft

Industry-leading protocols, CE-marked devices, ongoing clinical training.

## Human-first culture

Non-scripted. Non-judgmental. Towards patients and each other.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201050%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

![Orange Twist practitioner 1 - Concert treatment](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20789%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Room to grow

Structured career paths, mentorship from Medical Advisory Board, cross-location opportunities.

Benefits and perks

## Perks that go beyond the paycheck

We take care of you the same way we take care of our patients — with attention to what actually matters.

### Free treatments

Complimentary access to OrangeTwist services for you and your family.

### Career growth

Clear promotion paths from Injector to Lead to Center Manager and beyond.

### Flexible scheduling

Shifts that work around your life, not the other way around.

### Clinical training

Ongoing education, device certifications, and Medical Advisory Board access.

### Competitive comp

Market-rate salary + performance bonuses + TwistMode loyalty perks.

### Health & wellbeing

Medical, dental and vision. Because your health matters too.

# We Believe Everyone Deserves to Look and Feel Their Best

This belief informs everything we do, from how our treatment centers are designed to where they’re located to the kinds of treatments we offer. We’re minimally-invasive, non-judgemental, non-fussy. Our goal isn’t to change you, just help accentuate what’s already there.

## Where Science Meets Self-Care

#### Medical Grade Treatments

We use the same clinically-backed devices and products as top dermatologists and plastic surgeons, performed by highly-trained experts.

Every treatment is personalized for each client’s unique goals and needs to achieve the most natural results. Our treatment centers are purposely designed to feel less like going to the doctor and more like hitting the local “it” spot.

Expert Guidance

## Meet Our Medical Advisory Board

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20480%201024'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Dr. Karen K. Leong

Dr. Karen K. Leong, a board-certified plastic surgeon based in Newport Beach, CA, specializes in the nuances of beauty and graceful aging. With a comprehensive understanding of facial and body structural changes, she offers a thoughtful approach to patient care, combining empathy with a direct manner.

Dr. Leong’s expertise extends beyond surgery to include skincare, injectables, and lasers, enhancing her patients’ overall experience. She holds a medical degree from Drexel University College of Medicine and completed her residency at Brown University, followed by a prestigious fellowship in aesthetic plastic surgery, where she trained with renowned surgeons both in the U.S. and internationally.

## Dr. Taylor Pollei

Dr. Taylor Pollei is board-certified by the American Board of Otolaryngology—Head and Neck Surgery.

Following medical school, five years of surgical training at the prestigious Mayo Clinic, and a facial plastic surgery fellowship year in Albany, New York, Dr. Pollei established his “concierge-style” private facial plastic surgery practice in southern Orange County.

Dr. Pollei focuses on facial rejuvenation treatment through injectables and other non-surgical options as an addition to his passion for cosmetic and reconstructive facial plastic surgery.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20701%201024'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201080%201080'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Dr. James D. Goggin

Dr. James D. Goggin is a board-certified Plastic Surgeon in Fort Worth, Texas. He received his medical degree at the University of Texas Medical Branch in Galveston and completed his plastic surgery training at Baylor Scott & White – Texas A&M Medical Center in Temple.

Dr. Goggin completed an Aesthetic & Reconstructive Breast Fellowship and an Aesthetic Surgery Fellowship at The Plastic Surgery Center in Sacramento. He has earned a reputation for his high level of surgical skill and dedication to patient care.

His broad experience and commitment to providing unparalleled care inspired him to open Westside Plastic Surgery in his hometown of Fort Worth, TX.

# Personalized Treatments for Everyone

Whether you’re looking to sculpt, smooth, or refresh, every treatment starts with a complimentary consultation and a customized plan that’s all about you.

## Your OrangeTwist Botox journey starts with a You Review.

A licensed provider will get to know your face, listen to your goals, and map out a personalized plan. No pressure, no hard sell. Just honest, expert guidance before anything begins.

##### You Review

Every OrangeTwist journey starts with a You Review. It’s our complimentary, no-pressure consultation, and it’s where the real personalization happens. Your provider or esthetician sits down with you, gets to know your face, listens to your goals, and walks you through what’s possible. Together, you’ll talk through the right treatment plan, the cadence that fits your life, and exactly what it costs before anything is booked or recommended. No hard sell, no surprises, no obligation to proceed on the day. Just honest, expert guidance from the people who’ll be treating you.

##### Botox Preparation

A few days before your appointment, avoid blood thinners like ibuprofen and aspirin where possible, and hold off on alcohol for 24 hours beforehand. Come in with a clean face. That is all there is to it.

##### The Botox Treatment

Your provider will use a very fine needle to deliver small, precise amounts of Botox into the targeted muscles. The whole process takes 15 to 30 minutes. Most clients describe each injection as the lightest spicy on the menu, gone in a second.

##### Botox Aftercare

Stay upright for four hours after treatment, skip the gym for the rest of the day, and steer clear of rubbing or applying pressure to the treated areas. Light redness or minor swelling at the injection sites is completely normal and settles quickly. Your provider will confirm what to expect at your appointment.

## Botox Before & Afters

When Botox is done well, people notice something has changed without being able to say exactly what. You look refreshed, more alert, like you have had a genuinely good week. That is the benchmark our providers work to.

Results typically last three to four months. Many clients find their treatments hold longer with a consistent schedule. Over time, the targeted muscles become less active between appointments, which can mean less product needed and more time between visits. Your provider will map out a realistic maintenance plan based on how your results settle.

## Masseter (Jawline)

A heavy or square jaw is often less about bone structure and more about an overworked masseter muscle, the one that powers chewing and clenching. Botox relaxes it over time, gradually slimming the lower face into a softer, more tapered jawline. Bonus: it can ease jaw tension, grinding, and clenching too.

## What is Botox and how does it work?

Botox Cosmetic is an FDA-approved injectable made from botulinum toxin type A. It works by temporarily relaxing the facial muscles responsible for expression lines. When injected, it blocks the chemical signal that tells those muscles to contract. The skin above softens, and lines become noticeably smoother.  
  
This is not about changing your face. It is about accentuating a version of it that looks genuinely refreshed. In experienced hands, Botox delivers results that are tailored to your goals and wear naturally over three to five months.  
  
Botox is one of the most studied aesthetic treatments in the world. Millions of treatments are performed each year. At OrangeTwist, every injection is carried out by a licensed provider who specializes in facial aesthetics and trains continuously in the latest techniques.

Think forehead creases from a lifetime of raised eyebrows, the elevens between your brows, crow’s feet that deepen every time you laugh, and the finer lines that gather around the eyes, nose, and mouth. It can also lift the brow for a subtle, refreshed eye area, smooth dimpling in the chin, soften neck bands, and slim a heavy jaw by relaxing the masseter muscle.

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

Still have questions about Botox and Anti Wrinkle treatments? You’re in good company. Below are the questions our clients ask most often, answered by the team who actually performs the treatment. If yours isn’t here, bring it to your You Review.

Common questions OrangeTwist Difference Appointments and pricing Results and Aftercare

### What is Botox?

Botox Cosmetic is an FDA-approved injectable treatment made from botulinum toxin type A. It temporarily relaxes the facial muscles responsible for creating expression lines, softening the skin above them. It is one of the most studied and widely performed aesthetic treatments in the world.

### How does Botox work?

Botox works by blocking the chemical signal that tells your facial muscles to contract. When those muscles ease up, the skin above them softens and expression lines become less visible. The effect is temporary, which is what makes the treatment so controllable and adjustable over time.

### What is the difference between Botox and Dermal Filler?

Botox and filler do two different things. Botox relaxes the muscles that cause wrinkles. Filler adds or restores volume beneath the skin. Botox is best for dynamic wrinkles formed by repeated facial movement, such as frown lines and crow’s feet. Filler is better suited to static lines, volume loss, and contouring. Many clients use both together for a more complete result.

### What areas can Botox treat?

At OrangeTwist, Botox is most commonly used to treat:

-   Forehead lines
-   Frown lines between the brows
-   Crow’s feet around the outer eyes
-   Brow lifting for a subtle, refreshed eye area
-   Bunny lines on the nose
-   Lip lines and fine lines around the mouth
-   Chin dimpling and texture
-   Neck bands

Your provider will recommend the most appropriate areas for your goals at your You Review

### What is preventative Botox?

Preventative Botox refers to starting treatment before deep lines set in, typically in the late 20s or early 30s. By relaxing the muscles early and consistently, you can slow how quickly expression lines become permanent. It is one of the most proactive long-term approaches to aesthetic care.

### Is Botox only for Women?

Not at all. Botox is increasingly popular with men for exactly the same reasons. Smoothing forehead lines, softening frown lines, and reducing crow’s feet are not gender-specific goals. OrangeTwist providers work with clients of all genders and adapt every treatment plan to the individual.

### Will Botox make me look frozen?

Not when performed by an experienced provider. The frozen look associated with Botox is almost always the result of too much product or poor placement. At OrangeTwist, our providers focus on natural-looking results that preserve your expressions while softening the lines caused by them. You will still look like you, just more refreshed.

### How is Botox different from Dysport or Jeuveau?

Botox Cosmetic, Dysport, and Jeuveau are all botulinum toxin type A injectables that work in the same way. The differences lie in their formulation, unit measurement, and onset time. At your You Review, your provider will recommend the right neuromodulator for your goals and anatomy.  

### Who performs the treatment?

Every Botox treatment at OrangeTwist is carried out by a licensed provider with specific training in facial injectables and aesthetic technique. Visit your local Treatment Shop to meet the team.

### Precision over volume

We are not here to max out your units. We are here to achieve your goal. Our providers use exactly what is needed for a natural, balanced result.

### You Review included

Every client starts with a complimentary, no-pressure consultation. Your provider assesses your facial anatomy and listens to your goals before recommending anything.

### Membership that pays you back

Botox is one of the treatments where membership earns its keep fastest. TwistUp members get exclusive pricing on every visit, plus Beauty Bank credit toward future treatments.

### Alle points stack here

Alle members earn points on every Botox treatment at OrangeTwist. Link your account before your You Review and the points stack from your first visit.

### How Much does Botox cost at OrangeTwist?

Our from price for Botox starts at $295, the total price will dependent on treatment areas and the number of the units required. Your provider will walk through a personalized plan and exact costs at your complimentary You Review before anything is agreed. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing benefits on all treatments.

### How long does a Botox treatment take?

Most Botox treatments take 15 to 30 minutes depending on the number of areas treated. If you are combining your You Review with the treatment in the same visit, allow around 45 to 60 minutes in total.

### What should I do to prepare for my treatment?

In the days before, avoid blood-thinning medications like ibuprofen and aspirin where possible. Skip alcohol for 24 hours beforehand. Come in with a clean face, free of makeup.

### Do Twisted members get a discount?

Yes. TwistUp membership includes exclusive pricing benefits across all OrangeTwist treatments including Botox. Members also earn TwistMode points on every treatment, redeemable through the Beauty Bank.

### Can I earn Alle points on Botox?

Yes. Botox Cosmetic treatments at OrangeTwist are eligible for Alle points. Make sure your Alle account is linked before your appointment.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review. OrangeTwist accepts all major credit and debit cards, plus financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi.

### When will I see results from Botox?

Results begin developing within 3 to 7 days of treatment. Full effects are visible at around 14 days as the treated muscles gradually relax and the skin softens. You will notice lines reducing progressively, not all at once, which is what a natural result looks like.

### How long does Botox last?

Usually three to four months. Some clients stretch it to five with a regular cadence. Your provider will walk you through a schedule that matches your face, not a calendar.

### Will my Wrinkles come back worse if I stop?

No. If you stop having Botox, your wrinkles will gradually return to where they were before treatment. They will not be worse than before. Many clients find that years of consistent treatment leave their skin with fewer lines when the product wears off than it would have had otherwise.

### What should I avoid after Botox?

For the first 24 hours after treatment:

-   Hold off on facials, microneedling, or any procedure that puts pressure on the face for two weeks
-   Do not lie flat or lean your head forward for at least 4 hours
-   Avoid strenuous exercise, saunas, and hot environments
-   Do not rub or massage the treated areas
-   Avoid alcohol for 24 hours

### Can I exercise after Botox?

Light walking is fine. Avoid strenuous exercise, heavy lifting, and anything that increases blood pressure to the face for 24 hours after treatment.

### Can I drink alcohol after Botox?

Skip alcohol for 24 hours after treatment. Alcohol increases the chance of bruising and swelling at the injection sites.

### Is Botox safe?

Yes. Botox has decades of clinical use, an extensive safety record, and is one of the most studied aesthetic treatments in the world. At OrangeTwist, every treatment is performed by a licensed provider trained in facial injectables.

### What are the side effects of Botox?

The most common side effects are temporary and mild, including slight redness, swelling, or bruising at the injection sites. These typically resolve within a few hours to a few days. Rare side effects include temporary drooping of an eyelid or brow, which resolves naturally as the product wears off.

Whats on the menu?

## Our Anti-wrinkle brands

At OrangeTwist, we stock the wrinkle relief brands with the track record to back them up: Botox Cosmetic, Dysport, and Jeuveau. All three are FDA-approved botulinum toxin type A injectables, all three are sourced through authorized suppliers, and all three are administered by licensed providers trained specifically in facial aesthetics.

The one that started it all. The Classic Facial is a tailored cleanse, exfoliation, extraction, and mask, customized to your skin on the day. No machinery. Just expert hands, quality products, and skin that feels measurably better. The foundation, done well.

## The original, still undefeated.

Some treatments need machines, devices, and complicated explainers. The Classic Facial is not one of them. Hot towels, careful extraction, a custom mask, and an hour to actually breathe. Your skin walks out cleaner, brighter, and more balanced than it has been in weeks.

-   Fully tailored to your skin
-   Deep clean, deep relax
-   Suitable for every skin type

## What is a Classic Facial and how does it work?

The Classic Facial is the foundational facial treatment, refined over decades and still one of the most reliable ways to give your skin a meaningful reset. The treatment follows a tailored sequence of steps your esthetician adjusts to your skin on the day: a thorough cleanse to remove surface buildup, gentle exfoliation to lift dull cells, hands-on extraction where needed, a treatment mask matched to your concern, and a finishing routine of serums and moisturizer.

Where modern facials lean on devices and technology, the Classic Facial leans on expertise. Your esthetician’s hands and product knowledge are the technology. The result is a treatment that adapts to whatever your skin needs that week, rather than running a fixed protocol.

Classic facials are particularly well-suited to clients new to professional skincare, clients between more advanced treatments who want to keep their skin balanced, and clients who simply enjoy the pace and pause of an hour spent doing nothing but caring for their skin. Maintenance is the whole point.

At OrangeTwist, we stock medical-grade products from ALASTIN, ZO Skin Health, SkinCeuticals, and Epicutis. Your esthetician will use the formulas best suited to your skin during the treatment and can recommend a take-home routine to extend the results.

## The OrangeTwist Difference

##### Expert hands, every time

Every Classic Facial at OrangeTwist is performed by a licensed esthetician trained on multiple skincare product lines and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board. The products matter. The hands matter more.

##### Medical-grade products

OrangeTwist stocks ALASTIN, ZO Skin Health, SkinCeuticals, and Epicutis in-center. Your esthetician will use the formulas that match your skin and recommend a routine to extend your results.

##### The maintenance treatment

The Classic Facial is the maintenance anchor of a smart skincare plan. Monthly cadence keeps your skin balanced and primed for the more advanced treatments scheduled around it.

##### Your local Treatment Shop

Bright, welcoming, and run by people who genuinely care about your experience. Nothing like a spa, nothing like a clinic.

## You Review

Your esthetician will examine your skin, listen to your concerns, and recommend whether the Classic Facial is the right starting point for your routine. For most clients, the Classic Facial is a monthly maintenance treatment that pairs with more advanced services scheduled less frequently. No pressure, no hard sell.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20572'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Preparation

Very little preparation needed. Avoid retinoids and active acids the night before your session. Come in with a clean face. Hydrate.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## The Treatment

Your esthetician will work through the tailored sequence: cleanse, exfoliate, extraction where needed, treatment mask, finishing serums and moisturizer. The pace is unhurried, and most of the experience feels measurably more relaxing than spicy. Total treatment time is 50 to 60 minutes.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201360%20907'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Aftercare

There is no downtime. You can return to normal activities immediately, including makeup. Apply SPF, drink water, and your esthetician will share any specific aftercare based on the products used.

## The visible kind of refresh.

Most clients see visibly brighter, cleaner, more balanced skin immediately after the treatment. The result builds slightly over the following 24 to 48 hours as the active serums continue working and surface inflammation settles.

### Results from a single Classic Facial typically last two to three weeks, which is why monthly maintenance is the most common cadence.

Built into a routine alongside Glo2Facial, Hydrafacial, or any of our more advanced treatments, the Classic Facial becomes the steady anchor your skin returns to.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20788'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Classical Facial Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About the Classic Facial Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare and Comfort Safety and Suitability

### What is a Classic Facial?

The Classic Facial is a tailored, hands-on facial treatment that follows a foundational sequence: cleanse, exfoliate, extraction, treatment mask, and finishing serums and moisturizer. Your esthetician adapts the protocol to your skin on the day.

### Is the Classic Facial good for all skin types?

Yes. The Classic Facial is fully tailored to your skin on the day. Your esthetician selects products, exfoliation strength, and extraction approach based on your skin type, concerns, and how your skin is behaving that week.

### What products does OrangeTwist use during a Classic Facial?

OrangeTwist stocks medical-grade products from ALASTIN, ZO Skin Health, SkinCeuticals, and Epicutis. Your esthetician selects the formulas best suited to your skin during the treatment.

### Will I get extractions during my Classic Facial?

Where needed and where your skin can tolerate it, yes. Your esthetician will assess your skin and perform extractions on blackheads or congested pores as part of the treatment. If your skin is reactive or inflamed, your esthetician may skip or reduce extractions to avoid irritation.

### Can I add boosters to my Classic Facial?

Yes. Many clients add LED light therapy, a Dermaplane, or a glow add-on. Your esthetician will recommend the right additions for your skin at your You Review.

### Do I need a consultation before a Classic Facial?

Yes. Every OrangeTwist client starts with a complimentary You Review. Your esthetician will examine your skin, listen to your goals, and recommend whether the Classic Facial is the right starting point for your routine.

### Can I have a consultation and treatment on the same day?

Yes. The You Review and Classic Facial typically happen in the same appointment for new clients.

### What should I tell my esthetician?

Let your esthetician know about your current skincare routine, any active skin conditions, recent cosmetic treatments, allergies, and whether you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

### How much does a Classic Facial cost at OrangeTwist?

Pricing depends on the products used and any add-ons or boosters included. The Classic Facial is one of the more accessibly priced treatments on the menu. Your esthetician will walk you through exact pricing at your You Review. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing benefits.

### How long does a Classic Facial appointment take?

Allow 60 to 75 minutes for your full appointment. The treatment itself takes 50 to 60 minutes.

### How often should I book a Classic Facial?

Monthly is the most common cadence. Your esthetician will recommend a frequency based on your skin and the rest of your treatment plan.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Most clients pay for facials in the moment, but for packages or memberships, financing is available.

### When will I see results from a Classic Facial?

Most clients see visibly brighter, cleaner, more balanced skin immediately after the treatment. The result builds slightly over the following 24 to 48 hours.

### How long do results last?

Results from a single Classic Facial typically last two to three weeks, which is why monthly maintenance is the most common cadence.

### Will a Classic Facial fix my acne?

The Classic Facial can help with mild acne, congestion, and surface texture. For active or persistent acne, your esthetician may recommend a longer-term plan involving medical-grade skincare, chemical peels, or other treatments alongside regular facials.

### Can I have a Classic Facial before an event?

Yes, with one caveat: if extractions are part of your treatment, schedule the facial three to five days before the event rather than the day before, to give any post-extraction redness time to settle.

### Does a Classic Facial hurt?

No. The Classic Facial is one of the most relaxing treatments on the menu. The only briefly spicy step is extraction, where applicable, and your esthetician will keep the pressure to what your skin can comfortably tolerate.

### What is the downtime after a Classic Facial?

There is no downtime. Most clients return to normal activities immediately. If extractions were part of your treatment, expect mild redness or small marks for a few hours, occasionally up to 24 hours.

### What should I avoid after a Classic Facial?

For 24 hours: avoid retinoids, active acids, and harsh exfoliants. Apply SPF daily. Avoid hot showers, saunas, and intense workouts for the rest of the day. Beyond that, return to your normal routine.

### When can I wear makeup after a Classic Facial?

Wait at least a few hours before applying makeup. If extractions were involved, wait until any redness has fully settled.

### Is the Classic Facial safe?

Yes. The Classic Facial is one of the safest treatments on the menu. At OrangeTwist, every session is performed by a licensed esthetician trained on multiple skincare product lines.

### Who should not have a Classic Facial?

The Classic Facial is suitable for most clients. Your esthetician may adjust the protocol or recommend an alternative if you have an active skin infection or open wound in the treatment area, have an active cold sore outbreak, have an active severe eczema, rosacea, or psoriasis flare, have used isotretinoin (Accutane) in the past six months, or are pregnant (some active ingredients may be substituted). Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### Is the Classic Facial safe for all skin tones?

Yes. The Classic Facial is fully tailored and safe across all skin tones and types.

### What are the side effects?

Common short-term effects include mild redness, warmth, or slight tenderness after extractions, all of which typically resolve within hours.

### How do I know my esthetician is qualified?

All Classic Facial treatments at OrangeTwist are performed by licensed estheticians trained on multiple skincare product lines and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board.

# Chemical Peels at OrangeTwist

Smoother. Brighter. Clearer. Chemical peels are the original skin resurfacing treatment, and there is a reason they have stayed on the menu for decades. The right peel, in the right hands, gives you the kind of glow that does not come out of a bottle.

Starting from $152

##### About the treatment

![clock-icon](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/clock.svg)

## The original resurfacing treatment.

A chemical peel uses a tailored blend of acids to lift away dull surface skin and reveal the brighter, smoother skin underneath. From a light glow peel that fits into a lunch break to deeper resurfacing for pigmentation and texture, OrangeTwist offers the full range, matched to your skin and your downtime tolerance.

-   Light, medium, and deeper peels
-   Brightens, smooths, evens tone
-   Tailored to your skin

## Peel by peel, the glow shows up

Light peels deliver an immediate glow that lasts one to two weeks. Best results come from a course of four to six sessions, spaced four to six weeks apart, where each peel builds on the last. Medium peels deliver more dramatic single-session change, but the visible peeling phase is part of the deal.

![Perfect-Derma-Peel-After-2](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/After-2-800x800.jpg) After

![Perfect-Derma-Peel-Before-2](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Before-2-800x800.jpg) Before

 ![Perfect-Derma-Peel-After-1](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/After-1-800x800.jpg) After

![Perfect-Peel-Before-1](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Before-1-800x800.jpg) Before

## What is a chemical peel and how does it work?

A chemical peel uses an acid solution applied to clean skin to gently lift away the upper layer of dead, dull, or discolored cells. As that layer is replaced, your skin reveals a fresher, smoother, more even surface underneath. Different acids work at different depths and target different concerns, which is why your provider matches the peel to your specific goals.

Light peels (glycolic, lactic, mandelic) work at the surface and are designed for a quick glow boost with minimal downtime. Medium-depth peels (TCA, Jessner’s, salicylic) reach further and address pigmentation, acne marks, and texture. Deeper peels are reserved for specific clinical use and almost always carry meaningful downtime.

OrangeTwist also offers PRX-T33, a peel that breaks the usual peel rule entirely. PRX-T33 delivers similar benefits to a traditional peel without surface peeling or social downtime. It works at depth without damaging the surface, which makes it a popular choice for clients who want the glow without the visible recovery window.

## The OrangeTwist Difference

##### The right peel, not the deepest

The right peel is the one matched to your skin, your goals, and the week you actually live in. Our providers walk through depth, downtime, and timing honestly at your You Review.

##### Course-led pricing

Peels work best as a course. We price packages of sessions transparently at your You Review, with TwistUp member benefits across every visit.

##### Aftercare that earns its keep

OrangeTwist stocks ALASTIN, ZO Skin Health, SkinCeuticals, and Epicutis in-center. Your provider will recommend the medical-grade products that keep your peel results going between sessions.

## You Review

Your provider will examine your skin, discuss your goals, and recommend the right peel and depth for your case. Lighter peels can often be delivered on the same day. Medium peels are usually scheduled separately so your provider can map out the timing around your life and any other treatments.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Peel Prep

Stop retinoids and active acids for five to seven days before your session. Avoid sun exposure and self-tanner for two weeks beforehand. Come in with a clean face. Let your provider know about any active cold sores, acne, or recent skincare changes.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## The Treatment

Your provider will cleanse your skin and apply the peel solution in layers, building intensity as appropriate. You will feel mild to moderate warmth and tingling depending on the peel depth, spicy but easily manageable. Treatment takes 30 to 45 minutes.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%202560%201707'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Aftercare

Downtime depends on the peel depth. Light peels: a few hours of mild redness, ready for makeup the next day. Medium peels: three to seven days of visible peeling and flaking. PRX-T33: no real downtime at all. Your provider will share specific aftercare and product recommendations for your peel type.

## PRX-T33 builds over a course of four to six sessions, with no downtime in between.

Most clients combine peels with other treatments (HydraFacial, microneedling, medical-grade skincare) for compounded results. Your provider will design the plan, not push the product.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20933%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Chemical Peel Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

The questions clients ask most often before booking a chemical peel. If yours is not here, ask your provider at your You Review.

About Chemical Peels Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare and Comfort Safety and Suitability

### What is a chemical peel?

A chemical peel uses an acid solution applied to clean skin to lift away the upper layer of dead, dull, or discolored cells, revealing the fresher skin underneath. Different acids work at different depths and target different concerns.

### What types of chemical peels does OrangeTwist offer?

OrangeTwist offers light peels (glycolic, lactic, mandelic), medium peels (salicylic, TCA, Jessner’s), and the PRX-T33 No-Peel Peel which delivers benefits without surface peeling or downtime. Your provider will recommend the right peel for your skin at your You Review.

### What is the difference between a light and a medium peel?

Light peels work at the surface and give a quick glow boost with minimal downtime. Medium peels reach further and address pigmentation, acne marks, and texture more substantially, with visible peeling for three to seven days. Your provider will recommend the right depth based on your concern, goals, and downtime tolerance.

### What is PRX-T33 and how is it different from a regular peel?

PRX-T33 is a peel that does not peel. It uses similar active ingredients to a traditional peel but in a formulation designed to work deeper without damaging the surface skin. You get the benefits without the flaking or downtime. See our dedicated PRX-T33 page for more detail.

### What concerns do chemical peels treat?

Chemical peels are effective for dullness, fine lines, sun damage, pigmentation, acne marks, congested skin, and surface texture. Your provider will assess which concern is dominant and match the peel to that.

### Are chemical peels safe for darker skin tones?

Yes, with the right peel and the right protocol. Some peels (mandelic, lactic, and PRX-T33) are particularly well-suited to darker skin tones. Deeper TCA peels carry more risk of pigment changes in darker skin and are used carefully. Your provider will recommend a peel matched to your phototype.

### Do I need a consultation before a chemical peel?

Yes. Peels are matched to skin type, concern, and lifestyle. Every OrangeTwist client starts with a complimentary You Review where your provider will assess your skin and recommend the right peel and protocol.

### What should I tell my provider?

Let your provider know about any active acne, cold sores, current skincare including retinoids or active acids, recent sun exposure or self-tanner, history of pigmentation issues, and any medications including isotretinoin.

### How much does a chemical peel cost at OrangeTwist?

Pricing depends on the peel type and depth. Light peels are the most affordable. PRX-T33 and deeper peels are priced higher. Most clients buy peels as a course. Your provider will walk through exact pricing at your You Review. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing benefits.

### How long does a peel appointment take?

Most peel sessions take 30 to 45 minutes.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most clients see best results across a course of four to six peels, spaced four to six weeks apart. Maintenance every three to six months keeps results building.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from a chemical peel?

Light peels deliver an immediate glow within hours. Medium peels show their full result after the peeling phase, typically a week to ten days. PRX-T33 builds over a course, with visible brightness within days and deeper improvement over months.

### How long do peel results last?

A single light peel result lasts one to two weeks. Course results build cumulatively and can last several months. Maintenance every three to six months extends results long-term.

### Do peels work for melasma?

Some peels can help with melasma, but melasma is one of the trickier pigmentation concerns and requires careful treatment selection. Lighter peels like mandelic are often a safer starting point than deeper TCA peels. Your provider will assess and recommend honestly.

### Will my skin look worse before it looks better?

With medium-depth peels, yes, briefly. Visible peeling and flaking are part of the process and signal the treatment is working. Most clients reach a glow phase within seven to ten days. With light peels and PRX-T33, no, there is no awkward in-between phase.

### Does a chemical peel hurt?

Most peels are comfortable. The sensation during application is warmth and tingling, on the spicier end for deeper peels but easily managed. No numbing is typically needed.

### What is the downtime after a peel?

Light peels: a few hours of mild redness, ready for makeup the next day. Medium peels: three to seven days of visible peeling and flaking. PRX-T33: no real downtime at all. Your provider will walk you through what to expect for the specific peel at your You Review.

### What should I avoid after a peel?

For one to two weeks depending on peel depth: avoid retinoids, active acids, harsh exfoliants, intense workouts, saunas, and direct sun. Apply SPF 30 or higher every day. Do not pick or peel the flaking skin, let it shed on its own.

### When can I wear makeup after a peel?

Light peels and PRX-T33: makeup is fine immediately or within 24 hours. Medium peels: wait until the visible peeling has finished, typically five to seven days. Mineral makeup is gentler on recovering skin.

### Are chemical peels safe?

Yes. Chemical peels have decades of clinical use and a strong safety record when performed by trained professionals at appropriate depths for the skin type. At OrangeTwist, every peel is matched to your skin and applied by a licensed esthetician or provider.

### Who should not have a chemical peel?

Peels are generally not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have an active skin infection or open wound in the treatment area, have an active cold sore outbreak, have an active severe acne flare, have used isotretinoin (Accutane) in the past six months, or have a known allergy to any peel ingredients. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### What are the side effects?

Common side effects include redness, dryness, peeling, and mild irritation. All are expected and resolve as the skin renews. Rare side effects include unexpected pigment changes or prolonged irritation, which is why peel selection and provider technique matter.

### How do I know my provider is qualified?

All chemical peels at OrangeTwist are performed by licensed estheticians or providers with specific training in peel chemistry, skin assessment, and protocol. Our team is supervised by our Medical Advisory Board.

## Collagen is a Love Language

Where traditional fillers add volume directly, collagen stimulators work differently. They trigger your skin to produce its own new collagen over a course of treatments. The result is firmer, smoother, more supported skin, built from the inside, that lasts significantly longer than HA fillers.

-   Builds your own collagen
-   Long-lasting, natural results
-   Works with your face

## What are collagen stimulators and how do they work?

Collagen stimulators, also called biostimulators, are FDA-approved injectables that prompt the body to produce its own new collagen. Unlike hyaluronic acid fillers that add immediate volume, biostimulators work gradually over weeks and months. The visible improvement comes from your own collagen rebuilding the structure of the skin from underneath.

Two products lead this category. Sculptra, made from poly-L-lactic acid, is dissolved into the skin in microparticles that trigger fibroblasts (the cells that produce collagen) to ramp up production. Results build over three to six months and last around two years on average. Radiesse, made from calcium hydroxylapatite microspheres in a gel carrier, delivers some immediate volume alongside collagen stimulation, with results that typically last 12 to 18 months.

Because the result comes from your own collagen, biostimulator treatments tend to look and feel natural. The skin does not appear filled. It appears restored. Your provider will recommend the right product based on the areas being treated, the type of correction needed, and your timeline.

## The OrangeTwist Difference

##### Advanced injector training

Collagen stimulators require advanced injector skill and a deep understanding of facial anatomy. Every treatment at OrangeTwist is performed by a licensed provider with specific training in biostimulator technique.

##### Course-led, plan-led

Biostimulators are a course, not a single visit. We price the realistic full plan transparently and walk through what to expect at each stage at your You Review.

##### Aftercare guidance that earns its keep

Sculptra requires specific post-treatment massage at home. Your provider will demonstrate the technique in-center and check in during the course to make sure you are on track.

##### Your local Treatment Shop

Bright, welcoming, and run by people who care about your experience and your long-term results.

Prep 101

## Your Treatment Timeline

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## You Review

Your provider will assess your skin, examine the areas you want to address, and recommend whether Sculptra, Radiesse, or a combination suits your goals. They will walk through realistic timelines (collagen takes time to build) and pricing for the full course before anything is booked.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Onboarding

Avoid blood-thinning medications like ibuprofen, aspirin, fish oil, and vitamin E for a few days before your appointment where possible. Skip alcohol for 24 hours beforehand. Eat beforehand. Hydrate well in the days leading up. Come in with a clean face.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Ongoing Care

Your provider will mark the injection points and apply topical numbing. The product is injected in small amounts across the treatment area. Most clients describe the sensation as a manageable spicy. Treatment takes 30 to 45 minutes.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20645%20645'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Maintenance and Transition

For Sculptra, you will be asked to massage the treated areas at home for several days after treatment, in a specific pattern your provider will demonstrate. This helps the product disperse evenly. Avoid strenuous exercise and heat exposure for 24 hours. Mild swelling, redness, or bruising is normal and settles over the following days.

## The slow build, the long pay-off.

Collagen stimulators are a different timeline from HA fillers. Initial swelling after Sculptra masks the final result, and the treated areas may look temporarily fuller right after. As that settles, the actual result is the new collagen that builds underneath. You will see meaningful change after four to six weeks, and continued improvement for three to six months as collagen production continues.

Most clients need two to three sessions, spaced four to six weeks apart, to reach their goal. Results last around two years on average for Sculptra and 12 to 18 months for Radiesse. An annual maintenance session keeps results building over time.

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About Collagen Stimulators Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare Safety and Suitability

### What are collagen stimulators?

Collagen stimulators, also called biostimulators, are FDA-approved injectables that prompt the body to produce its own new collagen. Unlike hyaluronic acid fillers that add immediate volume, biostimulators work gradually over weeks and months. The visible improvement comes from your own collagen, rebuilt from underneath.

### What is Sculptra?

[Sculptra](https://orangetwist.com/treatments/sculptra/) is the lead collagen stimulator in aesthetic medicine. It is made from [poly-L-lactic acid](https://orangetwist.com/dictionary/sculptra/), a biodegradable material that has been used in medical applications for decades. When injected, Sculptra microparticles trigger fibroblasts to produce new collagen. Results build over three to six months and last around two years on average.

### What is Radiesse?

[Radiesse](https://orangetwist.com/treatments/radiesse/) is a collagen stimulator made from calcium hydroxylapatite microspheres in a gel carrier. Unlike Sculptra, Radiesse delivers some immediate volume alongside the collagen stimulation. Results typically last 12 to 18 months and are particularly effective for jawline contouring and hand rejuvenation.

### What is the difference between collagen stimulators and HA fillers?

HA fillers (like JUVÉDERM and Restylane) add immediate volume that lasts six to 18 months and can be reversed with hyaluronidase. Collagen stimulators trigger your own collagen production. Results build gradually over months and last significantly longer, but they are not reversible the same way.

### Which is better: collagen stimulators or HA fillers?

Neither is better in isolation. They do different jobs. HA fillers are ideal for immediate, targeted, reversible volume (lips, tear troughs, fine lines). Collagen stimulators are better for broader structural restoration and longer-lasting results in larger areas like cheeks, jawline, and décolletage. Many clients use both.

### What areas can be treated?

Common treatment areas include cheeks, jawline, temples, marionette lines, hands, and décolletage. Some collagen stimulators have off-label clinical use for body laxity (knees, upper arms, abdomen). Your provider will discuss what is appropriate at your You Review.

### Do I need a consultation before collagen stimulators?

Yes. Biostimulators are a structured course with a different timeline from HA fillers, so a thorough consultation is essential. Every OrangeTwist client starts with a complimentary You Review where your provider will assess your goals, recommend the right product, and walk through realistic timelines.

### What should I tell my provider?

Let your provider know about any autoimmune conditions, previous biostimulator treatments, current medications, blood thinners, allergies, and skin conditions. The more your provider knows, the better the plan.

### Am I a good candidate for collagen stimulators?

Good candidates are clients with mild to moderate volume loss, early skin laxity, or those wanting longer-lasting alternatives to HA fillers. Biostimulators are not typically the right choice for delicate areas like the lips or under-eyes. Your provider will assess and recommend honestly at your You Review.

### How much do collagen stimulators cost?

Pricing depends on the product and the number of vials or syringes needed. Because biostimulators are a structured course, OrangeTwist prices the full plan transparently at your You Review. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing benefits on all treatments.

### How long does a treatment session take?

Most sessions take 30 to 45 minutes. Allow additional time for topical numbing to take effect. If combining your You Review with treatment in the same visit, allow around 90 minutes.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most clients need two to three sessions, spaced four to six weeks apart, to reach their initial goal. An annual maintenance session keeps results building over time. Your provider will set realistic expectations at your You Review.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from collagen stimulators?

Results build gradually. Initial swelling after Sculptra masks the final outcome for the first one to two weeks. You will see meaningful change at four to six weeks, with continued improvement over three to six months as collagen production continues. Radiesse delivers some immediate volume with continued collagen-led improvement.

### How long do results last?

Sculptra results last around two years on average. Radiesse results typically last 12 to 18 months. Annual maintenance sessions keep results building over time. Individual longevity varies based on lifestyle, sun exposure, and your individual metabolism.

### Can I combine collagen stimulators with other treatments?

Yes, and many clients do. Biostimulators combine well with HA fillers (for immediate volume in delicate areas), RF microneedling (for surface texture and skin quality), and Botox (for expression lines). Your provider will design a treatment sequence at your You Review.

### Will I look different right after treatment?

You may look slightly fuller immediately after treatment due to the diluent used during injection. This settles within a few days, and the visible result comes from the new collagen that builds underneath over the following weeks.

### Do I need to massage after Sculptra?

Yes. Sculptra requires specific post-treatment massage at home, typically five times a day for five days. This helps the product disperse evenly and prevents the formation of nodules. Your provider will demonstrate the technique before you leave the Treatment Shop.

### What should I avoid after collagen stimulator treatment?

For the first 24 to 48 hours: avoid strenuous exercise, saunas, and hot environments; skip alcohol; avoid pressure on the treated areas (other than the prescribed massage for Sculptra); and hold off on other facial treatments for two weeks.

### How long will swelling and bruising last?

Mild swelling typically settles within a few days. Bruising, when it occurs, usually fades within a week. Your provider will share what to expect for your specific treatment areas.

### When can I wear makeup?

Wait at least 24 hours before applying makeup to treated areas. Apply gently when you do. Avoid pressing or massaging the skin during application (other than the prescribed Sculptra massage, if applicable).

### Are collagen stimulators safe?

Yes. Sculptra and Radiesse have strong clinical safety records and decades of medical use. At OrangeTwist, every biostimulator treatment is performed by a licensed provider with specific advanced injector training.

### Who should not have collagen stimulators?

Biostimulators are generally not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have an active skin infection in the treatment area, have certain autoimmune conditions, have a history of keloid scarring, or have a known allergy to any product ingredients. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### What are the side effects?

Common side effects include temporary swelling, bruising, redness, and tenderness at the injection sites, all of which resolve within days. The most notable risk specific to biostimulators is nodule formation, which is why proper technique and post-treatment massage matter. Your provider will walk through risks at your You Review.

### Can collagen stimulators be reversed?

Not in the same way HA fillers can. Collagen stimulators are designed to integrate with the tissue and stimulate the body’s own collagen, so dissolution is not straightforward. This is one reason proper consultation, conservative dosing, and experienced injectors matter so much in this category.

### Are collagen stimulators safe for darker skin tones?

Yes. Biostimulators work independently of skin tone. The treatment principle (stimulating your own collagen) is the same across all skin types. Treatment technique is tailored to facial anatomy, not pigmentation.

### How do I know my provider is qualified?

Collagen stimulators are an advanced injectable category that requires deeper anatomical knowledge and more experience than HA fillers. At OrangeTwist, every biostimulator treatment is performed by a licensed provider with specific advanced injector training, continuously updated on the latest protocols, and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board.

Fillers and injectables that enhance your features, not replace them. Our licensed providers use FDA-approved hyaluronic acid (HA) to restore volume, define contours, and refresh the parts of your face. Subtle. Balanced. Still you.

## Fuller, but still you.

Looking to restore softness in places that have lost it, or refine features without overhauling them? [Hyaluronic acid](https://orangetwist.com/articles/brea/dermal-filler-101-before-first-treatment/) (HA) Dermal fillers, add volume exactly where it is needed, in amounts that work with your face, not against it. Our providers focus on natural-looking balance, not maximalist transformations.

-   Restore lost volume naturally
-   Refine contours and definition
-   FDA-approved and fully reversible

![Ha-Dermal-filler](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201360%20765'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## The OrangeTwist Difference

##### Trained injectors, every time

Every HA Dermal [filler](https://orangetwist.com/dictionary/dermal-fillers/) injection is carried out by a licensed provider with specific training in dermal filler technique, facial anatomy, and product selection. Visit your local Treatment Shop to meet the team.

##### Balanced over maximum

We are not here to overfill. Our providers select the right product, in the right amount, for the result that suits your face. Honest assessment first. Treatment plan second.

##### Reversible by design

OrangeTwist providers carry hyaluronidase, the enzyme that dissolves HA Dermal fillers, on-site. That safety net is non-negotiable for us, and it is a question worth asking anywhere you book.

##### Alle points stack here

Alle members earn points on every Juvederm treatment at OrangeTwist. Link your account before your You Review and the points stack from your first visit.

## Dermal Fillers

A defined jawline does a lot of quiet work. Structure along the lower face sharpens the line between face and neck, your own angles, dialed up a notch.

## What are dermal fillers and how do they work?

Dermal fillers are FDA-approved gels made from hyaluronic acid, a substance the body produces naturally. When injected into specific areas of the face, they restore volume, smooth lines, and refine contours by sitting in the layer of skin where the body’s own hyaluronic acid has thinned over time.

Different filler products are designed for different jobs. Softer formulations sit closer to the surface for lip enhancement and fine lines. Denser, more structural formulations work deeper to rebuild cheekbones, jawline, and chin definition. At OrangeTwist, we use Juvéderm as our lead brand, alongside RHA, [Restylane](https://orangetwist.com/dictionary/restylane/), and Versa products selected for the specific job your provider is doing.

Because hyaluronic acid fillers are reversible, the treatment is one of the most controllable in aesthetic medicine. If a result is not quite right, your provider can dissolve the filler with an enzyme called [hyaluronidase](https://orangetwist.com/articles/highland-village/botox-and-filler-for-beginners-what-to-know-before-your-first-visit/). That single fact is why this is one of the most forgiving injectables on the menu.

## Before treatment

Avoid blood-thinning medications like ibuprofen, aspirin, fish oil, and vitamin E for a few days before your appointment where possible.

Skip alcohol for 24 hours beforehand. Avoid intensive workouts the morning of. Come in with a clean face. Eat beforehand. Hydrate.

![after-full-filler-treatment](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E) After

## What happens next?

Expect some swelling, mild bruising, and tenderness for 24 to 72 hours. Use cool compresses, sleep elevated, and avoid pressure on the treated area for 24 hours. Skip strenuous exercise, alcohol, and heat exposure (saunas, hot yoga) for the first 24 to 48 hours. Your provider will share specific aftercare for your treatment areas.

## Subtle, settled, and naturally yours

You will see initial results immediately from HA Dermal Fillers, though swelling will mask the final outcome for the first one to two weeks. As the swelling settles, your final result becomes clear. The filler integrates with the surrounding tissue, softens visually, and reads as part of your face rather than an addition to it.

Results last anywhere from six to 18 months depending on the product, the area treated, and how your body metabolizes hyaluronic acid. Lips tend to require more frequent touch-ups. Cheek and jawline fillers tend to last longer. Your provider will map out a realistic maintenance schedule based on the products you choose.
