## Dermal Filler Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

The questions clients ask most often before booking dermal filler, from which product suits which area to how long results last. If yours is not here, your provider will walk you through it at your complimentary You Review.

About Dermal Fillers Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare Safety

### What are dermal fillers?

Dermal fillers are FDA-approved gels made from [hyaluronic acid](https://orangetwist.com/dictionary/hyaluronic-acid/), a substance the body produces naturally. They are injected into specific areas of the face to restore volume, smooth lines, define features, and refresh the look of skin that has softened over time.

### How do dermal fillers work?

Hyaluronic acid attracts and holds water in the skin. When injected, the filler adds immediate volume and supports the surrounding tissue. Different products are formulated with different thicknesses for different jobs: softer fillers for lip enhancement, denser fillers for structural areas like cheeks and jawline.

### What is the difference between Botox and filler?

Botox and filler do two different things. Botox relaxes the muscles that cause wrinkles. Filler adds or restores volume beneath the skin. Botox is best for dynamic wrinkles formed by repeated facial movement. Filler is better suited to static lines, volume loss, and contouring. Many clients use both together.

### What is Juvéderm?

Juvéderm is a family of hyaluronic acid filler products made by [Allergan](https://allergan.com/), the same company that makes [Botox](https://orangetwist.com/treatments/botox-anti-wrinkle/). The range includes [JUVÉDERM](https://www.juvederm.com/) Voluma for cheek and jawline volume, Vollure and Volbella for lines and lip enhancement, and Ultra and Ultra Plus for additional lip and facial contouring. Your provider will select the right product for the area being treated.

### What is RHA and how is it different from Juvéderm?

RHA (Resilient Hyaluronic Acid) is a newer family of fillers designed to move with the face, making them particularly suitable for the lips and lower face. Some clients find RHA delivers a more natural feeling during facial expression. Your provider will recommend the right product based on your goals.

### What is Restylane?

Restylane is another family of hyaluronic acid fillers, including Restylane Kysse for lips, Restylane Lyft for cheeks, and Restylane Defyne and Refyne for moderate lines. OrangeTwist providers select across the major HA filler families based on the specific job at hand.

### Are dermal fillers reversible?

Yes. Hyaluronic acid fillers can be dissolved with an enzyme called hyaluronidase, which is given as an injection. This is one of the key safety features of HA fillers and a major reason they remain the most common filler type. OrangeTwist providers carry hyaluronidase on-site.

### What areas can be treated with filler?

Common treatment areas include [lips](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/thin-lips-treatment/), [cheeks](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/cheek-volume-treatment/), [jawline](https://orangetwist.com/dictionary/jawline-definition/), [chin](https://orangetwist.com/dictionary/chin-augmentation/), tear troughs (under-eye hollowing), nasolabial folds (smile lines), marionette lines (corners of the mouth), and temples. Your provider will recommend the right areas for your specific goals at your You Review.

### Do I need a consultation before getting filler?

Yes. Every OrangeTwist filler client starts with a complimentary You Review. Your provider will examine your facial structure, listen to your goals, recommend specific products and amounts, and walk through pricing before anything is booked.

### Can I have a consultation and treatment on the same day?

Yes, in many cases. If your You Review confirms filler is right for you and you are ready to proceed, your provider can often carry out the treatment in the same appointment. There is no pressure to proceed on the day if you want more time.

### What should I tell my provider during the consultation?

Let your provider know about any medications you are taking, previous cosmetic injections, known allergies, cold sore history (especially for lip filler), autoimmune conditions, and whether you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The more your provider knows, the better the plan.

### How much do dermal fillers cost at OrangeTwist?

Pricing depends on the products selected and the volume needed. Filler is typically priced by syringe, and the number of syringes varies by treatment area and your goals. Your provider will walk through exact pricing at your You Review. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing benefits on all treatments.

### How long does a filler appointment take?

Most filler treatments take 30 to 60 minutes depending on the areas being treated. Allow additional time for topical numbing to take effect. If combining your You Review with treatment in the same visit, allow around 90 minutes in total.

### Can I earn Alle points on filler?

Yes. JUVÉDERM treatments at OrangeTwist are eligible for Alle points. Make sure your Alle account is linked before your appointment.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from filler?

Immediate, with swelling masking the final outcome for the first one to two weeks. As the swelling settles, your final result becomes clear. The filler integrates with the surrounding tissue and reads as part of your face.

### How long does filler last?

Six to 18 months on average, depending on the product, the area treated, and your individual metabolism. Lip filler tends to require more frequent touch-ups due to the constant movement of the lips. Cheek and jawline fillers tend to last longer. Your provider will set realistic expectations for the products you choose.

### What does natural filler look like?

Natural filler means subtle restoration, not visible addition. People notice you look rested, balanced, and refreshed without being able to point to anything specific. Lip enhancement that suits your face. Cheek volume that softens hollowing without sitting on top of the bone. That is the result our providers work to.

### What if I do not like my filler result?

Hyaluronic acid fillers can be dissolved with hyaluronidase. Most providers wait two weeks for the final result to settle before considering dissolution, since swelling can mask the true outcome. OrangeTwist providers carry hyaluronidase on-site for exactly this reason.

### Will filler stretch my skin?

Used conservatively, no. Used excessively over many years, repeated overfilling can affect tissue. This is one reason OrangeTwist’s approach favors restraint over volume, and why your provider will discuss long-term maintenance honestly at your You Review.

### What should I avoid after filler?

For the first 24 to 48 hours after treatment: avoid strenuous exercise, saunas, and hot environments; do not apply pressure to or massage the treated areas; avoid alcohol; sleep on your back, elevated, where possible; and hold off on facials, lasers, or any procedure on the treated area for two weeks.

### How long will swelling and bruising last?

Mild swelling typically peaks at 24 to 48 hours and settles over the next several days. Bruising, when it occurs, usually fades within a week. Lip filler tends to swell most dramatically. Tear trough and cheek filler may swell longer. Your provider will share what to expect for your specific treatment.

### Can I exercise after filler?

Light walking is fine. Avoid strenuous exercise, heavy lifting, and anything that increases blood pressure or heat to the face for 24 hours after treatment. Return to your normal routine after 48 hours.

### When can I wear makeup after filler?

Wait at least 24 hours before applying makeup to treated areas, especially for lip filler where injection points need time to seal. Apply gently when you do. Avoid pressing or massaging.

### Are dermal fillers safe?

Hyaluronic acid fillers have an extensive clinical safety record. At OrangeTwist, every injection is performed by a licensed provider with specific training in facial anatomy and filler technique, with hyaluronidase on-site for any complications.

### Who should not have filler?

Filler is generally not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have a known allergy to hyaluronic acid or lidocaine, have an active skin infection in the treatment area, have certain autoimmune conditions, or have an active cold sore outbreak (for lip filler). Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### What are the side effects of dermal fillers?

Common side effects include temporary swelling, bruising, redness, and tenderness at the injection sites, all of which resolve within days. Rare side effects include lumps, asymmetry, or, very rarely, vascular complications. Choosing a properly trained provider is the single most important factor in reducing risk.

# Glo2Facial at OrangeTwist

Less tired. More you. Glo2Facial is the three-step oxygenating facial that exfoliates, infuses, and oxygenates the skin from within. Brighter, plumper, and visibly more awake, in under an hour. The lunch-break glow with the long-weekend payoff.

Starting from $228

##### About the treatment

![clock-icon](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/clock.svg)

![animated-stopwatch-icon](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/animated-stopwatch.gif)

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201120%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## The facial that breathes life back in.

Some weeks the mirror tells on you. Glo2Facial is the reset button. The treatment exfoliates dull surface skin, drives in active serums tailored to your concern, and triggers a natural oxygenating effect at the same time. The result is brighter, plumper, more rested-looking skin you can see when you walk out the door.

-   Three steps, one session
-   Visible glow, no downtime
-   Suitable for every skin type

## What is Glo2Facial and how does it work?

Glo2Facial is a three-step oxygenating facial from Lumenis, formerly known as OxyGeneo. The treatment combines three actions in a single session: gentle exfoliation, infusion of active ingredients tailored to your skin, and an oxygenating effect triggered at the surface that brings fresh, oxygen-rich blood to the area being treated.

Your esthetician selects the active formula that suits your skin on the day. The Hydrate formula targets dehydration and tired surface texture. The Balance formula is designed for oily or congested skin. The Revive formula focuses on early signs of aging, dullness, and uneven tone. The treatment is fully personalized within the same three-step framework.

The oxygenating effect is what gives the treatment its name. As your esthetician works the device across your skin, a chemical reaction occurs at the surface that prompts your body to send fresh, oxygen-rich blood to the area. The result is a noticeable plumping, brightening, and renewed glow that becomes visible within minutes of the treatment finishing.

Glo2Facial is one of the most reliable in-and-out facials on the menu. Forty minutes, three steps, zero downtime, and skin that looks meaningfully better walking out than it did walking in.

## The OrangeTwist Difference

##### Trained on the platform

Every Glo2Facial is performed by a licensed esthetician trained on the platform and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board. The formula matters. The hands matter more.

##### The on-the-day glow

Glo2Facial is the on-the-day-of facial. Pre-event, pre-shoot, pre-anything-you-want-to-look-rested-for. We will book you in around the rest of your schedule.

##### Built for the routine

Glo2Facial works best as part of a routine, not a one-off. Monthly maintenance keeps the glow consistent. We price packages transparently at your You Review.

##### Your local Treatment Shop

Bright, welcoming, and run by people who genuinely care about your experience. Nothing like a clinical environment.

[Book Now](https://orangetwist.com/book-now/)

## Your Treatment Timeline

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## You Review

Your esthetician will examine your skin, listen to your concerns, and recommend the right Glo2Facial formula for your goals. For most clients, Glo2Facial is a single session you build into your routine, often as part of a wider skin maintenance plan. No pressure, no hard sell.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Preparation

Very little preparation needed. Avoid retinoids and active acids the night before your session. Come in with a clean face. Eat beforehand. Hydrate.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## The Treatment

Your esthetician will cleanse your skin, then work through the three steps of the Glo2Facial: exfoliation with the chosen capsule, infusion of the active serum, and the oxygenating step that closes the treatment. Most clients describe the sensation as gentle and warm, more comfortable than spicy. Total treatment time is 40 to 60 minutes.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20645%20645'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Aftercare

There is no downtime. You can return to normal activities immediately, including makeup and your usual skincare routine. Apply SPF, drink water, and your esthetician will share any specific aftercare for the formula you had.

## Glow before you walk out the door.

Glo2Facial is designed for immediate, visible results. Most clients see brighter, plumper, more rested-looking skin within minutes of the treatment finishing. The result builds slightly over the following 24 hours as the active serums continue working and the oxygenating effect fully expresses itself.

### Most clients see results lasting two to four weeks from a single session, which is why monthly maintenance is the most common cadence.

Combined with Hydrafacial, regular skincare, and other treatments in a plan, Glo2Facial becomes part of the glow routine that compounds over months.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20683%201024'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About Glo2Facial Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare and Comfort Safety and Suitability

### What is Glo2Facial?

Glo2Facial is a three-step oxygenating facial from Lumenis, formerly known as OxyGeneo. The treatment exfoliates dull surface skin, infuses active ingredients tailored to your concern, and triggers a natural oxygenating effect at the surface, all in a single session.

### How does the oxygenating effect work?

As your esthetician works the device across your skin, a chemical reaction occurs at the surface that prompts your body to send fresh, oxygen-rich blood to the area. The result is a noticeable plumping, brightening, and renewed glow that becomes visible within minutes of the treatment finishing.

### What is the difference between Glo2Facial and OxyGeneo?

Glo2Facial is the current name for the treatment that was previously branded as OxyGeneo. The technology, formulas, and three-step approach are the same. The rebrand reflects the platform’s evolution under Lumenis.

### What formulas does OrangeTwist offer?

Most centers offer the three core Glo2Facial formulas: Hydrate for dehydration and tired skin, Balance for oily and congested skin, and Revive for early signs of aging and dullness. Your esthetician will recommend the right one for your skin on the day.

### What concerns does Glo2Facial treat?

Glo2Facial is effective for dullness, dehydration, oiliness and congestion, early signs of aging, and surface tone concerns. It is also one of the most popular pre-event facials for an on-the-day glow.

### Is Glo2Facial good for sensitive skin?

Generally yes. Glo2Facial is one of the gentler resurfacing facials and suits most skin types and sensitivities. Your esthetician will adjust the formula and pressure to your skin at your You Review.

### Do I need a consultation before Glo2Facial?

Yes. Every OrangeTwist client starts with a complimentary You Review. Your esthetician will examine your skin, listen to your goals, and recommend the right formula for your case.

### Can I have a consultation and treatment on the same day?

Yes, in most cases. If your You Review confirms Glo2Facial is right for you and you are ready to proceed, your esthetician can often carry out the treatment in the same appointment.

### What should I tell my esthetician?

Let your esthetician know about your current skincare routine including any retinoids or active acids, recent cosmetic treatments, any skin conditions like rosacea or eczema, allergies, and whether you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

### How much does Glo2Facial cost at OrangeTwist?

Pricing depends on the formula and any add-ons or boosters included. Your esthetician will walk through exact pricing at your You Review. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing benefits on all treatments.

### How long does a Glo2Facial appointment take?

Allow 60 minutes for your full appointment. The treatment itself takes 40 to 60 minutes depending on the formula and any add-ons. Most clients find it fits into a lunch break.

### How often should I book a Glo2Facial?

Most clients book monthly to keep the glow consistent. Some clients book around specific events for an on-the-day refresh.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your esthetician about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from Glo2Facial?

Most clients see brighter, plumper, more rested-looking skin within minutes of the treatment finishing. The result builds slightly over the following 24 hours as the active serums continue working.

### How long do results last?

Most clients see results lasting two to four weeks from a single session, which is why monthly maintenance is the most common cadence.

### Will Glo2Facial fix my acne or pigmentation?

Glo2Facial helps with surface tone, balance, and short-term glow. It is not a primary acne treatment or pigmentation correction. For more substantial concerns, your esthetician may recommend a longer-term plan involving chemical peels, microneedling, or other treatments.

### Can I have Glo2Facial before an event?

Yes. Glo2Facial is one of the most popular pre-event facials. Book one to three days before the event for the most rested, glowing finish.

### Does Glo2Facial hurt?

No. Glo2Facial is one of the gentler facials on the menu. Most clients describe the sensation as warm and relaxing, more comfortable than spicy.

### What is the downtime after Glo2Facial?

There is no downtime. You can return to normal activities immediately, including makeup.

### What should I avoid after Glo2Facial?

For 24 hours: avoid retinoids, active acids, and harsh exfoliants. Apply SPF 30 or higher daily. Beyond that, return to your normal routine.

### When can I wear makeup after Glo2Facial?

Immediately. Most clients book Glo2Facial on the way to an event for the day-of glow.

### Is Glo2Facial safe?

Yes. Glo2Facial has a strong safety record across years of clinical use. At OrangeTwist, every session is performed by a licensed esthetician trained on the platform.

### Who should not have Glo2Facial?

Glo2Facial is generally not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding (check with your esthetician for current guidance), have an active skin infection or open wound in the treatment area, have an active cold sore outbreak, have an active severe eczema, rosacea, or psoriasis flare, or have used isotretinoin (Accutane) in the past six months. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### Is Glo2Facial safe for all skin tones?

Yes. Glo2Facial does not target pigment and is safe across all skin tones and types.

### What are the side effects?

Common side effects include mild redness or warmth for a few hours after treatment. All typically resolve quickly. Rare side effects include sensitivity or irritation, which is why your esthetician will adjust the formula and pressure to your skin.

### How do I know my esthetician is qualified?

All Glo2Facial treatments at OrangeTwist are performed by licensed estheticians with specific training on the Glo2Facial platform and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board.

Your skin has a lot going on. Hydrafacial handles all of it. In under an hour, this three-step treatment cleanses, extracts, and floods your skin with the hydration and nutrients it needs. Walk in, walk out glowing.

## Facials designed for real skin, real life, and real results

At OrangeTwist, our facials are designed to do more. Each Hydrafacial is customized to your skin type and goals by a licensed esthetician, using medical-grade serums that go further than anything available over the counter.

### What is a Hydrafacial and how does it work?

Hydrafacial is a non-invasive, medical-grade facial treatment, what sets it apart from a traditional facial is its patented Vortex-Fusion technology. Instead of manual extraction, which can cause redness and discomfort, Hydrafacial uses a spiral suction tip to simultaneously remove congestion and infuse treatment serums into freshly cleared pores. The result is more effective, more comfortable, and visible immediately.

-   Instant, visible glow
-   Zero downtime
-   Every skin type

[Book A Hydrafacial Near You](https://orangetwist.zenoti.com/webstoreNew/services)

### The Hydrafacial before & after glow is real and its immediately visible. Most clients walk out of our centers with visibly cleaner, smoother, and more radiant skin.

No waiting period. No hiding. A single treatment delivers results that typically last 5 to 7 days. With monthly sessions, many clients find their skin holds improvements longer between appointments and maintains hydration more consistently overall.

Let’s get started

### Your OrangeTwist Hydrafacial journey starts with a You Review.

Your esthetician will assess your skin type, listen to what you want to achieve, and recommend the right Hydrafacial tier and booster combination. No pressure, no upsell. Just a clear, honest plan built around your skin.

##### You Review

Come in with a clean face and no active sunburn or open lesions. Let your esthetician know about any skincare products you are currently using, including retinoids, acids, or prescription topicals, as some may affect your treatment plan.

##### The Treatment

Your esthetician will work through the three steps: a gentle exfoliating cleanse, painless vortex extraction, and deep serum infusion. Most clients find the experience deeply relaxing. The spiral tip creates a distinctive sensation but causes no pain or discomfort.

##### Aftercare

You can apply makeup and return to your routine immediately. For the first 24 hours, use gentle products, avoid heavy exfoliants, and apply SPF. Your esthetician will recommend specific products to extend your results at home.

## Pick Your Level

Every Hydrafacial starts with the same great bones: cleanse, extract, hydrate. From there, it’s about how much extra you want to bring to the party. Here’s how the three tiers stack up.

### Signature

The classic. Great for a monthly reset or your first-ever Hydrafacial.

-   Cleanse + Peel: Gentle exfoliation and relaxing resurfacing.
-   Extract + Hydrate: Remove debris from pores with painless suction, then nourish with intense moisturizers.
-   Fuse + Protect: Saturate the skin’s surface with antioxidants and peptides to maximize your glow.

30-45 minutes

**Zero downtime, immediate glow**

### Deluxe

The same benefits as a Signature Hydrafacial with addition:

-   Specialty booster tailored to address your specific skin concerns.
-   LED light therapy to further reduce signs of aging and rejuvenate your skin.

45-60 minutes

**Best for when you know exactly what you’re working on**

### Platinum

The full Hydrafacial experience. Everything in Deluxe, plus:

-   Lymph drainage to detox and depuff.

up to 75 minutes

**The most comprehensive option on the menu**

**Not sure which one’s yours?** That’s exactly what your You Review is for. Your esthetician will look at your skin, hear your goals, and recommend the tier that actually makes sense. No upselling, no guesswork. And if you start with Signature and decide you want more mid-visit, upgrading to Deluxe or Platinum is easy.

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About Hydrafacial Consultations Appointments and pricing Results and Aftercare Safety and Suitability

### What is a Hydrafacial?

Hydrafacial is a non-invasive, medical-grade facial treatment combining three steps: cleansing and exfoliation, painless extraction, and deep hydration with medical-grade serums. It uses patented Vortex-Fusion technology to simultaneously remove impurities and infuse active ingredients, delivering visible results immediately and with no downtime.

### How is Hydrafacial different from a regular facial?

A traditional facial relies on manual extraction, which can cause redness, and standard product application that sits on the surface. Hydrafacial simultaneously extracts and infuses using patented technology, delivering serums deeper and more consistently. Results are also visible immediately.

### What are the three steps of a Hydrafacial?

The three steps are:

-   Cleanse and Peel: gentle exfoliation loosens dead skin cells, followed by a mild chemical peel to lift away dull, congested skin
-   Extract and Hydrate: painless vortex suction removes congestion while simultaneously infusing hydrating serum
-   Fuse and Protect: antioxidants, Hyaluronic Acid, and peptides are delivered into the skin to lock in hydration and protect the complexion

### What serums are used in a Hydrafacial?

Standard serums include Activ-4 for gentle cleansing, GlySal for mild chemical peeling, and Antiox+ for antioxidant protection and Hyaluronic Acid. Boosters can be added for brightening (Britenol), anti-aging (Growth Factor), or skin rejuvenation (CTGF) depending on your goals.

### Is Hydrafacial suitable for all skin types?

Yes. Hydrafacial is safe and effective for all skin types including sensitive skin. Your OrangeTwist esthetician will customize your serums and boosters to suit your specific skin.

### What is the difference between Signature, Deluxe, and Platinum Hydrafacial?

Signature covers the core three-step treatment. Deluxe adds a targeted booster serum for your specific concern. Platinum includes everything in Deluxe plus lymphatic drainage and LED light therapy. Your esthetician will recommend the right tier at your You Review.

### What skin concerns does Hydrafacial address?

Hydrafacial is effective for congested or enlarged pores, fine lines and early wrinkles, uneven skin tone, dryness and dehydration, oily and acne-prone skin, dullness, and sun damage. With the right booster it can also target hyperpigmentation and early aging.

### Do I need a consultation before a Hydrafacial?

Every OrangeTwist Hydrafacial starts with a complimentary You Review. Your licensed esthetician will assess your skin type, discuss your goals, and recommend the right tier and booster combination to ensure your treatment is genuinely customized.

### How do I know which Hydrafacial tier is right for me?

Your esthetician will recommend the best option at your You Review. As a general guide: Signature is ideal for maintenance and general glow, Deluxe adds targeted correction, and Platinum is the most comprehensive option for maximum results.

### What should I tell my esthetician before my Hydrafacial?

Let your esthetician know about any active skin conditions, known allergies, or skincare products you currently use, especially retinoids, prescription topicals, or acid-based products. Also mention if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as certain boosters may not be suitable.

### How much does a Hydrafacial cost at OrangeTwist?

OrangeTwist Hydrafacial Pricing starts from £xxx. Pricing varies by tier and any add-on boosters. Your esthetician will walk through exact pricing at your complimentary You Review before any treatment is agreed. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing benefits on all treatments.

### How long does a Hydrafacial appointment take?

Signature treatments take 30 to 45 minutes. Deluxe runs 45 to 60 minutes. Platinum can take up to 75 minutes. Your esthetician will confirm timing at your You Review.

### Can I book a Hydrafacial as a gift?

Yes. OrangeTwist gift cards can be used across all treatments including Hydrafacial. Ask at your nearest Treatment Shop or visit the OrangeTwist website for gift card options.

### Is financing available for Hydrafacial?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your esthetician about available options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from a Hydrafacial?

Results are visible immediately. Most clients leave the Treatment Shop with noticeably cleaner, smoother, and more radiant skin. There is no waiting period and no downtime.

### How long do Hydrafacial results last?

A single treatment delivers results that typically last 5 to 7 days. With regular monthly sessions, many clients find their skin holds improvements longer between appointments.

### Is there any downtime after a Hydrafacial?

None. Hydrafacial has absolutely no downtime. You can return to work, apply makeup, and carry on with your day immediately after treatment.

### What skincare should I use after a Hydrafacial?

Keep your skincare gentle for the first 24 hours. Avoid retinoids and active exfoliants immediately after treatment. After 24 hours, return to your normal routine. Your esthetician will recommend medical-grade products from OrangeTwist’s in-center brands to extend your results at home.

### How often should I get a Hydrafacial?

Monthly treatments deliver the best cumulative results for most clients. For specific concerns like acne or hyperpigmentation, your esthetician may recommend a more frequent initial schedule before moving to monthly maintenance.

### Will Hydrafacial make my skin more sensitive to the sun?

Your skin may be slightly more sensitive to UV immediately after treatment. Always apply SPF 30 or higher on the day of your treatment and in the days following. Your esthetician can recommend a medical-grade sunscreen from OrangeTwist’s retail range.

### Is Hydrafacial safe for sensitive skin?

Yes. Hydrafacial is one of the gentlest advanced facial treatments available, making it suitable for even sensitive skin types. The exfoliation is mild, the extraction is painless, and the serums are hydrating rather than irritating.

### Can I have a Hydrafacial if I have active acne?

Yes. Hydrafacial is particularly well-suited to acne-prone skin because it clears congestion without manual pressure, minimizing inflammation and the risk of spreading bacteria. The balancing serums used during treatment also help reduce breakouts over time.

### Is Hydrafacial safe during pregnancy?

The core treatment is generally considered safe during pregnancy, but certain booster serums containing retinoids or salicylic acid may not be suitable. Let your esthetician know if you are pregnant or breastfeeding so your treatment can be adjusted accordingly.

### Can I have a Hydrafacial if I have rosacea?

Yes, with care. Hydrafacial can be a good option for rosacea-prone skin because it is non-abrasive and hydrating. Your esthetician will select gentle serums and avoid anything that could trigger a flare. Let them know about your rosacea at your You Review.

### Can teenagers have a Hydrafacial?

Yes. Hydrafacial is suitable for younger clients including teenagers dealing with acne or congested skin. The treatment is gentle, non-invasive, and highly effective for managing breakouts. Parental consent may be required for clients under 18. Ask your Treatment Shop for details.

## The glow is real. And it’s immediate.

Most clients walk out of the Treatment Shop with visibly cleaner, smoother, and more radiant skin.  
No waiting period. No hiding.

## The Skin Reset, From the Inside

Microneedling is one of the most reliable ways to improve skin texture, soften acne scars, and rebuild collagen, without lasers, peels, or downtime measured in weeks. At OrangeTwist, every session is performed by a trained provider using medical-grade devices.

-   Smoother skin texture
-   Softens acne scars
-   Boosts natural collagen

## What is microneedling and how does it work?

Microneedling, also called collagen induction therapy, uses an array of fine medical-grade needles to create controlled micro-channels in the upper layers of the skin. The body responds to these tiny injuries with a natural healing cascade: new collagen, new elastin, and renewed cellular activity in the treated area.

The result is firmer, smoother, more refined skin over a series of sessions. Microneedling is particularly effective for acne scars, enlarged pores, fine lines, uneven texture, and early signs of laxity. It is also one of the most versatile treatments in aesthetics, suitable for almost every skin tone and most skin types.

OrangeTwist offers traditional microneedling and, in selected centers, radiofrequency (RF) microneedling, which adds heat energy at depth for stronger collagen response and tightening. Your provider will recommend the right platform for your goals at your You Review.

## You Review

Your provider will examine your skin, listen to your concerns, and recommend the right microneedling platform and session count. They will walk through a realistic timeline, pricing, and what each session involves. No pressure, no hard sell.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Preparation

Shave the treatment area 24 hours before your appointment. Do not wax, pluck, or use depilatory creams in the four weeks leading up to a session, as the laser needs an intact follicle to work. Avoid sun exposure and self-tanner for two weeks before your visit.

![COncern Treatment 5](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20933'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## The Treatment

Your provider will apply a topical numbing cream and let it sit for 20 to 30 minutes. The microneedling pass takes around 20 to 45 minutes depending on the area. Most clients describe the sensation as spicy but manageable, with the numbing handling most of it.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20313%20417'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Aftercare

Expect redness similar to a mild sunburn for 24 to 48 hours, sometimes with light flaking around days three to five. Use only gentle cleansers and recommended skincare for the first week. Avoid retinoids, exfoliants, makeup, and direct sun for 48 hours. Your provider will give you a specific routine and recommend medical-grade products to extend results.

## Results that build with every session.

Microneedling is a progressive treatment. You will see initial smoothness and glow within a week of your first session as the surface skin renews. The deeper collagen response takes longer, usually four to eight weeks per session, and continues building for months after a course.

Most clients see best results across three to six sessions spaced four to six weeks apart. For scar revision, more sessions may be recommended. Maintenance every three to six months keeps results building over time.

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About Microneedling Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare and Comfort Safety and Suitability

### What is microneedling?

Microneedling is a medical aesthetic treatment that uses fine needles to create controlled micro-channels in the skin, triggering the body’s natural collagen and elastin response. It is one of the most established skin renewal treatments in aesthetic medicine.

### How does microneedling work?

The micro-channels created by the device prompt the skin to repair itself, producing new collagen, new elastin, and renewed cellular activity in the treated area. Over a series of sessions, this rebuilds the structure of the skin and softens scars, lines, and texture.

### What is RF microneedling?

Radiofrequency (RF) microneedling combines the mechanical micro-channels of traditional microneedling with controlled heat energy delivered at depth. This stimulates a stronger collagen response and adds tightening, making it particularly effective for laxity and deeper textural concerns.

### What’s the difference between microneedling and RF microneedling?

Traditional microneedling stimulates collagen through mechanical micro-injury alone. RF microneedling adds heat at depth, which triggers a stronger remodeling response and adds skin tightening. RF is typically chosen for deeper concerns and laxity. Traditional microneedling is excellent for surface texture, fine lines, and earlier-stage scarring. Your provider will recommend the right option at your You Review.

### Is microneedling the same as a derma roller?

No. At-home derma rollers use shorter, less precise needles and do not penetrate to the depth required to stimulate meaningful collagen change. Medical-grade microneedling uses precisely controlled depth and motorized needle cartridges in a sterile clinical environment. The results are not comparable.

### What concerns does microneedling treat?

Microneedling is effective for acne scars, enlarged pores, fine lines, uneven texture, early laxity, surgical and injury scars, stretch marks, and some pigmentation. Your provider will confirm what’s right for your specific concerns at your You Review.

### Do I need a consultation before microneedling?

Yes. Every OrangeTwist microneedling client starts with a complimentary You Review. Your provider will examine your skin, discuss your concerns, and recommend the right platform and session count before anything is booked.

### What should I tell my provider?

Let your provider know about any retinoids or active skincare you currently use, history of cold sores, recent sun exposure, active acne, or any medications. These can affect timing and protocol.

### How much does microneedling cost at OrangeTwist?

Pricing depends on the platform (traditional or RF), the area treated, and the package size. Microneedling is most effective as a course, so OrangeTwist prices packages of sessions. Your provider will walk through exact pricing at your You Review. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing benefits.

### How long does a microneedling session take?

Allow 60 to 90 minutes for your full appointment. This includes 20 to 30 minutes for numbing cream to take effect, 20 to 45 minutes for the treatment pass, and a few minutes for post-treatment soothing serums.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most clients see best results across three to six sessions, spaced four to six weeks apart. For scar revision, more sessions may be recommended. Your provider will confirm at your You Review.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from microneedling?

You will see initial surface smoothness and glow within a week of your first session. The deeper collagen response takes longer, typically four to eight weeks per session, and continues building for several months after the full course.

### How long do microneedling results last?

Collagen rebuilt through microneedling is real, structural change in the skin. Results last for years, though aging and lifestyle (sun, smoking) continue to act on the skin. Maintenance sessions every three to six months keep results building over time.

### Does microneedling work for acne scars?

Yes. Microneedling is one of the most effective non-surgical treatments for atrophic acne scars (boxcar, rolling, and shallow ice pick). Deeper or more textured scars may benefit from RF microneedling, which delivers stronger remodeling. Your provider will recommend the right protocol at your You Review.

### Does microneedling tighten the skin?

Traditional microneedling firms and refines the skin over time as new collagen builds. RF microneedling delivers more direct tightening because the heat energy contracts existing collagen and stimulates new collagen at depth. For visible tightening, RF is usually the better option.

### Does microneedling hurt?

With proper numbing cream, most clients find microneedling manageable. The sensation is spicy, more on bonier areas like the forehead, and easier on the cheeks. RF microneedling adds some heat. Numbing handles most of it, and most clients describe the discomfort as brief and contained.

### What is the downtime after microneedling?

Expect 24 to 48 hours of redness similar to a mild sunburn. Some clients see light flaking or dryness around days three to five. Most clients return to work the next day, often using a tinted SPF or mineral makeup to cover residual pinkness.

### What should I avoid after microneedling?

For the first 48 hours: avoid makeup, retinoids, exfoliants, intense workouts, saunas, and direct sun. Avoid active skincare ingredients (glycolic, salicylic, vitamin C) for five days. Apply SPF 30 or higher daily for the duration of your course.

### When can I wear makeup after microneedling?

Wait 24 to 48 hours before applying makeup. When you do, use clean brushes and gentle, non-comedogenic formulas. Your provider will recommend post-treatment skincare to extend your results.

### Is microneedling safe?

Yes. Medical-grade microneedling has a strong safety record and decades of clinical use. At OrangeTwist, every session is performed by a licensed provider trained on our specific device platform.

### Who should not have microneedling?

Microneedling is not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have active acne, eczema, or psoriasis in the treatment area, have an active cold sore outbreak, have a bleeding disorder or are on certain blood thinners, have used isotretinoin (Accutane) in the past six months, or have a history of keloid scarring. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### Is microneedling safe for darker skin tones?

Yes. Microneedling does not use light or heat to target pigment, which is why it is one of the safest skin renewal treatments for darker skin tones. RF microneedling is also generally well-tolerated, though your provider will use a tailored protocol to minimize any risk of post-inflammatory pigmentation.

### Are there any side effects?

The most common side effects are redness, mild swelling, and slight flaking, all of which resolve within a few days. Rare side effects include bruising, prolonged redness, or post-inflammatory pigmentation, particularly when aftercare guidance is not followed.

### Can I have microneedling if I have rosacea?

In some cases, yes, but the protocol needs adjustment and rosacea must not be in an active flare. Your provider will assess the skin at your You Review and recommend an approach that works for your specific case.

## Built by you, gradually

Sculptra is a different category of injectable from traditional [fillers](https://orangetwist.com/treatments/dermal-fillers/). It does not add volume directly. Instead, it triggers your own body to produce new collagen over the weeks and months after treatment. The visible improvement is built by your own tissue. The result is firmer, smoother, more supported skin that lasts significantly longer than HA fillers.

-   Stimulates your own collagen
-   Long-lasting structural change
-   Works with your face

## What is Sculptra and how does it work?

Sculptra is an FDA-approved injectable made from [poly-L-lactic acid,](https://www.sculptrausa.com) a biodegradable substance used in medical applications for decades, including dissolvable sutures. When injected, the Sculptra microparticles trigger your skin’s own collagen-producing cells to ramp up production in the treatment area. Over the weeks and months that follow, your own collagen rebuilds the structural support of your skin.

Sculptra is FDA-approved for restoring volume loss in the cheeks and for moderate to deep facial wrinkles, with broader off-label clinical use across the midface, jawline, and temples. Some providers also use Sculptra for body indications including the decolletage, buttocks, and knees, where the goal is broader skin quality and laxity correction rather than localized volume.

Because the visible result comes from your own collagen, Sculptra treatments tend to look and feel particularly natural. The skin does not appear filled. It appears restored. The trade-off is timeline: where hyaluronic acid filler delivers immediate volume, Sculptra builds gradually. Results unfold over three to six months and last around two years on average.

## What’s next?

Avoid blood-thinning medications like ibuprofen, aspirin, fish oil, and vitamin E for a few days before your appointment where possible. Skip alcohol for 24 hours beforehand. Eat beforehand. Hydrate well in the days leading up. Come in with a clean face.

## Your Sculptra Treatment

Your provider will mark the injection points and apply topical numbing. The product is injected in small amounts across the treatment area. Most clients describe the sensation as a manageable spicy. Treatment takes 30 to 45 minutes.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201080%20720'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Sculptra Aftercare with our team

Sculptra requires specific post-treatment massage at home for several days after treatment, typically five times a day for five days. This helps the product disperse evenly and is a non-negotiable part of the protocol. Your provider will demonstrate the technique before you leave. Avoid strenuous exercise and heat exposure for 24 hours. Mild swelling, redness, or bruising is normal and settles over the following days.

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About Sculptra Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare Safety

### What is Sculptra?

Sculptra is an FDA-approved injectable made from poly-L-lactic acid, a biodegradable substance used in medical applications for decades. Unlike traditional fillers that add immediate volume, Sculptra triggers your own body to produce new collagen over the weeks and months after treatment.

### How does Sculptra work?

When injected, Sculptra microparticles trigger your skin’s own collagen-producing cells to ramp up production in the treatment area. Over the following months, your own collagen rebuilds the structural support of your skin. The visible result is built by your own tissue, not by the product itself.

### Is Sculptra a filler?

Sculptra is technically a collagen stimulator (also called a biostimulator), not a traditional filler. While both are injectables, they work very differently. Fillers add immediate volume. Sculptra triggers your body to add volume gradually over months.

### What is the difference between Sculptra and HA fillers?

HA fillers add immediate volume that lasts six to 18 months and can be reversed with hyaluronidase. Sculptra triggers your own collagen production. Results build gradually over months and last around two years on average, but they are not reversible the same way. Many clients use both.

### What areas can Sculptra treat?

Sculptra is FDA-approved for cheek volume loss and moderate to deep facial wrinkles. Off-label clinical use includes jawline, temples, marionette lines, decolletage, and broader body indications like buttocks, knees, and arms for skin quality and laxity. Your provider will discuss what is appropriate at your You Review.

### Is Sculptra reversible?

Not in the same way HA fillers can be reversed. Sculptra is designed to integrate with the tissue and stimulate your own collagen, so dissolution is not straightforward. This is one reason proper consultation, conservative dosing, and experienced injectors matter so much.

### Do I need a consultation before Sculptra?

Yes. Sculptra is a structured course with a different timeline from HA fillers, so a thorough consultation is essential. Every OrangeTwist client starts with a complimentary You Review where your provider will assess your goals and design a protocol.

### Am I a good candidate for Sculptra?

Good candidates are clients with mild to moderate volume loss, early skin laxity, or those wanting longer-lasting alternatives to HA fillers. Sculptra is not typically the right choice for delicate areas like the lips or under-eyes. Your provider will assess and recommend honestly at your You Review.

### What should I tell my provider?

Let your provider know about any autoimmune conditions, previous biostimulator treatments, current medications, blood thinners, allergies, and skin conditions. History of keloid scarring or active inflammation in the treatment area is particularly important.

### How much does Sculptra cost at OrangeTwist?

Sculptra is priced by vial. Most clients need a course of two to three sessions to reach their initial goal. Your provider will walk through exact pricing for the full course at your You Review. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing benefits.

### How long does a Sculptra session take?

Most sessions take 30 to 45 minutes. Allow additional time for topical numbing to take effect. If combining your You Review with treatment, allow around 90 minutes.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most clients need two to three sessions, spaced four to six weeks apart, to reach their initial goal. An annual maintenance session keeps results building over time.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from Sculptra?

Initial swelling after Sculptra masks the final outcome for the first one to two weeks. You will see meaningful change at four to six weeks, with continued improvement over three to six months as collagen production continues.

### How long do Sculptra results last?

Around two years on average. Annual maintenance sessions keep results building over time.

### Will I look fuller right after treatment?

You may look slightly fuller immediately after treatment due to the diluent used during injection. This settles within a few days, and the visible result comes from the new collagen that builds underneath over the following weeks.

### Can Sculptra be combined with other treatments?

Yes. Sculptra combines particularly well with HA fillers (for immediate volume in delicate areas), RF microneedling (for surface texture), and Botox (for expression lines). Your provider will design a treatment sequence at your You Review.

### Do I need to massage after Sculptra?

Yes. Sculptra requires specific post-treatment massage at home, typically five times a day for five days. This helps the product disperse evenly and prevents the formation of nodules. Your provider will demonstrate the technique before you leave the Treatment Shop.

### What should I avoid after Sculptra?

For the first 24 to 48 hours: avoid strenuous exercise, saunas, and hot environments; skip alcohol; avoid pressure on the treated areas (other than the prescribed massage); hold off on other facial treatments for two weeks.

### How long will swelling and bruising last?

Mild swelling typically settles within a few days. Bruising, when it occurs, usually fades within a week.

### When can I wear makeup?

Wait at least 24 hours before applying makeup to treated areas. Apply gently. Continue the prescribed Sculptra massage protocol as directed.

### Is Sculptra safe?

Yes. Sculptra has a strong clinical safety record and has been FDA-approved since 2004. Poly-L-lactic acid has been used in medical applications, including dissolvable sutures, for decades.

### Who should not have Sculptra?

Sculptra is generally not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have an active skin infection in the treatment area, have certain autoimmune conditions, have a history of keloid scarring, or have a known allergy to any product ingredients. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### What are the side effects?

Common side effects include temporary swelling, bruising, redness, and tenderness at the injection sites, all of which resolve within days. The most notable risk specific to Sculptra is nodule formation, which is why proper injection technique and the post-treatment massage protocol matter so much. Your provider will walk through risks at your You Review.

### Is Sculptra safe for darker skin tones?

Yes. Sculptra works independently of skin tone. The treatment principle (stimulating your own collagen) is the same across all skin types. Treatment technique is tailored to facial anatomy, not pigmentation.

### How do I know my provider is qualified?

Sculptra is an advanced injectable category that requires deeper anatomical knowledge and more experience than HA fillers. At OrangeTwist, every Sculptra treatment is performed by a licensed provider with specific advanced injector training, supervised by our Medical Advisory Board.

## Firmer skin for jowls, lines, and early sagging.

Most treatments stop at the surface. ZenTite does not. By pairing microneedling with controlled radiofrequency heat, it firms and lifts at the level where collagen and elastin actually live, then puts your skin to work rebuilding its own structure over the months that follow. Translation: firmer skin you get to keep, not a weekend’s worth of glow.

-   Lifts, firms, and tightens
-   Softens scars and pores
-   Safe for every skin tone

Real Zentite results

## ZenTite Before & Afters

Most clients see their best results across a course of three sessions, spaced four to six weeks apart, with an annual maintenance session to keep things building. Results last one to two years for most people, with lifestyle and the natural aging process continuing to do their thing in the background.

### Get results that tighten and lift with Zentite

ZenTite is a progressive treatment, you will notice early smoothness and a little tightening within the first few weeks.

The meaningful change, the firmer, lifted, more refined skin, builds over three to six months as new collagen and elastin develop. The full effect of a course typically shows up around the four to six month mark.

### What is ZenTite and how does it work?

ZenTite is OrangeTwist’s radiofrequency microneedling treatment, built on the ZenTite system by [Boston Aesthetics](https://bostonaesthetics.com/products/professional-use/zentite/). It pairs microneedling with controlled radiofrequency heat: the needles create tiny channels that trigger your skin’s natural collagen response, while the heat travels through those channels into the deeper layers to tighten the skin you already have and build new collagen and elastin over time.

That heat is the whole point, and it is what separates ZenTite from traditional [microneedling](https://orangetwist.com/dictionary/microneedling/) like our SkinPen treatment. SkinPen works mostly at the surface, which is brilliant for texture, glow, and shallow marks. ZenTite reaches deeper, so it is the one your provider reaches for when the goal is firmer skin, a sharper jawline, deeper scars, or laxity that surface treatments simply cannot get to.

What sets ZenTite apart from older radiofrequency (RF) microneedling devices is how it is engineered. A smart motor sets needle placement precisely and evenly, the energy adjusts itself in real time as it reads your skin, and treatment can be tailored layer by layer across different areas of the face in a single pass. The result is a faster, more even, and genuinely more comfortable treatment than tradtional RF microneedling.

[Book Now](https://orangetwist.com/book-now/)

## ZenTite vs SkinPen Microneedling: how they compare

Both build collagen. They just work at different depths, for different jobs.

Both treatments use fine needles to create controlled micro-injuries that kickstart your skin’s natural collagen and elastin production, but they work at different depths and intensities. Traditional microneedling with the [SkinPen](https://orangetwist.com/treatments/skinpen/) relies purely on those mechanical micro-channels at the skin’s surface, making it a great entry point for smoothing texture, softening fine lines, and brightening overall tone with minimal downtime. ZenTite RF microneedling adds radiofrequency energy delivered through the needle tips, heating the deeper layers of the skin to drive more significant tightening and remodeling.

Your provider will tell you which one your skin is actually asking for at your [You Review.](/book-now)

Designed for tricky areas

## ZenTite is great treatment for the eye area including fine lines, dark circles, puffiness, and tired-looking eyes.

The skin around your eyes is the thinnest on your face, the first to crease, and the hardest for most treatments to handle safely. ZenTite is built for it. The insulated needle design and precise, adjustable placement let your provider treat right up to the lash line, far closer to the eye than most energy treatments can safely reach, so the delicate skin closest to your eyes is not left untreated. That means smoother fine lines and crow’s feet, firmer eyelid skin, and softer puffiness and bags, for eyes that look more rested, lifted, and less tired. On dark circles, the honest answer is it depends on the cause.

If your circles are really shadows cast by loose, tired-looking skin, ZenTite can help by firming and smoothing that skin so the area looks brighter and more awake. If your circles come from pigment or visible blood vessels, those need a different approach, and your provider may pair ZenTite with brightening skincare or a targeted treatment. We will tell you honestly which kind you have at your You Review, rather than promising something a single treatment cannot do.

## Your Treatment Timeline

![mckinney-groupshot](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%202560%201707'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

### Where every ZenTite journey starts.

Your provider examines your skin, listens to your goals, and tells you honestly whether ZenTite is the right tool, or whether traditional microneedling or a combination approach suits you better. You will walk through a realistic course and transparent pricing before anything is booked.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20933'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

### A few simple steps beforehand.

Stop retinoids and active exfoliants for five to seven days before your session. Avoid sun exposure and self-tanner for two weeks beforehand. Let your provider know about any cold sore history, recent breakouts, or isotretinoin use within the past six months. Arrive with a clean, product-free face.

![orangetwist-mckinney-exterior](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201053%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

### What the appointment feels like.

Your provider applies a numbing cream and lets it settle, then makes the treatment pass. Thanks to the smart motor and insulated needle design, the actual pass is fast, often 15 to 20 minutes for a full face, and noticeably more comfortable than older radiofrequency microneedling. You will feel warmth and a light prickle, not the white-knuckle experience the treatment used to have a reputation for.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201120%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

### How to recover well.

Expect redness similar to a mild to moderate sunburn for one to three days, sometimes with a little swelling or pinpoint marks where the needles passed. Most clients are back to normal within a day or two, with mineral makeup fine after 24 hours. Skip retinoids, exfoliants, and direct sun for several days. Your provider will give you a specific routine and the right post-treatment products to support the rebuild.

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

Everything clients want to know before booking ZenTite, our radiofrequency microneedling treatment, from how it feels to how long the results last. Anything we have not covered, your provider will walk you through at your complimentary You Review.

About ZenTite Candidacy and Safety Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare and Comfort

### What is ZenTite?

ZenTite is OrangeTwist’s radiofrequency microneedling treatment, built on the ZenTite system from Boston Aesthetics. It combines microneedling with radiofrequency heat to tighten skin, soften scars, refine pores, and rebuild collagen and elastin in the deeper layers.

### How is ZenTite different from regular microneedling?

Traditional microneedling, like our SkinPen treatment, works mostly at the surface, which is great for texture and glow. ZenTite adds radiofrequency heat at depth, which is what delivers real tightening and a stronger response for deeper scars and laxity. Short version: SkinPen refreshes, ZenTite reconstructs.

### Is ZenTite new?

ZenTite is one of the newer radiofrequency microneedling platforms, engineered with a smart motor for precise needling, energy that adjusts to your skin in real time, and multi-layer treatment in a single pass. OrangeTwist is among the first to bring it to clients.

### Is ZenTite the same as Morpheus8 or Vivace?

They are all radiofrequency microneedling, in the same family. ZenTite is the specific system OrangeTwist uses. It is engineered for precise, even needle placement and energy that adjusts to your skin in real time, which makes for a faster and more comfortable treatment.

### Am I a good candidate for ZenTite?

Good candidates want firmer skin, smoother texture, softer scars, or non-surgical tightening, and have realistic expectations about gradual, building results. Every OrangeTwist client starts with a complimentary You Review, where your provider confirms whether ZenTite is the right tool for your goals.

### Who should not have ZenTite?

ZenTite is not suitable if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have a pacemaker or implanted electrical device, an active skin infection in the area, a bleeding disorder, or are on certain medications. Your provider will review your full history at your You Review.

### What should I tell my provider?

Let your provider know about any retinoids or active skincare you use, history of cold sores, recent sun exposure, active acne, isotretinoin use within the past six months, any implanted electrical devices, any medications, and whether you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

### Is ZenTite safe for darker skin tones?

Yes. Radiofrequency microneedling does not target pigment, which makes it one of the safer collagen-building and tightening treatments for darker skin tones. Your provider will use a tailored protocol where needed.

### How much does ZenTite cost at OrangeTwist?

ZenTite starts from $470 and scales by treatment area and series, from focused eye sessions up to full Face, Neck, and Décolleté combinations. TwistUp members pay less on every visit. You can see the full menu and member pricing on our pricing page, or get exact numbers for your plan at your complimentary You Review.

### How long does a ZenTite session take?

Allow 45 to 75 minutes for your appointment. That includes numbing time and the treatment pass itself, which is fast, often 15 to 20 minutes for a full face.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most clients see their best results across a course of three sessions, spaced four to six weeks apart, with an annual maintenance session afterward. Deeper scarring or more significant laxity may call for additional sessions. Your provider confirms a realistic plan at your You Review.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from ZenTite?

You will notice early smoothness and mild tightening within the first few weeks. The deeper structural improvement builds over three to six months as new collagen and elastin develop. The full effect of a course typically shows around the four to six month mark.

### How long do ZenTite results last?

Results last one to two years for most clients. An annual maintenance session keeps them consistent. Lifestyle factors and the natural aging process continue to act on the skin, which is why maintenance delivers the most reliable outcome over time.

### Does ZenTite actually tighten the skin?

Yes, and this is where it separates from standard microneedling. The radiofrequency heat contracts existing collagen and stimulates new collagen at depth, which delivers visible tightening over time. For more advanced laxity, ZenTite combines well with biostimulators like Sculptra.

### Does ZenTite work for acne scars?

Yes, particularly for deeper or more textured scars that surface microneedling cannot fully address. The combined needling and heat approach delivers a stronger remodeling response in the lower layers, where scar tissue lives.

### Is ZenTite worth it?

If your goal is firmer, tighter, smoother skin without surgery or real downtime, most clients find a ZenTite course well worth it, especially for laxity and scarring that creams and surface treatments cannot reach. It is a progressive treatment, so the payoff builds over months rather than overnight, and it lasts one to two years with maintenance.

### Does ZenTite hurt?

With numbing cream, most clients find ZenTite very manageable. It is engineered to be more comfortable than older radiofrequency microneedling, thanks to precise needle placement and energy that adjusts to your skin. You will feel warmth and a light prickle, not the white-knuckle experience the treatment used to be known for.

### What is the downtime?

Expect redness like a mild to moderate sunburn for one to three days, sometimes with light swelling or pinpoint marks. Most clients are back to normal within a day or two, with mineral makeup fine after 24 hours.

### What should I avoid after treatment?

Skip retinoids, exfoliants, and makeup for the first day or so, and avoid direct sun for several days. Your provider will give you a specific routine and the right post-treatment products to support your skin while it rebuilds.

## A More Sculpted You Starts with CoolSculpting Elite

Some areas of fat do not respond to diet or exercise, no matter how consistent you are. CoolSculpting Elite freezes and eliminates those fat cells in a single, comfortable session. The treated cells leave the body permanently and do not grow back.

-   Targets stubborn pinchable fat
-   FDA-cleared and non-surgical
-   Permanent fat cell removal

## What is body contouring and how does CoolSculpting Elite work?

Body contouring covers a range of non-surgical treatments designed to reshape areas of the body that diet and exercise alone cannot reach. At OrangeTwist, the lead device for non-surgical fat reduction is CoolSculpting Elite, the latest generation of the FDA-cleared cryolipolysis system from Allergan Aesthetics.

Cryolipolysis works on a simple principle: fat cells freeze at a higher temperature than the surrounding skin and tissue. CoolSculpting Elite uses precisely calibrated cooling applicators to chill the fat in the treatment area to the temperature where the cells are damaged beyond repair, without harming anything around them. The damaged cells are then cleared naturally by the body over the following weeks and months.

The key word is permanent. Fat cells that are eliminated do not regenerate. Existing fat cells in untreated areas can still expand or shrink with weight changes, which is why CoolSculpting Elite is positioned as a contouring tool, not a weight loss method. It works best for clients who are at or near a stable weight and want to address specific, pinchable areas.

Prep 101

## Your Treatment Timeline

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## You Review

Your provider will examine the areas you want to address, confirm what is pinchable and treatable with CoolSculpting Elite, and map out a realistic treatment plan. Most areas need one or two sessions, with results building over three months. They will walk through pricing transparently before anything is booked.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Onboarding

There is very little to do beforehand. Wear comfortable clothing that allows access to the treatment area. Eat beforehand. Hydrate. Avoid blood-thinning medications like ibuprofen and aspirin for a few days where possible to minimize the risk of bruising.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Ongoing Care

Your provider will apply a gel pad and the CoolSculpting Elite applicator to the treatment area. The applicator suctions the tissue and begins cooling. The first few minutes are spicy as the area cools, then numbs. Most clients read, scroll, or rest during the session. Each cycle takes 35 to 45 minutes. Multiple areas can be treated in the same visit using dual applicators.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20645%20645'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Maintenance and Transition

Your provider will briefly massage the treated area immediately after removal to help break up the frozen fat cells and improve results. Expect some redness, mild swelling, numbness, or tenderness in the treated area for a few hours to a few days. You can return to normal activities immediately. Some clients experience deeper tissue tenderness that can last one to three weeks, which is normal and resolves on its own.

## The fat cells left. They are not coming back.

Results build gradually. You will start to notice change at three to four weeks as your body clears the damaged fat cells. The most dramatic improvement typically shows at 12 weeks, with final results visible by 16 weeks. Most clients see a 20 to 25 percent reduction in fat thickness in the treated area after one session, with additional sessions adding further reduction.

## Because the treated fat cells leave the body permanently, results are long-lasting.

Maintaining a stable weight keeps the treated area looking the way it does post-treatment. Significant weight gain can affect untreated fat cells in surrounding areas, which is why CoolSculpting Elite is positioned as one part of a broader contouring approach, not a replacement for healthy lifestyle habits.
