## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About Body Contouring and CoolSculpting Elite Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare and Comfort Safety and Suitability

### What is body contouring?

Body contouring is the category of non-surgical treatments designed to reshape areas of the body that diet and exercise alone cannot reach. It includes fat reduction, muscle building, and skin tightening technologies. At OrangeTwist, CoolSculpting Elite is the lead device for non-surgical fat reduction.

### What is CoolSculpting Elite?

CoolSculpting Elite is the FDA-cleared cryolipolysis (fat freezing) system from Allergan Aesthetics. It uses precisely calibrated cooling to permanently eliminate fat cells in pinchable areas of the body, without surgery, needles, or downtime.

### How is CoolSculpting Elite different from original CoolSculpting?

CoolSculpting Elite is the latest generation of the platform. It features dual applicators (so two areas can be treated at once), refined cooling that is more efficient, and a wider range of treatment areas. Not all clinics have upgraded, which is worth checking anywhere you book.

### How does CoolSculpting Elite work?

Fat cells freeze at a higher temperature than the surrounding skin and tissue. CoolSculpting Elite uses cooling applicators to chill the fat in the treatment area to the temperature where the cells are damaged beyond repair, without harming anything around them. The damaged cells are then cleared naturally by the body over the following weeks and months.

### Is CoolSculpting Elite a weight loss treatment?

No. CoolSculpting Elite is a body contouring treatment, not a weight loss method. It works best for clients who are at or near a stable weight and want to address specific, pinchable areas that diet and exercise have not changed. If significant weight loss is your goal, your provider may recommend exploring TwistOff (medical weight loss) first.

### What areas can CoolSculpting Elite treat?

CoolSculpting Elite is FDA-cleared for nine distinct areas: abdomen, flanks (love handles), inner thighs, outer thighs, banana roll (under buttocks), upper arms, back, bra fat, and submental area (under the chin). Your provider will assess what is treatable at your You Review.

### Do I need a consultation before CoolSculpting Elite?

Yes. Every body contouring client starts with a complimentary You Review. Your provider will examine the areas you want to address, confirm what is pinchable and treatable, and walk through a realistic treatment plan and pricing before anything is booked.

### Am I a good candidate for CoolSculpting Elite?

Good candidates are clients at or near a stable weight with specific, pinchable areas of fat that have not responded to diet and exercise. CoolSculpting Elite is not suitable for clients with very small amounts of fat to treat, very loose skin in the area, or those looking for significant weight loss. Your provider will assess honestly at your You Review.

### What should I tell my provider?

Let your provider know about any cold sensitivity conditions (cold urticaria, Raynaud’s), recent weight changes, previous body contouring treatments, pregnancy or planned pregnancy, and any medications. The more your provider knows, the better the plan.

### How much does CoolSculpting Elite cost at OrangeTwist?

Pricing depends on the number of areas treated, the number of cycles per area, and the package. Most clients treat multiple areas, often in the same visit. Your provider will walk through exact pricing at your You Review. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing on all body contouring packages.

### How long does a CoolSculpting Elite session take?

Each cycle takes 35 to 45 minutes. Most clients treat one to three areas in a single visit. With dual applicators on CoolSculpting Elite, two areas can be treated simultaneously, which can cut total appointment time significantly. Allow 60 to 120 minutes for a typical visit.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most areas show meaningful improvement after one session. Some clients add a second session to the same area for further reduction. Your provider will recommend a realistic plan based on the amount of fat in the area, your goals, and how your body responds at your You Review.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from CoolSculpting Elite?

You will start to notice change at three to four weeks as your body begins clearing the damaged fat cells. The most dramatic improvement typically shows at 12 weeks. Final results are visible by 16 weeks. Patience is part of the process.

### How much fat will be reduced?

Clinical studies show an average 20 to 25 percent reduction in fat thickness in the treated area after one session. Individual results vary based on the area, the starting fat thickness, and how your body responds. Your provider will set realistic expectations for your specific case at your You Review.

### Are the results permanent?

Yes. Fat cells that are eliminated by CoolSculpting Elite do not regenerate. The remaining fat cells in the treated area and untreated areas can still expand or shrink with weight changes, which is why maintaining a stable weight is recommended to preserve your results.

### Will the fat come back somewhere else?

Treated fat cells are gone permanently. If you gain weight after treatment, your body distributes that weight across the existing fat cells, both in untreated areas and in the cells that remain in treated areas. Some clients perceive this as fat redistributing, though clinically the treated area still has fewer fat cells than before.

### Can I treat the same area more than once?

Yes. Many clients return for a second treatment in the same area for further reduction. Your provider will typically recommend waiting at least eight to 12 weeks between sessions in the same area to allow the first session’s results to fully develop.

### Does CoolSculpting Elite hurt?

The first few minutes of each cycle are spicy as the applicator pulls the tissue and the cooling begins. The cold sensation builds, then numbs the area, and most clients find the rest of the cycle very tolerable. Many clients read, scroll, or even nap. The post-treatment massage is the most intense moment, lasting a couple of minutes.

### What is the downtime after CoolSculpting Elite?

Most clients return to normal activities immediately. Expect redness, mild swelling, numbness, or tenderness in the treated area for a few hours to a few days. Some clients experience deeper tissue tenderness, itching, or sensitivity for one to three weeks, particularly in larger treatment areas.

### Can I exercise after CoolSculpting Elite?

Light activity is fine immediately. Most clients return to their normal exercise routine within 24 to 48 hours. Listen to your body. Tenderness or sensitivity will let you know if you are pushing too hard too soon.

### What should I do to support my results?

Maintain a stable weight. Stay hydrated, as your body clears the damaged fat cells through normal metabolic processes. There is no special diet or supplement required. Some clients find the post-treatment massage technique your provider demonstrates helps maximize results.

### Is CoolSculpting Elite safe?

Yes. CoolSculpting has been FDA-cleared since 2010, with millions of treatments performed worldwide. CoolSculpting Elite has refined the technology further. At OrangeTwist, every session is performed by a licensed provider trained on the device.

### Who should not have CoolSculpting Elite?

CoolSculpting Elite is not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have cold sensitivity conditions (cold urticaria, paroxysmal cold hemoglobinuria, cryoglobulinemia, Raynaud’s), have a hernia in or near the treatment area, have very loose skin in the treatment area, or are seeking significant weight loss rather than spot fat reduction. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### What are the side effects of CoolSculpting Elite?

Common side effects include redness, swelling, bruising, numbness, tenderness, itching, and skin sensitivity in the treated area. These typically resolve within days to weeks. A rare side effect called paradoxical adipose hyperplasia (PAH), where treated fat cells enlarge instead of shrink, occurs in a very small percentage of treatments. Your provider will walk through risks at your You Review.

### Is CoolSculpting Elite safe for all skin tones?

Yes. CoolSculpting Elite works on fat cells, not skin pigment, and is safe across all skin types and tones.

### How do I know my provider is qualified?

All CoolSculpting Elite treatments at OrangeTwist are performed by licensed professionals with specific training on the device platform and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board. To find out more about the team at your nearest Treatment Shop, visit your local center page or get in touch directly.

## Light Does the Heavy Lifting

Light-based treatments work below the surface to target the pigment, redness, and texture issues that topical skincare alone cannot reach. Whether your concern is sun spots, visible capillaries, or uneven skin tone, your provider will recommend the right wavelength for the job.

-   Targets sun damage and pigment
-   Calms redness and capillaries
-   Smoother, more even tone

## What are laser and IPL treatments and how do they work?

Laser and IPL (intense pulsed light) treatments deliver controlled light energy into the skin. The light is absorbed selectively by pigment (melanin) or oxygenated blood (in vascular concerns), then converted to heat that breaks down the target without damaging surrounding tissue. The body clears the debris naturally over the following days and weeks.

Different light technologies are designed for different jobs. IPL and BBL (BroadBand Light) use a range of wavelengths well-suited to surface pigmentation and redness. Q-switched and picosecond lasers target deeper pigment with shorter, more precise pulses. Fractional resurfacing lasers create controlled micro-channels in the skin to trigger collagen remodeling for texture and fine lines.

At OrangeTwist, your provider will assess your skin tone, your specific concern, and your downtime tolerance, then recommend the right platform. Some concerns benefit from a single technology over a course. Others benefit from a combination across multiple sessions.

## Your Treatment Timeline

![Concern Treatment 16](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20933%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## You Review

Your provider will assess your skin tone, examine the concern you want to address, and recommend the right light-based platform and session count. They will walk through realistic timing, pricing, and downtime expectations before anything is booked.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Onboarding

Avoid sun exposure and self-tanner for two to four weeks before your session. Stop retinoids and active exfoliants five to seven days before. Let your provider know about any photosensitizing medications or recent cosmetic treatments. Come in with a clean face and no makeup.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20933%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Ongoing Care

Your provider will apply a cool gel or chilled tip, then pass the device handpiece over the treatment area. Each pulse feels like a quick warm snap, at the spicier end of the menu for IPL and BBL, more intense for fractional resurfacing. Topical numbing is available for sensitive areas and stronger treatments.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201920%202560'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Maintenance and Transition

Expect redness and warmth similar to mild sunburn for a few hours to a few days, depending on the treatment. Pigmented spots may darken and flake off naturally over the following week. Apply SPF 30 or higher every day. Avoid hot showers, saunas, and direct sun for 48 hours. Your provider will share specific aftercare for your device and treatment.

## Cleaner tone, treatment by treatment.

Most laser and IPL treatments deliver visible improvement after a single session, with best results building across a course. Pigmentation typically darkens before flaking away within seven to 10 days, revealing clearer skin underneath. Vascular concerns fade gradually as treated capillaries are reabsorbed.

A typical course runs four to six sessions, spaced three to four weeks apart. Results last six to 12 months on average, with annual maintenance recommended for sustained improvement. Sun protection between sessions is essential. Without it, results undo themselves.

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About Laser and IPL Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare and Comfort Safety and Suitability

### What is the difference between laser and IPL?

Laser uses a single, focused wavelength of light. IPL (intense pulsed light) uses a broader range of wavelengths in each pulse. Lasers are typically used for more targeted or deeper concerns. IPL is well-suited to surface pigmentation, redness, and general tone correction. Your provider will recommend the right one for your concern.

### What is BBL?

BBL (BroadBand Light) is a brand of IPL technology made by Sciton. It is one of the most established and widely used IPL platforms in aesthetic medicine. The treatment principle is the same as standard IPL with a refined delivery system.

### What is laser skin resurfacing?

Laser skin resurfacing uses fractional or ablative laser technology to create controlled micro-channels in the skin. The body responds by producing new collagen and replacing damaged surface tissue. It is one of the most effective treatments for textural concerns, acne scars, and fine lines, with more downtime than IPL.

### What is a photofacial?

Photofacial is a common term for an IPL or BBL treatment focused on the face. The treatment uses pulsed light to address sun damage, pigmentation, redness, and general tone correction in a single session, with minimal downtime.

### What concerns can laser and IPL treat?

Common concerns include sun damage, freckles and age spots, melasma, rosacea and redness, broken capillaries, uneven skin tone, dullness, fine lines, and certain types of acne scarring. Your provider will assess which technology suits your specific concern at your You Review.

### Does IPL work on melasma?

IPL can help with some forms of melasma but is not universally suitable. Melasma can sometimes worsen with light-based treatment, particularly in darker skin tones. Your provider will assess your specific case carefully and may recommend topical or alternative approaches first.

### Do I need a consultation before laser or IPL?

Yes. Light-based treatments are calibrated to your skin tone and specific concern, which means a thorough assessment is essential. Every OrangeTwist client starts with a complimentary You Review.

### What should I tell my provider?

Let your provider know about any photosensitizing medications (including antibiotics, retinoids, isotretinoin), recent sun exposure, current skincare routine, history of cold sores or rosacea flares, pigmentation conditions, and any previous laser or IPL treatments.

### Will my skin tone affect my treatment options?

Yes. Some older laser and IPL platforms are not safe for darker skin tones. Modern devices and protocols can safely treat a wider range of skin tones, but the technology and settings have to be carefully matched. Your provider will assess your specific phototype at your You Review and recommend only what is safe for your skin.

### How much do laser and IPL treatments cost?

Pricing depends on the device, the area treated, and the number of sessions. Because light-based treatments deliver best results across a course, OrangeTwist prices packages of sessions. Your provider will walk through exact pricing at your You Review.

### How long does a session take?

Most IPL and BBL sessions take 20 to 30 minutes. Fractional resurfacing or larger treatment areas can take up to 60 minutes. Topical numbing adds an additional 20 to 30 minutes when used.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most concerns benefit from a course of four to six sessions, spaced three to four weeks apart. Some clients see meaningful results after a single session for surface concerns. Your provider will recommend a realistic course at your You Review.

### Do TwistUp members get a discount?

Yes. TwistUp membership includes exclusive pricing on light-based treatment packages, plus TwistMode points on every session.

### When will I see results?

Some visible improvement is common after the first session, especially for surface pigmentation. Pigmented spots typically darken before flaking off within seven to 10 days. Vascular concerns fade gradually over weeks. Best results build across the full course.

### How long do results last?

Results typically last six to 12 months. Annual maintenance sessions keep improvements consistent. Sun protection between sessions and after the course is essential.

### Will my pigmentation come back?

Treated pigmentation does not regenerate, but new pigmentation can form with continued sun exposure or hormonal changes. Daily SPF 30 or higher and annual maintenance sessions are the best ways to keep results consistent.

### Does laser or IPL hurt?

Most clients describe IPL and BBL pulses as a quick warm snap, the spicier end of the menu but easily manageable. Fractional resurfacing is more intense and typically requires topical numbing. Your provider will offer numbing where appropriate and adjust pace to your comfort.

### What is the downtime after IPL or BBL?

Most clients see mild redness and warmth for a few hours after IPL or BBL. Pigmented spots may darken visibly over the following days before flaking off. Most clients return to normal activities immediately, sometimes with mineral makeup to cover residual pinkness.

### What is the downtime after laser resurfacing?

Fractional resurfacing involves more visible recovery, typically three to seven days of redness, swelling, and pinpoint scabbing as the skin renews. Your provider will walk through realistic downtime for the specific device at your You Review.

### What should I avoid after treatment?

Avoid sun exposure, hot showers, saunas, intense workouts, and active skincare ingredients (retinoids, exfoliating acids, vitamin C) for at least 48 hours. Apply SPF 30 or higher every day for the duration of your course and beyond.

### Are laser and IPL safe?

Yes, when performed by trained providers on properly calibrated devices. The most common complications come from miscalibration or use on inappropriate skin tones. OrangeTwist’s protocols include comprehensive skin assessment at every session.

### Who should not have laser or IPL?

Light-based treatments are generally not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have an active sun tan, sunburn, or recent self-tanner, are taking photosensitizing medications such as isotretinoin, have a history of keloid scarring, or have an active skin infection in the treatment area. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### Can I have IPL if I have a darker skin tone?

Some IPL platforms are not safe for darker skin tones because the device cannot distinguish well between pigment in the lesion and pigment in surrounding skin. OrangeTwist providers will assess your phototype carefully and recommend only the technology safe for your skin. If IPL is not appropriate, alternative approaches such as chemical peels, microneedling, or different laser wavelengths may be recommended.

### Are there side effects?

Common side effects include redness, mild swelling, and temporary pigmentation changes during the healing window. Rare side effects include blistering, scarring, or persistent pigment changes, which is why provider training and device calibration matter. Your provider will walk through risks specific to your treatment at your You Review.

### Can I have laser treatment in the summer?

Light-based treatments are not recommended on tanned skin or skin that will be actively sun-exposed. Many clients choose to do their course in cooler months and maintain with mineral SPF year-round. Your provider will recommend timing at your You Review.

## The Last Razor You’ll Buy

Done with the constant cycle of shaving, waxing, and growing things back? Laser hair removal disables the follicles that produce hair, gradually, over a series of sessions. Most clients see permanent reduction after six to eight visits.

-   Permanent hair reduction
-   Safe for every skin tone
-   Fast, comfortable sessions

## What is laser hair removal and how does it work?

Laser hair removal uses a focused beam of light to target the pigment in the hair follicle. The energy is absorbed by the follicle and converted to heat, which disables its ability to produce new hair. Because the laser only targets actively growing follicles, a series of treatments is needed to catch each hair at the right stage in its cycle.

OrangeTwist uses medical-grade laser technology cleared for all skin tones, including darker phototypes that older systems struggled to treat safely. Your provider will assess your skin and hair at your You Review and program the device to the right wavelength and intensity for you.

Once treated, the disabled follicles do not grow back. Some clients see a small percentage of regrowth over time, typically finer and lighter than before, and an annual maintenance session keeps results consistent.

## Your Treatment Timeline

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20933'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## You Review

Your provider will assess your skin tone, hair color, and the areas you want treated. They will walk through a realistic session schedule and pricing for the package that suits you. No pressure. Just an honest plan before anything starts.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20933'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Preparation

Shave the treatment area 24 hours before your appointment. Do not wax, pluck, or use depilatory creams in the four weeks leading up to a session, as the laser needs an intact follicle to work. Avoid sun exposure and self-tanner for two weeks before your visit.

![Frown Lines](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201052%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## The Treatment

Your provider will apply a cool gel and pass the laser handpiece over the treatment area. Each pulse feels like a quick warm snap, the spicy end of the menu, but most clients find it manageable. A small area like the upper lip takes minutes. A full leg takes around 30 to 45.

![Concern and treatments 30](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201993%201643'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Aftercare

Mild redness or slight warmth in the treated area is normal and settles within a few hours. Avoid hot showers, saunas, and direct sun for 24 hours. Apply SPF 30 or higher every day on treated areas for the duration of your course. Your provider will share full aftercare at your visit.

## Smooth happens in stages.

You will not see full results after one session. Hair grows in cycles, and the laser can only treat follicles in their active growth phase. After two or three sessions, most clients notice slower regrowth, thinner hairs, and patches that stop growing back. After the full course, typically six to eight sessions spaced four to six weeks apart, treated areas are functionally hair-free. An annual maintenance session keeps results consistent for most clients. Hormonal changes (pregnancy, menopause) can prompt some new follicles to wake up, which is why some clients return for top-ups.

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About Laser Hair Removal Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare and Comfort Safety and Suitability

### What is laser hair removal?

Laser hair removal is a medical aesthetic treatment that uses focused light energy to disable hair follicles, reducing hair growth permanently over a series of sessions. It is one of the most established and well-studied hair removal methods in cosmetic medicine.

### How does laser hair removal work?

The laser emits a wavelength of light that is absorbed by the pigment in the hair follicle. The energy converts to heat, which damages the follicle and prevents it from producing new hair. Because the laser only affects actively growing follicles, multiple sessions are needed to catch each follicle in its growth phase.

### Is laser hair removal permanent?

After a full course, most clients experience permanent hair reduction. Some clients see a small percentage of regrowth over time, typically finer and lighter. An annual maintenance session keeps results consistent for most clients.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most clients need six to eight sessions, spaced four to six weeks apart. The exact number depends on the treatment area, your hair type, and your hair growth cycle. Your provider will map out a realistic schedule at your You Review.

### Does laser hair removal work on all skin tones?

Yes. Modern laser hair removal platforms, including the device used at OrangeTwist, are cleared for all skin tones from very fair to deeply pigmented. Your provider will calibrate the wavelength and energy settings to your specific phototype at your You Review.

### Does laser hair removal work on blonde, red, or gray hair?

Laser hair removal works best on hair that contains melanin (the pigment the laser targets). Blonde, red, gray, and white hair contain little melanin and respond poorly to laser. If your hair falls into one of these categories, your provider will discuss alternatives at your You Review.

### What areas can be treated?

Almost anywhere with unwanted hair: underarms, bikini, Brazilian, legs, arms, face (lip, chin, cheeks), back, chest, stomach, and neck. Your provider will confirm the exact areas at your You Review.

### Do I need a consultation before laser hair removal?

Yes. Every OrangeTwist laser hair removal client starts with a complimentary You Review. Your provider will assess your skin tone, hair color, and the areas you want treated, then walk through a realistic plan and pricing before anything is booked.

### What happens at a You Review for laser?

Your provider will examine the treatment area, discuss any medications or skin conditions, and may perform a small test patch to confirm the device settings. They will then walk through pricing, package options, and a realistic timeline.

### What should I tell my provider?

Let your provider know about any photosensitizing medications, recent sun exposure, skin conditions, history of cold sores (for facial treatments), or pregnancy. These can all affect timing or technique.

### How much does laser hair removal cost at OrangeTwist?

Pricing depends on the treatment area, the package, and your local center. Because laser is most effective as a course, OrangeTwist prices packages of sessions rather than single visits. Your provider will walk through exact pricing at your You Review.

### How long does a session take?

A small area like the upper lip or underarms takes about 15 minutes. A full leg or back takes 30 to 45 minutes. Your provider will confirm timing for your specific package.

### Do TwistUp members get a discount on laser?

Yes. TwistUp membership includes exclusive pricing on laser hair removal packages, plus TwistMode points on every visit and Beauty Bank credit toward future treatments.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results?

You will notice slower regrowth and thinner hairs after two or three sessions. By session four or five, most clients see patches that stop growing back entirely. After the full course, treated areas are functionally hair-free.

### Will hair grow back after laser hair removal?

Follicles disabled by the laser do not grow back. Some clients see a small percentage of regrowth over time, usually finer and lighter than the original hair. Hormonal changes can prompt new follicles to wake up, which is why an annual maintenance session is recommended.

### How long do results last?

For most clients, treated follicles stay disabled long-term. An annual maintenance session is recommended to address any new follicle activity, particularly around hormonal changes such as pregnancy or menopause.

### Does laser hair removal hurt?

Most clients describe each pulse as a quick warm snap, the spicy end of the menu but easily manageable. The sensation eases as the session progresses and the device cools the skin between pulses. Topical numbing cream is available on request for sensitive areas.

### What does laser hair removal feel like?

Most clients compare it to the snap of a rubber band against the skin, followed by a brief warmth. Areas with thicker hair or thinner skin (bikini, lip) tend to feel more, while areas with finer hair feel less.

### What should I avoid after a session?

For 24 hours: avoid hot showers, saunas, intense workouts, and direct sun exposure. Apply SPF 30 or higher to treated areas every day. Avoid waxing, plucking, or any hair removal method that pulls the follicle during your course.

### When can I shave after laser?

You can shave the treatment area as soon as the skin is no longer warm or red, usually within 24 to 48 hours. Do not wax, pluck, or use depilatory creams during your course.

### Is laser hair removal safe?

Yes. Medical-grade laser hair removal is one of the most established treatments in aesthetic medicine, with decades of clinical use. At OrangeTwist, every session is performed by a licensed provider trained on our specific device platform.

### Who should not have laser hair removal?

Laser hair removal is not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have a recent active tan or sunburn in the treatment area, are taking photosensitizing medications, have a history of keloid scarring, or have certain skin conditions affecting the treatment area. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### Are there any side effects?

The most common side effects are mild redness, slight swelling, or warmth in the treated area, all of which resolve within a few hours. Rare side effects include pigment changes or blistering, which is why proper device calibration and trained providers matter.

### Can I have laser hair removal if I am tan?

Active sun tans (including self-tanner) increase the risk of pigment changes and burns. Wait two to four weeks after sun exposure or fading the tan before your session. Your provider will assess the skin at your appointment and reschedule if needed.

### Can I have laser hair removal during pregnancy?

Laser hair removal is not recommended during pregnancy due to a lack of clinical safety data, not a known risk. We ask clients to wait until after pregnancy and breastfeeding to begin or resume a course.

The facial your scalp has been waiting for. Hydrafacial Keravive is the three-step treatment that cleanses, exfoliates, and nourishes the scalp, supporting healthier, fuller-looking hair from the root up. Your scalp deserves a glow routine.

## Healthy hair starts with a healthy scalp.

Your scalp is skin. It needs the same care as the rest of your face: cleansing, exfoliation, and the right active ingredients. Hydrafacial Keravive treats the scalp with the same three-step approach as the original Hydrafacial, designed specifically to support the conditions hair needs to grow strong, healthy, and dense.

-   Three steps for scalp health
-   Cleanses, exfoliates, nourishes
-   Suitable for thinning hair

## What is Hydrafacial Keravive and how does it work?

Hydrafacial Keravive is a scalp treatment from the makers of the [original Hydrafacial](https://orangetwist.com/dictionary/hydrafacial/). The treatment applies the same proven three-step protocol used for facial skin: deep cleansing and exfoliation, painless extraction of buildup and dead skin, and infusion of a specialized scalp health serum rich in growth factors and skin proteins.

The scalp is where hair starts. Buildup of product, oil, and dead skin can clog hair follicles, reduce circulation, and create conditions where hair becomes thinner, weaker, and less healthy over time. Keravive addresses the scalp environment directly, restoring the clean, balanced, well-nourished surface your hair needs to thrive.

The treatment includes both an in-center session and a take-home Keravive spray applied daily between visits. The take-home spray extends the benefits of the in-center treatment and is part of why Keravive works best as a series rather than a one-off.

Keravive is particularly well-suited to clients noticing early thinning, clients with itchy or congested scalps, clients with product buildup that home shampoos cannot fully address, and clients who simply want their hair to look healthier and feel fuller.

## The OrangeTwist Difference

##### Trained on the platform

Every Keravive session at OrangeTwist is performed by a licensed esthetician or provider trained on the platform and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board. The device matters. The hands matter more.

##### Results Focused Pricing

Although Keravive can be done as a single treatment for a scalp refresh, results are best with a series of multiple treatments. We price packages transparently at your You Review and will walk through what is realistic for your scalp and your hair goals.

##### Designed for combinations

Keravive combines particularly well with PRP and PRF for clients addressing thinning hair. Your provider will design the right combination plan, not push a single product.

##### Your local Treatment Shop

Bright, welcoming, and run by people who genuinely care about your experience. Nothing like a clinical environment.

## Your Treatment Timeline for Hydrafacial Keravive

![hydrafacial-for-thinning-hair](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201291%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## You Review

Your provider will examine your scalp, discuss your hair concerns and history, and recommend whether Keravive is the right tool for your goals. For most clients, Keravive is part of a wider scalp and hair plan rather than a single visit. They will walk through the realistic course and pricing transparently.

[Book A You Review](/book-now)

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20933'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Preparation

Come in with clean hair if possible, or hair that has been gently shampooed the day before. Avoid heavy styling products on the day. Eat beforehand. Let your provider know about any scalp conditions or medications affecting your hair or scalp.

![Santa-clara-keravive](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/santa-clara-3.webp)

## The Treatment

Your provider will apply the Keravive handpiece across your scalp in three steps: deep cleansing and exfoliation, painless extraction of buildup, and infusion of the Keravive serum. Most clients describe the sensation as gentle and surprisingly relaxing, with mild tingling during the active phases. Total treatment time is 30 to 45 minutes.

![recovery-after-hydrafacial](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201707%202560'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Aftercare

There is no downtime. Avoid washing your hair for the first six hours after treatment to allow the Keravive serum to fully absorb. Use the take-home Keravive spray daily as directed between sessions. Your provider will share specific aftercare and confirm your next appointment in the treatment plan.

![scalp-after-keravive](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/after-keravive-800x800.jpg) After

![scalp-before-keravive](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/before-keravive-800x800.jpg) Before

 ![scalp-after-keravive](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/after-keravive-800x800.jpg) After

![scalp-before-keravive](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/before-keravive-800x800.jpg) Before

## Healthier scalp, fuller-looking hair.

Most clients feel an immediate difference in scalp comfort and cleanliness after the first session. The visible hair quality and density improvement builds across the series of treatments, typically three to six sessions spaced two to four weeks apart, alongside daily use of the take-home spray.

Official [Hydrafacial](https://hydrafacial.com) Before & After Photo

### Results last for months when the treatment series is completed and supported by good ongoing scalp care.

Maintenance sessions every three to six months keep the result consistent. Keravive is one of the most effective non-medical scalp treatments and pairs particularly well with PRP and PRF for clients addressing more advanced thinning.

![women-hair-beach](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201000%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

Learn more about Hydrafacial Keravive

About Keravive Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare and Comfort Safety and Suitability

### What is Hydrafacial Keravive?

Hydrafacial Keravive is a three-step scalp treatment from the makers of the original Hydrafacial. It cleanses and exfoliates the scalp, removes buildup, and infuses a specialized scalp health serum to support healthier, fuller-looking hair.

### How does Keravive work?

The treatment uses the same vacuum-assisted approach as a Hydrafacial, adapted specifically for the scalp. Three steps in a single session: deep cleansing and exfoliation, painless extraction of buildup and dead skin, and infusion of a Keravive serum rich in growth factors and skin proteins. The result is a cleaner, healthier scalp environment that supports hair growth.

### Will Keravive regrow my hair?

Keravive supports the conditions hair needs to grow strong and healthy. It is not a regrowth treatment in the same way as [PRP](https://orangetwist.com/treatments/prp/) or prescription medications. For clients with early thinning or scalp health issues, Keravive can meaningfully improve hair quality and density. For clients with more advanced hair loss, Keravive is most effective as part of a wider plan that may include PRP, [PRF](https://orangetwist.com/dictionary/blood-plasma-therapy/), or medical treatments.

### What does the take-home Keravive spray do?

The take-home spray extends the in-center treatment by applying scalp health actives daily between sessions. It is part of the protocol and one of the reasons Keravive works best as a course rather than a one-off.

### Is Keravive the same as a regular scalp massage?

No. A scalp massage stimulates circulation, which is valuable but limited in what it can address. Keravive cleans, exfoliates, and infuses active ingredients into the scalp directly, working on the surface environment hair grows from.

### Who is Keravive for?

Keravive is suited to clients with early hair thinning, clients with congested or buildup-heavy scalps, clients with itchy or sensitive scalps, and clients who want to maintain long-term hair health. Your provider will assess your case at your You Review.

### Do I need a consultation before Hydrafacial Keravive?

Yes. Every OrangeTwist client starts with a complimentary You Review. Your provider will examine your scalp, discuss your hair concerns and history, and recommend the right protocol for your case.

### What should I tell my provider?

Let your provider know about any scalp conditions, current shampoos and styling products, medications affecting your hair or scalp, history of hair loss, family hair loss pattern, and any previous hair or scalp treatments.

### Can Hydrafacial Keravive be combined with PRP?

Yes, and the combination is one of the most effective approaches for clients addressing thinning hair. Keravive prepares the scalp environment by cleansing and exfoliating. PRP then delivers growth factors deeper into the scalp through injection. Your provider will design the right sequencing at your You Review.

### How much does Hydrafacial Keravive cost at OrangeTwist?

Pricing depends on the package size and whether take-home Keravive spray is included. Because Keravive works best as a course, OrangeTwist prices packages transparently. Your provider will walk you through exact pricing at your You Review. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing benefits.

### How long does a Hydrafacial Keravive appointment take?

Most Keravive sessions take 30 to 45 minutes. Allow around 60 minutes for your full appointment including a brief check-in and aftercare.

### How many sessions will I need of Hydrafacial Keravive?

Most clients see best results across three to six sessions spaced two to four weeks apart, alongside daily use of the take-home spray. Maintenance sessions every three to six months keep the result consistent. Your provider will recommend a realistic plan at your You Review.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from Hydrafacial Keravive?

Most clients feel an immediate difference in scalp comfort and cleanliness after the first session. The visible hair quality and density improvement builds across the course, typically three to six sessions over two to three months.

### How long do results last?

Results last for months when the course is completed and supported by good ongoing scalp care. Maintenance sessions every three to six months keep the result consistent over time.

### Will my hair feel different after Hydrafacial Keravive?

Yes. Most clients notice their hair feels cleaner, lighter, and easier to manage after the first session. Visible thickness and density improvement build across the course.

### Does Hydrafacial Keravive work for everyone?

Keravive works best for clients with scalp health concerns or early thinning. For clients with advanced hair loss or hair loss caused by genetic, hormonal, or medical conditions, Keravive is most effective as part of a wider plan that may include PRP, PRF, or medical treatments. Your provider will set realistic expectations honestly.

### Does Keravive Hydrafacial hurt?

No. Keravive is one of the gentler treatments on the menu. Most clients describe it as relaxing, with mild tingling during the active phases. The vacuum-assisted approach is painless.

### What is the downtime after Hydrafacial Keravive?

There is no downtime. You can return to normal activities immediately.

### What should I avoid after Hydrafacial Keravive?

Avoid washing your hair for the first six hours after treatment to allow the Keravive serum to fully absorb. Use the take-home Keravive spray daily as directed. Avoid heavy styling products on the scalp during your course where possible.

### Can I use my regular shampoo after Hydrafacial Keravive?

Yes, after the first six hours. Your provider may recommend a gentler shampoo during your course to support the scalp health work the treatment is doing.

### Is Hydrafacial Keravive safe?

Yes. Keravive uses the same well-established HydraFacial technology adapted for the scalp. It has a strong safety record. At OrangeTwist, every session is performed by a licensed esthetician or provider trained on the platform.

### Who should not have Hydrfacial Keravive?

Keravive is generally not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding (check with your provider for current guidance), have an active scalp infection or open wound, have severe psoriasis or seborrheic dermatitis in active flare, or have hair extensions or weaves that prevent direct scalp access. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### Is Hydrafacial Keravive safe for color-treated hair?

Yes. Keravive treats the scalp, not the hair shaft, and is safe for color-treated, chemically treated, and styled hair.

### Is Hydrafacial Keravive safe for all hair types?

Yes. Keravive works on the scalp environment and is suitable for all hair types and textures. Your provider will adapt the approach where needed for specific hair types.

### What are the side effects?

Common side effects include mild tingling during the treatment and very occasional brief scalp sensitivity afterward. All typically resolve quickly.

### How do I know my provider is qualified?

All Keravive treatments at OrangeTwist are performed by licensed estheticians or providers with specific training on the HydraFacial platform and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board.

## Regenerative aesthetics, designed by your own biology

Regenerative treatments work differently from injectables that add to the face. They use your own platelets, plasma, or signaling molecules to trigger renewal at the cellular level. The result is improvement that looks completely natural because it is. Your body did the work. We just gave it the signal.

-   Uses your own biology
-   For face and scalp
-   Naturally regenerative results

## What are PRP, PRF, and exosomes, and how do they work?

Regenerative aesthetics is the category of treatments that use biologically active substances, drawn from your own body or bioengineered, to trigger tissue renewal. At OrangeTwist, the three lead treatments in this category are PRP, PRF, and exosomes.

PRP (platelet-rich plasma) is concentrated platelets drawn from a small sample of your own blood. The blood is spun in a centrifuge to separate the platelet-rich layer, which is then injected or applied topically to the treatment area. Platelets release growth factors that stimulate cellular repair, collagen production, and tissue renewal. PRP has been used in orthopedics and sports medicine for decades and has well-established aesthetic applications.

PRF (platelet-rich fibrin) is the next generation of PRP. It uses a slower centrifuge speed to preserve a wider range of cellular components, including white blood cells and stem cells, in a fibrin matrix that releases growth factors over a longer period. Many providers prefer PRF for its sustained release profile. Exosomes are tiny signaling vesicles that carry growth factors, proteins, and genetic material between cells. They can be derived from a range of sources and are typically applied topically after a microneedling or laser procedure, signaling cells in the treatment area to behave more like younger, healthier cells.

Exosomes are tiny signaling vesicles that carry growth factors, proteins, and genetic material between cells. They can be derived from a range of sources, including mesenchymal stem cells, and are typically applied topically after a microneedling or laser procedure. Exosomes work as messengers, telling cells in the treatment area to behave more like younger, healthier cells.

## The OrangeTwist Difference

##### Sterile, in-center preparation

Regenerative treatments require careful blood handling, sterile preparation, and trained technique. Every PRP, PRF, and exosome treatment at OrangeTwist is performed by a licensed provider with specific training on the protocol and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board.

##### Course-led, plan-led

Regenerative treatments are a course, not a single visit. We price the realistic full protocol transparently at your You Review and walk through what to expect at each stage.

##### Designed for combinations

Regenerative treatments often combine with other procedures (microneedling, RF, scalp care) for amplified results. Your provider will design a treatment plan, not push a single product.

Prep 101

## Your Treatment Timeline

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20789%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## You Review

Your provider will assess your concern, examine the treatment area, and recommend whether PRP, PRF, exosomes, or a combination suits your goals. For hair restoration, this includes a scalp assessment and a realistic conversation about what regenerative treatments can and cannot do. They will walk through the protocol and pricing before anything is booked.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20788'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Onboarding

For PRP and PRF: drink plenty of water in the 24 hours before your appointment to make blood draw easier. Eat beforehand. Avoid blood thinners, including ibuprofen, aspirin, fish oil, and vitamin E, for a few days where possible. For scalp treatments, come with clean, product-free hair.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201024%20683'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Ongoing Care

For PRP and PRF, your provider will draw a small sample of your blood, spin it in a centrifuge in-center, and prepare the active layer for injection or topical application. Topical numbing is applied before injection. The injection phase is spicy but quick. Exosomes are typically applied after microneedling or a similar procedure that creates channels for the product to penetrate.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20769%201001'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Maintenance and Transition

For scalp treatments, avoid washing your hair for the first six hours, then return to your normal routine. For facial treatments, avoid heavy skincare, retinoids, and exfoliants for 48 hours. Avoid strenuous exercise, saunas, and direct sun for 24 hours. Your provider will share specific aftercare for your protocol.

## Slow signals, real change.

Regenerative treatments work on biological timelines. For facial applications, you will see initial brightness and improved texture within two to four weeks. The deeper collagen response and tissue improvement build over three to six months as your body responds to the growth factor signaling.

## For hair restoration, the timeline is longer.

Most clients see reduced shedding within the first one to two months and visible density improvement at four to six months. A typical course is three to four sessions spaced four to six weeks apart, followed by maintenance every six to 12 months.

Regenerative treatments work best for early to moderate concerns. Late-stage hair loss or significant volume loss may benefit from combining regenerative protocols with other treatments. Your provider will set realistic expectations at your You Review.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20683%201024'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About PRP, PRF, and Exosomes Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare and Comfort Safety and Suitability

### What is PRP?

PRP (platelet-rich plasma) is concentrated platelets drawn from a small sample of your own blood. The blood is spun in a centrifuge to separate the platelet-rich layer, which is then injected or applied topically to the treatment area. The platelets release growth factors that stimulate cellular repair and tissue renewal.

### What is PRF and how is it different from PRP?

PRF (platelet-rich fibrin) is the next generation of PRP. It uses a slower centrifuge speed to preserve a wider range of cellular components, including white blood cells and stem cells, in a fibrin matrix that releases growth factors over a longer period. Many providers prefer PRF for its sustained release profile and slightly stronger response.

### What are exosomes?

Exosomes are tiny signaling vesicles that carry growth factors, proteins, and genetic material between cells. In aesthetic medicine, exosomes are typically derived from mesenchymal stem cells and applied topically after a microneedling or laser procedure. They work as messengers, signaling cells in the treatment area to behave more like younger, healthier cells.

### Are exosomes the same as stem cells?

No. Exosomes are released by stem cells but are not stem cells themselves. They are signaling vesicles, not living cells. This is part of why exosomes have a different regulatory and safety profile from stem cell treatments.

### Which treatment is right for me?

It depends on your concern and goals. PRP and PRF are well-established for hair restoration and under-eye rejuvenation. Exosomes are often used for skin quality, scalp health, and recovery after procedures like microneedling. Many clients use a combination across a course. Your provider will recommend the right protocol at your You Review.

### What concerns can be treated?

Common applications include hair thinning and early hair loss, scalp health, under-eye hollowing and dark circles, skin quality and texture, post-procedure recovery, and collagen induction when combined with microneedling. Your provider will assess what is right for your case.

### Do I need a consultation before regenerative treatments?

Yes. Regenerative treatments are protocol-led, often combined with other procedures, and the right approach depends on your specific concern. Every OrangeTwist client starts with a complimentary You Review where your provider will assess your goals and design a protocol.

### What happens at a You Review for hair restoration?

Your provider will examine your scalp, discuss your hair loss pattern and history, ask about family hair loss, and assess whether you are a strong candidate for regenerative treatment. They will discuss realistic expectations and may recommend complementary approaches (topical treatments, oral medications) where appropriate.

### What should I tell my provider?

Let your provider know about any medical conditions, medications (especially blood thinners and hormone medications), hair loss history including family pattern, any previous regenerative treatments, autoimmune conditions, and whether you are pregnant or planning pregnancy.

### How much do PRP and regenerative treatments cost?

Pricing depends on the protocol (PRP vs PRF vs exosomes), the treatment area, and the number of sessions. Because regenerative treatments work best as a course, OrangeTwist prices packages. Your provider will walk through exact pricing at your You Review. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing benefits.

### How long does a session take?

Allow 60 to 90 minutes for a typical session. This includes time for blood draw (for PRP and PRF), centrifuge processing, numbing cream to take effect, and the treatment itself. Exosome treatments combined with microneedling can take longer.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most regenerative protocols call for three to four initial sessions spaced four to six weeks apart, followed by maintenance every six to 12 months. Your provider will recommend a realistic schedule based on your specific concern.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results?

For facial treatments, you will see brightness and improved texture within two to four weeks, with deeper collagen response building over three to six months. For hair restoration, most clients see reduced shedding within one to two months and visible density improvement at four to six months. Results build cumulatively across the course.

### How long do results last?

Most clients see results lasting 12 to 18 months from a full course, with maintenance sessions every six to 12 months to sustain results. Individual longevity varies based on the underlying cause of the concern and lifestyle factors.

### Will PRP regrow hair I have already lost?

PRP works best on hair follicles that are still active but weakened, not on follicles that are fully dormant. For early to moderate hair thinning, PRP can meaningfully improve density and slow further loss. For advanced hair loss where follicles are no longer active, regenerative treatments alone are unlikely to produce dramatic regrowth.

### Does PRP work for everyone?

No treatment works for everyone. Regenerative response varies between individuals based on genetics, age, the underlying cause of the concern, and overall health. Most clients see meaningful improvement. Your provider will set realistic expectations honestly.

### Does PRP hurt?

The blood draw feels like a routine lab draw, brief and easily managed. Injection of PRP or PRF is spicy but manageable with topical numbing. Scalp injections can feel particularly sensitive given the nerve density of the area. Your provider will adjust pace and pressure to your comfort.

### What is the downtime?

Most clients return to normal activities immediately. For facial injections, expect mild redness, swelling, or pinpoint bruising for 24 to 48 hours. For scalp treatments, your scalp may feel tender for a day. Avoid washing hair for the first six hours after a scalp treatment.

### What should I avoid after a session?

For 24 to 48 hours: avoid strenuous exercise, saunas, hot showers, alcohol, and direct sun. Avoid heavy skincare, retinoids, and active exfoliants for facial treatments. Avoid styling products and harsh shampoos for scalp treatments.

### Can I combine regenerative treatments with other procedures?

Yes. Regenerative treatments often combine well with microneedling, RF microneedling, fractional laser, and PRX. The combination amplifies the collagen response and recovery profile. Your provider will design a treatment sequence at your You Review.

### Is PRP safe?

Yes. Because PRP and PRF use your own blood, the risk of allergic or immune reaction is essentially zero. They have an extensive clinical safety record across orthopedics, sports medicine, and aesthetic applications. At OrangeTwist, every treatment is performed by a licensed provider with sterile in-center preparation.

### Are exosomes safe?

Exosomes have a strong emerging safety record in aesthetic applications, though the regulatory landscape continues to evolve. At OrangeTwist, exosome products are sourced through licensed pharmaceutical partners with documented quality standards. Your provider will discuss product specifics at your You Review.

### Who should not have regenerative treatments?

Regenerative treatments are generally not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have an active blood disorder or are on certain blood thinners, have an active infection in the treatment area, have certain autoimmune conditions, have active cancer or a history of certain cancers, or have a history of keloid scarring. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### What are the side effects?

Common side effects include temporary redness, swelling, mild bruising, and tenderness at the injection sites. Scalp treatments may cause temporary scalp sensitivity. All typically resolve within days. Rare side effects include infection at the injection site, which is why sterile technique matters.

### Are regenerative treatments safe for all skin tones?

Yes. PRP, PRF, and exosomes work independently of skin tone and are safe across all skin types.

### How do I know my provider is qualified?

All regenerative treatments at OrangeTwist are performed by licensed providers with specific training on the protocol, sterile blood handling, and complication management. Our providers are continuously updated and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board.

## A Quick Reset, Built Into Your Routine

Wellness shots are the low-lift way to support how you feel day to day. B12 helps keep energy and metabolism running the way they should. NAD+ supports the cellular repair process that naturally slows down over time. Both are quick, both are simple, and both fit into a normal Tuesday.

-   Quick, in-and-out visits
-   No drip chair required
-   Pairs with any treatment day

## What are B12 and NAD+, and how do they work?

Vitamin B12 is a nutrient your body relies on for energy production, red blood cell formation, and nervous system function. Because it is water-soluble and not always efficiently absorbed through food alone, a lot of people run lower than they realize. A quick injection delivers it directly, skipping digestion altogether.

NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is a coenzyme found in every cell in your body. It is central to energy production and cellular repair, and levels naturally decline with age. NAD+ injections are a subcutaneous way to help restore those levels without the time commitment of an IV drip.

Neither is about chasing a dramatic transformation. Think of them as maintenance for the systems already running the show.

### The OrangeTwist Difference

Wellness shots are easy to get wrong: rushed, generic, no real conversation about what your body actually needs. Here’s what makes it different at OrangeTwist.

### Trained providers, every visit

Every B12 and NAD+ injection at OrangeTwist is administered by a licensed provider trained on proper dosing, injection technique, and site rotation, and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board.

### A real check-in, not a form and a needle

Your provider talks through your goals and health history before anything is drawn up. No labs required, no assembly line. Just a quick, honest conversation about what actually makes sense for you.

### Built around your schedule

Five to ten minutes, no drip chair, no hour set aside. Wellness shots are designed to slot into a normal day, whether that’s on their own or stacked onto a treatment you already had booked.

### Honest pairing, not pressure

If B12 covers what you need, that’s the plan. If NAD+ makes sense too, your provider will say so and explain why, rather than defaulting to more.

### Your local Treatment Shop

Bright, welcoming, and run by people who genuinely care about your experience. Nothing like a clinical environment.

## Wellness Focused on You

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20933%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Who its for

If you’ve been feeling a little flat, a little foggy, or like your energy checked out before your to-do list did, this is worth a conversation. B12 is a good fit if you’re after everyday support for energy and metabolism. NAD+ tends to appeal to clients looking for something more built-in to their routine, whether that’s recovery, focus, or general cellular upkeep. Your provider will help you figure out which one (or both) actually makes sense for you, rather than defaulting to more.

B12 and NAD+ are not appropriate for everyone. Your provider will review your health history at your You Review to confirm you’re a good candidate.

![Tustin-Center-Lobby](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20933'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## What to expect

You’ll start with a quick check in on how you’ve been feeling and any relevant health history. No labs required. Your provider cleans the injection site (typically the arm, thigh, or abdomen), and the shot itself takes just a few seconds. NAD+ can sting a little as it goes in. Fast is not always the goal there, and your provider will pace it accordingly.

Afterward, you’re free to go. NAD+ clients may be asked to hang out for about 15 minutes just to make sure everything feels good, but there’s no real downtime for either treatment. Mild soreness at the injection site is normal and typically resolves within a day.

![model-ocean-cliffs-brea](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201120%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Your results

With B12, most clients notice a lift in energy within a few days, with benefits generally lasting about a week before the next dose. NAD+ tends to build. Some clients feel a difference the same day, others notice it gradually over their first one to two weeks of twice-weekly visits. Consistency is what makes both worth doing. A single shot is nice; a routine is what actually moves the needle.

Wellness shots pair naturally with [TwistUp](https://orangetwist.com/membership-loyalty/), our ongoing maintenance membership. Book B12 or NAD+ as a standalone visit, or build it into your regular OrangeTwist rhythm alongside the treatments you already come in for.

## Wellness Frequently Asked Questions and Answers

About Wellness Appointments & Pricing Results Aftercare Safety and Suitability

### What is a wellness shot?

A wellness shot is a quick injection, B12 or NAD+, designed to support how you feel day to day rather than change how you look. No drip chair, no long visit. In and out in a few minutes.

### What’s the difference between B12 and NAD+?

B12 is a nutrient that supports everyday energy, mood, and metabolism. NAD+ is a coenzyme tied to cellular repair and energy production at a deeper level, and tends to build over a series rather than deliver an instant lift. Many clients start with B12 and add NAD+ once they know their rhythm.

### Can I get both B12 and NAD+ at OrangeTwist?

Yes. They’re given at separate injection sites, so plenty of clients do both in the same visit.

### Is this the same as an IV drip?

No. IV drips run through a vein over time. B12 and NAD+ at OrangeTwist are quick subcutaneous injections, so there’s no line, no chair, and no hour to set aside.

### How long does a wellness shot appointment take?

About five to ten minutes for the injection itself. NAD+ clients may stay a little longer afterward, just to make sure everything feels good.

### How often should I book B12 or NAD+ shots?

B12 is typically weekly, as needed. NAD+ works best on a twice-weekly cadence, especially when you’re starting out. Your provider will map out a plan at your You Review.

### How much do B12 and NAD+ shots cost?

Pricing varies by location and whether you’re a member. Full pricing lives on the pricing page, or get exact numbers for your plan at your complimentary You Review.

### Do I need a consultation before starting?

Yes. Every OrangeTwist client starts with a complimentary You Review, where your provider reviews your health history and builds a plan around your goals.

### How soon will I feel a difference from B12?

Most clients notice a lift in energy within a few days, with benefits generally lasting about a week before the next dose makes sense.

### How soon will I feel a difference from NAD+?

It varies. Some clients feel a difference the same day, others notice it gradually over their first one to two weeks of twice-weekly visits. NAD+ tends to build rather than deliver an instant boost.

### Do results last if I stop treatments?

Both B12 and NAD+ work best as an ongoing routine rather than a one-off. Benefits taper off once injections stop, which is why most clients build it into a regular cadence.

### Is there any downtime after a B12 or NAD+ shot?

None to speak of. You’re free to go right after a B12 shot. NAD+ clients are typically asked to hang around for about fifteen minutes, just as a precaution.

### Is soreness at the injection site normal?

Mild soreness, redness, or bruising at the site is common and typically resolves within a day. Rotating injection sites over time helps keep this minimal.

### What should I do if I feel unwell after my shot?

Let your OrangeTwist provider know right away. Mild nausea, dizziness, or a headache can happen and usually passes quickly, but your provider is there to help if anything feels off.

### Does a B12 shot hurt?

Not really. It’s a quick injection, typically in the arm, and most clients describe it as a brief pinch at most.

### Does the NAD+ shot sting?

It can, briefly. NAD+ is injected a bit more slowly than B12 for exactly this reason. Your provider will pace it to keep it comfortable.

### Do I need bloodwork before starting?

No labs are required. Your provider will go over your health history and current medications at your You Review to make sure it’s a good fit.

### Who shouldn’t get NAD+ or B12 injections?

Wellness shots aren’t right for everyone. Your provider will review your full health history at your You Review to confirm you’re a good candidate before anything is scheduled.

### Is NAD+ safe alongside weight loss treatments like semaglutide?

Generally, yes, and the two are given at separate injection sites. Bring it up at your You Review so your provider can look at the full picture.

# Your concerns, your goals

Explore the areas you’d like to refresh, smooth, or refine. We’re here to help you find what feels right for you.

Area of concern

## Your Face

Every face tells a story, and your goals are uniquely yours. Whether you’re looking to refresh, smooth, or enhance your natural features, we’re here to guide you toward what feels right for you.

[

![model-Concern-Cheek-pigmentation](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/pexels-ron-lach-8128694-800x533.jpg)

#### Cheek Volume Treatment

As the mid-face loses support, the cheeks flatten and everything below them softens.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/cheek-volume-treatment/ "Cheek Volume Treatment")[

![Skin-model-Concerns-Crows-Feet](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/pexels-a-darmel-8989973-533x800.jpg)

#### Crow’s Feet Treatment

The fine lines that fan from the outer corners when you smile or squint.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/crows-feet-treatment/ "Crow’s Feet Treatment")[

![Model-Concerns-Dark-Circle](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/pexels-ivan-s-7162194-800x533.jpg)

#### Dark Circle Treatment

Dark circles are not one thing. They can come from pigment, from vessels showing through thin skin, or from a hollow casting a shadow.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/dark-circle-treatment/ "Dark Circle Treatment")[

![Woman-model-feeling-face](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/pexels-polina-tankilevitch-5588033-800x533.jpg)

#### Double Chin Treatment

The fullness under the chin that resists diet and exercise because that fat behaves differently.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/double-chin-treatment/ "Double Chin Treatment")[

![Model-skin-mirror-smile](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/pexels-olly-774866-800x533.jpg)

#### Fine Lines and Wrinkle

The everyday lines that build from years of expression, plus the ones that start to settle in even at rest.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/fine-lines-and-wrinkles/ "Fine Lines and Wrinkle")[

![Skin-and-hair-model-beige-background](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/pexels-artempodrez-7955852-800x450.jpg)

#### Forehead Line Treatment

The horizontal lines that show when you raise your brows.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/forehead-line-treatment/ "Forehead Line Treatment")[

![Laughing-middle-aged-skin-model](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20533%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Frown Line Treatment

The two vertical lines between the brows, the ones that read as the 11s.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/frown-line-treatment/ "Frown Line Treatment")[

![model-Concerns-Hair-thinning](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20533%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Hair Thinning and Hair Loss Treatment

Thinning at the part, the temples, or the crown, in both men and women.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/hair-thinning-treatment/ "Hair Thinning and Hair Loss Treatment")[

![Skin-model-Concerns-mirror](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20533'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Hollow Under-Eye Treatment

The sunken look under the eye that reads as tired no matter how much you sleep.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/hollow-under-eye-treatment/ "Hollow Under-Eye Treatment")[

![face-makeup-model-2](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20638%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Jawline Definition Treatment

A jawline can blur from fat, from softening skin, or from lost structure.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/jawline-definition-treatment/ "Jawline Definition Treatment")[

![woman-model-Lip-Line](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20533'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Lip Line Treatment

The fine vertical lines above the top lip, the ones lipstick likes to travel into.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/lip-line-treatment/ "Lip Line Treatment")[

![Woman-model-blonde-touching-face](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20533%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Marionette Line Treatment

The lines that run from the corners of the mouth down toward the chin and can read as a permanent frown.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/marionette-line-treatment/ "Marionette Line Treatment")[

![skin-model-Nasolabial-line](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20533%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Nasolabial Fold Treatment

The folds that run from the sides of the nose to the corners of the mouth.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/nasolabial-fold-treatment/ "Nasolabial Fold Treatment")[

![Skin-model-Lip-Line](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20533'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Thin Lips Treatment

Subtle, natural fullness

Smoother under-eyes

Area of concern

## Your Skin

Skin concerns rarely have one cause, which is why one-size treatments rarely work. Whether it’s acne, texture, tone, or sun damage, your plan starts with what’s actually happening beneath the surface, not a generic routine.

[

![Skin-model-Concerns-Acne-treatment](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20533%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Acne

Real progress comes from a plan built around your skin, not a template.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/acne/ "Acne")[

![model-Concerns-Acne-Scars](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20533%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Acne Scar

Different scars respond to different treatments, so the plan starts with reading the kind of scarring you have.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/acne-scar/ "Acne Scar")[

![Face-model-Dull-Skin](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20533%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Dull Skin Treatment

The flat, tired look that comes from buildup, dehydration, or stress.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/dull-skin-treatment/ "Dull Skin Treatment")[

![Woman-model-concerns-mirror](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Enlarged Pore Treatment

Pores look larger when they are congested or when the skin around them loses firmness.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/enlarged-pore-treatment/ "Enlarged Pore Treatment")[

![Woman-model-putting-on-makeup](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20533'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Hyperpigmentation Treatment

The dark spots and uneven patches left by sun, breakouts, or hormones.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/hyperpigmentation-treatment/ "Hyperpigmentation Treatment")[

![model-Concerns-Melasma-eyelid](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20532'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Melasma Treatment

Larger, often symmetrical patches driven by hormones plus sun.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/melasma-treatment/ "Melasma Treatment")[

![Model-feeling-face-in-mirror](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20533%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Rosacea and Redness Treatment

The persistent flushing, visible vessels, and reactivity that come with rosacea.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/rosacea-and-redness-treatment/ "Rosacea and Redness Treatment")[

![Skin-model-feeling-face](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20533%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Skin Laxity Treatment

The gradual loss of firmness as collagen and elastin slow, most visible along the jaw, neck, and lower face.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/skin-laxity-treatment/ "Skin Laxity Treatment")[

![model-lifestyle-sky-bikini](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20533%20800'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

#### Sun Damage Treatment

The spots, texture, and uneven tone that build from years in the sun.

](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/sun-damage-treatment/ "Sun Damage Treatment")

## Skin that breaks out deserves a real plan

Acne is one of the most common reasons clients book a You Review. It is also one of the most over-promised treatments in the industry. At OrangeTwist, the plan is built around what is actually going on with your skin, not a one-size template. The right combination of in-center treatments and a routine you can actually keep is what makes the difference.

-     Personalized plans
-     Visible progress
-     No quick-fix promises

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

For active, inflammatory breakouts. We usually start with Hydrafacial paired with a calming skincare reset. The goal is to bring the skin back to a stable baseline before layering anything stronger.

For hormonal or congestive acne. A series of chemical peels combined with a medical-grade routine works on both the surface and the underlying oil pattern.

For acne that has settled but left marks. See our Acne Scars page. The plan for marks and texture looks different from the plan for active breakouts.

## Acne Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

### How long until I see results?

Most clients see meaningful change across the first three months of a proper plan. Hydrafacial often shows skin looking calmer right away. Peels and microneedling work over a series.

### Will treatment make me break out at first?

A short purge phase can happen when the skin is being decongested. Your provider will explain what is normal versus what needs adjustment.

### Can I keep using my current skincare?  

Bring it to your You Review. Some products help, some are working against you, and your provider will tell you honestly which is which.

### Do you treat body acne?  

Yes. Back, chest, and shoulder acne respond well to many of the same treatments we use on the face.

### Is acne treatment safe during pregnancy?  

Several active ingredients and treatments are off the table during pregnancy. Your provider will build a safe routine that still moves things forward.

### Will I need to keep coming in once my skin clears?  

Most clients move to a maintenance rhythm. Less frequent, but consistent. The goal is to keep what we have built.
