# Acne Scar

__The breakouts are gone. The texture should not have to stay. Real plans for real scarring.__

[Book Now](https://orangetwist.com/book-now/)

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20933%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Texture is a different conversation

Acne scars are not the same as the flat marks left behind right after a breakout. True scarring is a change in the texture of the skin itself, and it needs a different plan. The right approach almost always combines a few treatments over several months. Done well, the result is skin that catches the light evenly again.

-   Smoother texture
-   Better light reflection
-   Real progress over time

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

**For rolling or shallow boxcar scars.** A [microneedling series](https://orangetwist.com/dictionary/microneedling/) is usually the first move. Most clients see a real shift across three to six sessions. For those with deeper rolling or boxcar scaring ZenTite RF microneedling can be a great treatment option.

**For deeper, narrow ice-pick scars.** A different technique is needed. Your provider will assess at your You Review and tell you honestly what will and will not help.

**For raised or hypertrophic scarring.** These respond to a separate treatment plan. We do not lump them in with depressed scars.

## Acne Scarring Frequently Asked  
Questions

Microneedling for Acne Scars General Questions

### How many sessions will I need?

Most clients need three to six sessions for visible improvement when Microneedling is the treatment of choice, sometimes more sessions are required depending on depth. Your provider will give you an honest range at your You Review.  

### How long between treatments?

Usually four to six weeks. The skin needs time to remodel between sessions for the work to add up.

### Is there downtime?

Microneedling typically leaves the skin pink for a day or two. Peels can flake mildly. Most clients are back to normal within two to three days.

### Does it hurt?

A numbing cream is applied first. Most clients describe the sensation as warm and a little spicy, not painful.

### Will my scars disappear completely?  

Most likely not. The goal is real, visible improvement, not a guarantee of perfectly smooth skin. We will be honest with you about what each treatment can do.

### Can I treat scars while I still get the odd breakout?  

Yes, in most cases. Your provider will time treatments around active breakouts so we are not working against ourselves.

### Which treatment is best for deep, pitted acne scars?

Deeper boxcar, rolling, and pitted scarring usually responds best to radiofrequency microneedling like [ZenTite](https://orangetwist.com/treatments/zentite/), which remodels the skin from within rather than working only at the surface. Traditional microneedling suits shallower rolling [scars](https://orangetwist.com/dictionary/acne-scars/), while ice pick scars often need the deepest-reaching options. Your provider will match the tool to the scar type at your You Review. If you want to learn more about ZenTite you can read up in this [article](https://orangetwist.com/articles/mckinney/zentite-what-it-is-how-it-works/).  

### What is the difference between microneedling and ZenTite for acne scars?

Traditional microneedling or RF microneedling creates controlled micro-channels that prompt new collagen, which works well for shallow and rolling scars. ZenTite adds radiofrequency energy through insulated needles, delivering heat deeper into the skin for more structural remodeling. For deeper or long-standing scarring, that extra depth often makes the difference.  

### Can dermal fillers fix acne scars?

[Fillers](https://orangetwist.com/articles/brea/dermal-filler-101-before-first-treatment/) can lift depressed rolling and boxcar scars for a smoother surface, and results are visible right away. The effect is temporary, so most providers pair filler with collagen-stimulating treatments like microneedling so the improvement builds over time rather than resetting.  

### Do chemical peels work on acne scars?

Peels are most effective on the pigmentation side of post-acne marks and on surface texture. They will not rebuild a deep pit, but as part of a combination plan they refine tone and help the deeper treatments read more evenly across the whole face.

## The mid-face moves everything

The cheeks are the structural foundation of the face. When they lose volume, the change shows up not only in the cheeks but in under-eye hollows, deeper nasolabial folds, and softer jaw definition. Restoring cheek volume often refreshes the whole face from one well-placed treatment.

-    Refresh the mid-face
-   Soften other concerns
-   Subtle, natural support

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

For immediate volume restoration. Hyaluronic acid filler shows results the same day. Lasts about a year.

For gradual, longer-lasting structure. Collagen stimulators rebuild support over months and last longer. Often used in combination with filler.

For volume plus skin laxity. Sofwave or microneedling layered into the plan tightens the area around the volume work.

## Cheek Volume Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

### Will my face look overfilled?

Not with a conservative plan. The right volume restoration brings your face back to a more rested version of itself.

### How long does cheek filler last?

About six to twelve months depending on the product and how your body processes it.

### Does it hurt?

Most hyaluronic acid fillers used here last about twelve to eighteen months.

### Will collagen stimulators replace the need for filler?

For some clients, yes. They build structure that lasts longer than filler.

### Is there downtime?

Mild swelling and possible bruising for a few days. Most clients return to normal quickly.  

### Does cheek filler help with my under-eye area?

Often yes. Supporting the cheek can soften the look of under-eye hollows without any direct treatment of that area.

# Crow’s Feet Treatment

______Soften the lines, keep the smile. Real care for the most delicate skin on your face.______

[Book Now](https://orangetwist.com/book-now/)

![COncern Treatment 5](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20933'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## A softer eye area, still expressive.

Crow’s feet are the fine lines that fan out from the outer corners of the eyes when you smile, squint, or laugh. The skin around the eyes is the thinnest on the face, so it shows expression earlier than anywhere else. The right treatment softens the deeper lines and protects the area going forward without erasing what makes your smile yours.

**✓** Smooth the lines

**✓**  Brighten the eye area

**✓**  Real, refreshed look

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

For lines that only show when you smile. A small, conservative dose of Botox every three to four months. The area rewards a light touch.

For lines plus surface texture or sun damage. Combining Botox with laser, IPL, or microneedling treats the lines and the skin quality together.

For shadow or hollowness under the eye. See our Dark Circles and Hollow Under Eyes pages. The plan looks different.

![Treatment - Rachel Orange twist](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201050%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Crow’s Feet  
Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

### Will my smile look different?

Not in the right hands. Conservative dosing keeps the cheek lift natural while softening the deeper lines.

### How long does it last?

Three to four months for most clients.

### Can I wear makeup after?

We recommend keeping the area clean for the rest of the day. Normal makeup the next morning is fine.

### Does it hurt?

A small pinch at each injection point. Most clients are back to normal in seconds.

### Can I treat crow’s feet with my forehead?

Yes, this is one of the most common combinations and gives a balanced upper-face result.

### What about wrinkles I see even when my face is relaxed?

Those are static lines. A layered plan with Botox plus microneedling or laser usually works best.

# Dark Circle Treatment

_________Brighter eyes. Less tired-looking. Real plans for the area that gets the most questions._  
________

[Book Now](https://orangetwist.com/book-now/)

![Concern treatment 13 ](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20933%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Dark circles are not one thing

Dark circles can come from pigment in the skin, blood vessels showing through thin skin, shadow cast by a hollow under the eye, or all three. The treatments for each are completely different. The first step is always identifying what is actually causing the look, then matching the plan to it.

-   Honest assessment first
-   The right plan for your eyes
-   Real, visible brightening

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

For pigment-based dark circles. Brightening skincare and gentle peels take the lead. Sun protection is non-negotiable.

For hollow-based darkness. A small amount of filler in the tear trough, placed by an experienced provider, can change how rested the face looks.

For vascular dark circles. Carefully selected laser or IPL can help, but only after assessment. Not every eye area is a candidate.

## Dark Circle Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

### Why are my dark circles getting worse?

Common drivers include sun exposure, hormonal changes, sleep patterns, and the gradual loss of volume in the mid-face.

### Will filler fix all dark circles?

No. Filler only helps when the darkness comes from a hollow casting a shadow. We assess first.

### How long do tear-trough filler results last?

Usually nine to twelve months, sometimes longer.

### Are the treatments painful?

A small pinch with filler injections. Numbing cream is available. Most clients describe it as quick.

### Can I do this if I have allergies?

Tell your provider about any allergies at your You Review. Most are not an issue, but it is important to share.

### What about creams from the drugstore?

They are unlikely to do meaningful work. Medical-grade skincare is significantly stronger and is part of the plan.

# Double Chin Treatment

___________________A more defined jaw and neck. The fat cells left. They’re not coming back._  
__________________

[Book Now](https://orangetwist.com/book-now/)

![Frown Lines](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201052%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Lose the chin. Keep the schedule.

A double chin can be stubborn. It often resists diet and exercise because the fat under the chin behaves differently from fat elsewhere in the body. The good news is non-surgical treatments now reduce this fat reliably. The right plan depends on whether the issue is fat, skin laxity, or both.  

**✓** More defined jawline

**✓**  Non-surgical results

**✓**  No general anesthesia

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

For fat-driven submental fullness. CoolSculpting Elite is the most established non-surgical option. Most clients need one to two sessions.

For smaller, precise areas. There are a number of treatments that work well for clients who want a more targeted approach with injections.

For skin-driven softness along the jaw. Sofwave tightens the area without removing volume.

For mixed concerns. A combination plan often gives the most complete result. We will tell you what each treatment can do.

## Double Chin Frequently Asked Questions and Answers

### Will the fat come back?

The treated fat cells do not regenerate. New weight gain can affect the area, but the cells we treat are gone.

### How long until I see results?

CoolSculpting Elite results develop over two to three months. Other treatments may vary.

### Is there downtime?

CoolSculpting Elite has minimal downtime. Other treatments can cause swelling for several days after each session.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most clients need one to two CoolSculpting sessions.

### Does it hurt?

CoolSculpting feels intensely cold for the first few minutes, than it numbs.

### Can I treat the chin with skin tightening at the same time?

Yes. We often plan Sofwave alongside CoolSculpting for the most complete result.

# Fine Lines and Wrinkle

___Smooth lines without freezing the face. Same expressions, fewer opinions about them.___

[Book Now](https://orangetwist.com/book-now/)

![Fine Lines - Orange Twist
](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20566%20768'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Lines are not the enemy, Bad treatment is

Some lines come from movement. Some come from sun. Some come from how skin changes over time. They all respond to treatment, but not the same way. The right plan picks the right tool for the right kind of line, and leaves the rest of your face looking like itself.

-   Natural-looking results
-   Smooth dynamic lines
-   Improve skin quality

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

For lines you only see when you move. These are dynamic lines. Botox is usually the first move, with consistent treatment every three to four months.

For lines you see at rest. These are static lines. A combination of [Botox](https://orangetwist.com/treatments/botox-anti-wrinkle/) plus [microneedling](https://orangetwist.com/treatments/microneedling/), [peels](https://orangetwist.com/treatments/chemical-peels/), or [filler](https://orangetwist.com/treatments/dermal-fillers/) in select cases gives the most complete result.

For overall skin quality. A regular Hydrafacial and medical-grade skincare routine compound over time and protect every other treatment you do.

## Fine Lines and Wrinkles: Frequently Asked Questions and Answers

### When should I start treatment?

When the lines start to bother you. There is no universal age. Some clients start in their late 20s with prevention. Others start later.

### Will Botox change my expressions?

Treated well, no. You will still be able to express. The line just stops becoming permanently visible.

### How long do results last?

Botox lasts three to four months. Filler lasts six to eighteen months depending on type and area. Microneedling builds for several months and lasts longer.

### Can I combine treatments in one visit?

Yes, often. Your provider will plan the order and timing so the treatments support each other.

### What does it feel like?

Botox injections are quick and feel like a small pinch. Filler areas are numbed first. Microneedling feels warm and a little spicy after numbing.

### How much does it cost?

Pricing depends on the area, the units or syringes needed, and your specific plan. Your You Review includes a clear, no-pressure walkthrough of cost.

# ****Forehead Line Treatment****

____Soften the lines, keep the brow movement. The line that gives you away every time you raise an eyebrow, on pause.____

[Book Now](https://orangetwist.com/book-now/)

![Lighter Forehead](https://orangetwist.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/pexels-davegarcia-34317989-1400x933.jpg)

## A lighter forehead, still yours.

Forehead lines are the horizontal bands that show up every time the brows lift. Surprise, focus, reaction, all show up in the same place. The right plan softens the lines without flattening expression. Done well, it just looks like you, on a good day.

**✓**  Smoother forehead

**✓**  Natural movement

**✓**  Back to your day fast

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

For lines you only see when you raise your brows. Botox or Dysport every three to four months is the standard plan. Most clients start here and never need more.

For lines that stay visible at rest. Botox combined with a collagen-building treatment like microneedling works on both the movement and the etched line.

For prevention. Smaller doses earlier in your 30s often slow the lines from forming in the first place. A real conversation, not a sales pitch.

[Get the ‘In Depth’ here](https://orangetwist.com/book-now/)

## Forehead Lines  
Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

### How long until I see results?

Most clients see softening within three to seven days. Full result is in by two weeks.

### Will my forehead look frozen?

Not in the right hands. Smaller, well-placed doses keep movement natural while softening the lines.

### How long does it last?

Three to four months for most clients. Consistent treatment often extends the interval as the muscle adapts.

### Is it safe?

Yes. Botox has been FDA-approved for cosmetic use in this area for more than two decades. The safety record is well established when delivered by a licensed provider.

### Can I work out the same day?

We recommend waiting until the next day for any intense exercise. Otherwise, normal activity is fine.

### What if I have never done this before?

Your You Review will walk you through every step. No surprises, no pressure, and most first-time clients leave saying it was easier than they expected.

## A softer space between the brows.

Frown lines, the vertical 11s between the brows, have an outsized effect on how your face reads. Even a soft set can make a relaxed expression look serious. The good news is this area responds predictably to treatment. The trick is precision, not volume.

**✓**  Smooth the 11s

**✓**  Soften resting face

**✓**  Natural expressions intact

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

For lines you only see when you frown. Botox or Dysport every three to four months is the standard, well-studied path. Most clients need nothing more.

For deeper 11s that stay visible at rest. A layered plan. Neuromodulator softens the movement, microneedling improves the skin, and a small touch of filler can finish the job in select cases.

## Frown Lines  
Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

### Why are they called the 11s?

Most people develop two short parallel vertical lines between the brows that look like the number 11.

### Do frown lines mean I am always frowning?

No. The muscles between the brows contract for reading, screen use, concentration, and squinting in the sun. The lines reflect how often those muscles move, not your mood.

### Is Botox safe between the brows?

Yes. This is one of the most thoroughly studied areas for Botox use and has carried FDA approval since 2002.

### How long do results last?

Three to four months for most clients. Consistent treatment may extend the interval over time.

### Will my expression look different?

Treated well, the result is a softer version of your natural expression, not a different one.

### Can I treat the 11s with my forehead and crow’s feet?

Yes, and most clients do. A balanced upper-face plan often delivers the most natural-looking result.

## Treat the scalp, support the hair.

Hair thinning and early hair loss are more common than people realize. For most clients, the right plan combines in-center scalp treatments with at-home care to support stronger growth. The earlier treatment starts, the better the results.  

**✓**  Healthier scalp

**✓**  Stronger growth support

**✓**  Real, gradual progress

## Which Treatment is Right for you?

For early thinning. A combination of Hydrafacial Keravive and at-home scalp care often shows real change over months.

For more pronounced thinning. A series of PRP sessions builds on the scalp work and supports stronger regrowth over time.

For thinning with other underlying causes. Some thinning is driven by hormones, medication, or nutrition. We may coordinate with your physician.

## Hair Thinning  
Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

### How long until I see results?

Hair grows slowly. Most clients see real change over three to six months of consistent treatment.

### How many PRP sessions will I need?

Most plans start with three to four sessions spaced about a month apart, then maintenance.

### Does it hurt?

PRP feels like a series of small pinches across the scalp. Numbing options are available.

### Will my hair grow back to what it was?

Sometimes. We are honest about expectations. The goal is healthier, fuller hair from where you are now.  

### Can I treat thinning while pregnant?

Some treatments are not safe during pregnancy. Your provider will build a safe plan.

### Is hair loss only a male concern?

No. Female hair thinning is very common and often appears as widening of the part rather than recession.

# Stubborn Fat Treatment

____________________For the fat that won’t leave no matter how hard you work. The cells left. They’re not coming back._

[Book Now](https://orangetwist.com/book-now/)

![Concern Treatment 31](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20931'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## The areas diet doesn’t reach

Stubborn fat is the body fat that resists diet and exercise. Most people who maintain a healthy weight still have one or two areas that stay, regardless of how lean they get overall. The lower abdomen, flanks, inner thighs, bra line, and upper arms are common. CoolSculpting Elite targets these areas without surgery.

**✓** Reduce stubborn areas

**✓**  No surgery, no needles

**✓**  Long-lasting results

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

For specific, stubborn areas. CoolSculpting Elite is the most established non-surgical fat-reduction treatment. Most areas need one to two sessions.

For fat plus skin laxity. A combination plan with Sofwave after CoolSculpting addresses both at once.

For overall body composition concerns. CoolSculpting is for spot treatment, not weight loss. See our TwistOff page for medical weight loss.

## Stubborn Fat Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

### Is CoolSculpting Elite the same as liposuction?

No. Liposuction is a surgical procedure. CoolSculpting Elite is non-surgical and uses cooling to break down fat cells.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most areas need one or two sessions. Larger areas may need more.

### When will I see results?

Results develop over two to three months as your body processes the treated fat cells.

### Will the fat come back?

The treated cells are gone for good. New weight gain can affect surrounding areas. Maintenance is about lifestyle, not retreatment.

### Is there downtime?

Minimal. Mild redness or numbness in the area for a few days. Most clients return to normal activity right away.

### How long is a session?

Most sessions take 35 to 45 minutes per applicator. Multiple areas can be treated in one visit.

# Sun Damage Treatment

______________Brighter tone, smoother texture, fewer dark spots. Real plans for real photoaging._  
_____________

[Book Now](https://orangetwist.com/book-now/)

![Concern treatment 23](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201120%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Most aging skin is sun skin

Sun damage is the cumulative effect of years of UV exposure. It shows up as dark spots, broken capillaries, rough texture, fine lines, and loss of elasticity. Most of what people call aging skin is actually photoaging, and almost all of it responds well to treatment.

**✓**  Brighten dark spots

**✓**  Smooth texture

**✓**  Even out tone

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

For brown spots and uneven tone. IPL or laser is the most efficient route. Most clients see real progress within one to three sessions.

For rough texture and dullness. A series of microneedling and peels lifts the surface and improves overall quality.

For everyday maintenance. Hydrafacial monthly, daily SPF, and the right at-home routine compound over time.

## Sun Damage Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

### How long until I see results?

IPL and laser show pigment lifting within a week or two. Microneedling and peel results build across the series.

### Is treatment safe on darker skin tones?

Many treatments are. Some are not. Your provider will choose the right approach for your skin type at your You Review.

### Will my sun damage come back?

New damage can develop with new exposure. Daily SPF and ongoing maintenance keep the work in place.

### Can I treat sun damage in summer?

Some treatments are best done outside peak sun seasons. Your provider will plan timing around your schedule.

### Is there downtime?

IPL and peels can leave the skin pink and treated spots temporarily darker. Most clients plan around a long weekend.

### How much does treatment cost?

Pricing depends on the type and number of sessions. Your You Review includes a clear walkthrough.

## Refreshed lips, Recognizably yours

Some lips have always been on the smaller side. Others get smaller from the late 30s onward as collagen slows and the skin around the mouth thins. Lip filler is one of the most common requests in aesthetics, and one of the most easily over-done. The right plan is built around your face, not a trend.

-   Subtle enhancement
-   Natural-looking shape
-   Still recognizably you

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

For first-time lip enhancement. Conservative dosing. Most first-time clients use a syringe or less to see how their lips respond.

For a subtle pout without filler. A Botox lip flip can roll the upper lip slightly outward without adding any volume.

For lips plus lines around the mouth. A layered plan that treats both areas. See our [Lip Lines](https://orangetwist.com/concerns/lip-line-treatment/) page.

## Thin Lips Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

### Will my lips look obviously done?

Not with conservative dosing. The goal is fuller lips that still look like yours.

### How long does lip filler last?

About six to twelve months depending on the product and how your body processes it.

### Does it hurt?

Numbing cream is applied first and the filler itself contains lidocaine. Most clients describe a brief pinch.

### Is there downtime?

Mild swelling for one to three days. Some clients bruise. Most are presentable the next day.  

### Can lip filler be reversed?

Yes. Hyaluronic acid filler can be dissolved if needed. Your provider will discuss this at your You Review.  

### How often will I need top-ups?

Most clients return every nine to twelve months. Some hold longer.

# Under-Eye Bag Treatment

__________Refresh the under-eye area. Real assessments, honest options._  
_________

[Book Now](https://orangetwist.com/book-now/)

![Concern treatment 15](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20933'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Bags are a different conversation than dark circles.

Bags refer to the puffy, raised tissue that can develop below the lower lash line. Sometimes they are caused by fluid. Sometimes by the small fat pads under the eye shifting forward. Sometimes by a hollow below that makes the area above look raised. The right plan depends on which one is yours.  

**✓**  Honest assessment first

**✓**  The right plan for your eyes

**✓**  No oversold promises

## Which Treatment Is Right for You?

For mild, fluid-based puffiness. Lifestyle factors and gentle in-center treatments often help. Your provider will walk you through both.

For structural bags. A small amount of filler placed to smooth the transition between bag and cheek can soften the look. Some structural bags benefit more from a surgical assessment, and we will tell you when that is the case.

For loose, crepey under-eye skin. Skin-tightening treatments like Sofwave can firm the area over time.

## Under-Eye Bags  
Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

### Are under-eye bags the same as dark circles?

No. Bags are about volume and texture. Dark circles are about color. They can show up together but they are different concerns.

### Will treatment last forever?

No. Most non-surgical treatments need maintenance. Your provider will give you a realistic timeline.  

### Can I treat bags at home?

Cold compresses, sleep, and hydration help mild puffiness. Structural bags need a different approach.

### What about surgery?

For some bags, a surgical assessment is the right path. We will tell you when that is the case and recommend trusted referrals.

### Is there downtime?

Filler treatments may cause mild swelling for a few days. Sofwave has minimal downtime. Microneedling leaves the area pink briefly.

### When will I see results?

Filler shows immediately. Sofwave develops over several months. Microneedling builds across the series.

## Some fat is just stubborn. Cold-hearted.

You eat well. You move. You do the work. Some pockets of fat still refuse to leave the party. CoolSculpting Elite freezes those fat cells where they sit. The treated cells leave the body permanently and do not grow back. Same lifestyle. Different pinch test.

-   Targets stubborn pinchable fat
-   FDA-cleared and non-surgical
-   Permanent fat cell removal

## What is CoolSculpting Elite and how does it work?

CoolSculpting Elite is the latest generation of the FDA-cleared cryolipolysis platform from Allergan Aesthetics. The science behind it is simple. Fat cells freeze at a higher temperature than the surrounding skin and tissue. The device uses precisely calibrated cooling applicators to chill the fat in the treatment area to the point the cells are damaged beyond repair, while everything around them stays comfortable and protected.

Once those fat cells are damaged, the body clears them naturally over the following weeks and months, the same way it would clear any other waste. The treated cells are gone. They do not regenerate. That permanence is what separates CoolSculpting Elite from temporary contouring treatments.

The Elite generation is a meaningful upgrade on legacy CoolSculpting. Dual applicators mean two areas can be treated in a single visit. Refined cooling makes the treatment more efficient and comfortable. The applicator range is broader, with FDA clearance across nine distinct treatment areas. Not every clinic offering CoolSculpting has upgraded. We have.

One important note: CoolSculpting Elite is a contouring treatment, not a weight loss treatment. It targets specific, pinchable areas in clients who are at or near a stable weight. If meaningful weight loss is your goal first, your provider may suggest exploring TwistOff before contouring.

## Your CoolSculpting Elite Treatment Timeline

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20935'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## You Review

Your provider will examine the areas you want to address, confirm what is pinchable and treatable with CoolSculpting Elite, and map out a realistic plan. Most areas need one or two sessions, with results building over three months. They will walk through pricing transparently before anything is booked.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201050%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

![Coolsculpting-elite](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20933%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Onboarding

There is very little to do beforehand. Wear comfortable clothing that allows access to the treatment area. Eat beforehand. Hydrate. Skip blood thinners like ibuprofen and aspirin for a few days where possible to keep bruising to a minimum.

![NewportBeach-customer-care](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201383%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Ongoing Care

Your provider will apply a gel pad and the applicator. The first few minutes are spicy as the cold builds, then the area numbs and most clients settle in. People read, scroll, work, nap. Each cycle takes 35 to 45 minutes. With dual applicators, two areas can be treated at once, which is why most appointments are over before your lunch break is.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201707%202560'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Maintenance and Transition

Your provider will briefly massage the treated area after removal. Expect some redness, mild swelling, and numbness for a few hours to a few days. You can return to normal activities immediately. Some clients experience deeper tissue tenderness for one to three weeks, which is normal and resolves on its own.

## Permanent is the whole point

Results build gradually. You will start to notice change at three to four weeks as your body clears the damaged fat cells. The most dramatic improvement typically shows at 12 weeks. Final results are visible by 16 weeks. Patience is part of the process. The cells leave your body the way your body removes any other waste, which takes time.

## Many clients add a second session for further reduction.

Clinical studies show an average 20 to 25 percent reduction in fat thickness in the treated area after one session. Many clients add a second session for further reduction. Because the treated fat cells leave the body permanently, results are long-lasting. Maintaining a stable weight keeps the treated area looking the way it does post-treatment.

![madison-l-headshot](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20933%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## CoolSculpting Elite Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About CoolSculpting Elite Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare and Comfort Safety and Suitability

### What is CoolSculpting Elite?

CoolSculpting Elite is the latest generation of the FDA-cleared fat freezing platform from Allergan Aesthetics. It uses precisely calibrated cooling applicators to permanently eliminate fat cells in pinchable areas of the body, without surgery, needles, or downtime.

### How does CoolSculpting Elite work?

Fat cells freeze at a higher temperature than the surrounding skin and tissue. The device chills the fat in the treatment area to the point the cells are damaged beyond repair, without harming anything around them. The damaged cells are then cleared naturally by the body over the following weeks and months.

### How is CoolSculpting Elite different from original CoolSculpting?

CoolSculpting Elite is the upgrade. Dual applicators mean two areas can be treated in a single visit, which cuts treatment time roughly in half for clients addressing multiple areas. The cooling is more efficient and comfortable, and the applicator range is broader. Not every clinic has upgraded, which is worth checking anywhere you book.

### Is CoolSculpting Elite a weight loss treatment?

No. CoolSculpting Elite is a body contouring treatment. It works best for clients who are at or near a stable weight and want to address specific, pinchable areas. If meaningful weight loss is your goal first, your provider may suggest exploring TwistOff before contouring.

### What areas can CoolSculpting Elite treat?

CoolSculpting Elite is FDA-cleared for nine distinct areas: stomach, flanks (love handles), inner thighs, outer thighs, banana roll (under buttocks), upper arms, back, bra fat, and the area under the chin. Your provider will assess what is treatable at your You Review.

### Will the fat come back somewhere else?

The treated fat cells are gone permanently. If you gain weight after treatment, your body distributes that weight across the fat cells you still have, both in untreated areas and the cells that remain in the treated area. The treated area still has fewer fat cells than before. The math is on your side.

### Do I need a consultation before CoolSculpting Elite?

Yes. Every body contouring client starts with a complimentary You Review. Your provider will examine the areas you want to address, confirm what is pinchable and treatable, and walk through a realistic treatment plan and pricing before anything is booked.

### Am I a good candidate for CoolSculpting Elite?

Good candidates are clients at or near a stable weight with specific, pinchable areas of fat that have not responded to diet and exercise. CoolSculpting Elite is not suitable for clients with very small amounts of fat to treat, very loose skin in the area, or those looking for significant weight loss. Your provider will assess honestly.

### What should I tell my provider?

Let your provider know about any cold sensitivity conditions, recent weight changes, previous body contouring treatments, pregnancy or planned pregnancy, and any medications. The more your provider knows, the better the plan.

### How much does CoolSculpting Elite cost at OrangeTwist?

Pricing depends on the number of areas treated, the number of cycles per area, and the package. Most clients treat multiple areas, often in the same visit. Your provider will walk through exact pricing at your You Review. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing on all body contouring packages.

### How long does a CoolSculpting Elite session take?

Each cycle takes 35 to 45 minutes. Most clients treat one to three areas in a single visit. With dual applicators, two areas can be treated at once. Allow 60 to 120 minutes for a typical visit.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most areas show meaningful improvement after one session. Many clients add a second session for further reduction. Your provider will recommend a realistic plan at your You Review.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from CoolSculpting Elite?

You will start to notice change at three to four weeks as your body begins clearing the damaged fat cells. The most dramatic improvement typically shows at 12 weeks. Final results are visible by 16 weeks. The fat cells leave your body the way your body removes any other waste, which takes time.

### How much fat will be reduced?

Clinical studies show an average 20 to 25 percent reduction in fat thickness in the treated area after one session. Individual results vary based on the area, the starting fat thickness, and how your body responds. Your provider will set realistic expectations for your case.

### Are the results permanent?

Yes. Fat cells that are eliminated by CoolSculpting Elite do not regenerate. The remaining fat cells in the treated area and untreated areas can still expand or shrink with weight changes, which is why maintaining a stable weight is recommended to preserve your results.

### Can I treat the same area more than once?

Yes. Many clients return for a second treatment in the same area for further reduction. Your provider will typically recommend waiting at least eight to 12 weeks between sessions in the same area to allow the first session’s results to fully develop.

### Does CoolSculpting Elite hurt?

The first few minutes of each cycle are spicy as the applicator pulls the tissue and the cooling begins. The cold sensation builds, then numbs the area, and most clients find the rest of the cycle very tolerable. Many clients read, scroll, or even nap. The post-treatment massage is the most intense moment, lasting a couple of minutes.

### What is the downtime after CoolSculpting Elite?

Most clients return to normal activities immediately. Expect redness, mild swelling, numbness, or tenderness in the treated area for a few hours to a few days. Some clients experience deeper tissue tenderness for one to three weeks, particularly in larger treatment areas.

### Can I exercise after CoolSculpting Elite?

Light activity is fine immediately. Most clients return to their normal exercise routine within 24 to 48 hours. Listen to your body. Tenderness or sensitivity will let you know if you are pushing too hard too soon.

### What should I do to support my results?

Maintain a stable weight. Stay hydrated, as your body clears the damaged fat cells through normal metabolic processes. There is no special diet or supplement required.

### Is CoolSculpting Elite safe?

Yes. CoolSculpting has been FDA-cleared since 2010, with millions of treatments performed worldwide. CoolSculpting Elite has refined the technology further. At OrangeTwist, every session is performed by a licensed provider trained on the device.

### Who should not have CoolSculpting Elite?

CoolSculpting Elite is not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have cold sensitivity conditions (cold urticaria, paroxysmal cold hemoglobinuria, cryoglobulinemia, Raynaud’s), have a hernia in or near the treatment area, have very loose skin in the treatment area, or are seeking significant weight loss rather than spot fat reduction. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### What are the side effects?

Common side effects include redness, swelling, bruising, numbness, tenderness, itching, and skin sensitivity in the treated area. These typically resolve within days to weeks. A rare side effect called paradoxical adipose hyperplasia (PAH), where treated fat cells enlarge instead of shrink, occurs in a very small percentage of treatments. Your provider will walk through risks at your You Review.

### Is CoolSculpting Elite safe for all skin tones?

Yes. CoolSculpting Elite works on fat cells, not skin pigment, and is safe across all skin types and tones.

### How do I know my provider is qualified?

All CoolSculpting Elite treatments at OrangeTwist are performed by licensed professionals with specific training on the device platform and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board.

## Build muscle. Burn fat. Same session.

Most body contouring treatments do one thing. Emsculpt Neo does two. In 30 minutes, the device combines high-intensity electromagnetic energy with radiofrequency to build muscle and reduce fat in the treated area at the same time. It is the only FDA-cleared treatment that addresses both.

-   Builds muscle and burns fat
-   FDA-cleared, non-surgical
-   30-minute sessions, no downtime

## What is Emsculpt Neo and how does it work?

Emsculpt Neo is an FDA-cleared body contouring device from BTL Aesthetics. It is the second-generation evolution of the original Emsculpt, with one critical addition: where the original Emsculpt built muscle alone, Neo builds muscle and reduces fat in the same session.

The treatment works by combining two technologies. High-intensity focused electromagnetic energy (HIFEM) triggers powerful, involuntary muscle contractions in the treated area, far beyond what voluntary exercise can produce. At the same time, radiofrequency heats the fat layer to the point where fat cells are damaged and cleared by the body. The result is stronger, more defined muscle underneath a slimmer layer of fat above. A single 30-minute session delivers the equivalent of approximately 20,000 muscle contractions.

Emsculpt Neo is FDA-cleared for the abdomen, buttocks, arms, calves, and thighs. Most clients see meaningful muscle and fat changes across a course of four sessions, with results that hold long-term when paired with normal physical activity. The treatment is non-invasive, requires no downtime, and clients walk out and continue their day immediately.

## Preparation

Very little preparation needed. Eat a small meal beforehand to keep your energy up, since the muscle work is real. Hydrate well. Wear comfortable clothing that allows access to the treatment area. Avoid intense workouts of the same muscle group on the day of your session.

![Natalia - Orange Twist](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201050%201400'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## The Treatment

Your provider will position the applicator on the treatment area and ramp up the intensity gradually. You will feel the muscle contractions immediately. The intensity is spicy and unusual at first, but most clients adjust quickly and find the sessions easy to tolerate. The 30 minutes is, honestly, the shortest workout you will ever do for that much muscle.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20645%20645'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

## Aftercare

No downtime. You can return to normal activities immediately, including your usual workouts. Some clients feel mild muscle soreness for a day or two, similar to a workout. Stay hydrated.

## Stronger, leaner, and seen in the mirror.

You will feel the muscle engagement immediately and you may notice initial definition within two to four weeks. The full result, including muscle build and fat reduction, typically develops over three months as the body responds and the treated fat clears. Clinical studies show an average 25 percent increase in muscle mass and 30 percent fat reduction in the treated area after a full course.

### Results last as long as you maintain the rest of your routine.

The fat reduction is permanent. The muscle build holds best with normal physical activity, with maintenance sessions every six to 12 months for clients who want to keep the result consistent.

## Frequently Asked  
Questions and Answers

About Emsculpt Neo Consultations Appointments and Pricing Results Aftercare and Comfort Safety and Suitability

### What is Emsculpt Neo?

Emsculpt Neo is an FDA-cleared body contouring device from BTL Aesthetics. It is the only treatment that builds muscle and reduces fat in the same session, using high-intensity electromagnetic energy and radiofrequency together.

### How is Emsculpt Neo different from the original Emsculpt?

Emsculpt Neo is the second-generation device. The original Emsculpt built muscle. Neo builds muscle and reduces fat at the same time, thanks to the added radiofrequency component. Most clinics offering body sculpting have upgraded to Neo.

### How is Emsculpt Neo different from CoolSculpting Elite?

They do different things. CoolSculpting Elite freezes and permanently eliminates fat cells. Emsculpt Neo builds muscle and reduces fat. Many clients use both as part of a broader body contouring plan, often layering the treatments for the most comprehensive result.

### What is HIFEM?

HIFEM stands for high-intensity focused electromagnetic energy. It is the technology that triggers the powerful muscle contractions during an Emsculpt Neo session, far beyond what voluntary exercise can produce.

### What areas can Emsculpt Neo treat?

Emsculpt Neo is FDA-cleared for the abdomen, buttocks, arms, calves, and thighs. Your provider will recommend the right area at your You Review.

### Is Emsculpt Neo a weight loss treatment?

No. Emsculpt Neo is a body contouring treatment. It builds muscle and reduces fat in specific treated areas. If meaningful weight loss is your primary goal, your provider may suggest exploring TwistOff alongside or before body contouring.

### Do I need a consultation before Emsculpt Neo?

Yes. Every body contouring client starts with a complimentary You Review. Your provider will assess your area of interest, your goals, and recommend the right plan.

### Am I a good candidate?

Good candidates are clients at or near a stable weight who want to build muscle definition and reduce fat in specific treated areas. Emsculpt Neo is not suitable for clients with very high body fat percentages, certain implanted devices, or those looking for significant weight loss alone.

### What should I tell my provider?

Let your provider know about any implanted electrical devices (pacemakers, defibrillators, IUDs with metal components), metal implants in the treatment area, pregnancy or planned pregnancy, recent weight changes, and any medications.

### How much does Emsculpt Neo cost at OrangeTwist?

Pricing depends on the area treated and the package size. Most clients commit to a course of four sessions. Your provider will walk through exact pricing at your You Review. TwistUp members receive exclusive pricing benefits.

### How long does a session take?

Each Emsculpt Neo session is 30 minutes. Most clients can fit a session into a lunch break.

### How many sessions will I need?

Most clients see best results across four sessions, typically scheduled two to three days apart over two to three weeks. Maintenance sessions every six to 12 months help keep the muscle result consistent.

### Is financing available?

Yes. OrangeTwist offers financing through CareCredit, Alle Cherry, and PatientFi. Ask your provider about options at your You Review.

### When will I see results from Emsculpt Neo?

You will feel the muscle engagement immediately and you may notice initial definition within two to four weeks. The full result, including muscle build and fat reduction, typically develops over three months as the body responds.

### How much muscle and fat change should I expect?

Clinical studies show an average 25 percent increase in muscle mass and 30 percent fat reduction in the treated area after a full course of four sessions. Individual results vary based on starting fitness, body composition, and lifestyle.

### How long do results last?

The fat reduction is permanent. The muscle build holds best when paired with normal physical activity. Most clients schedule maintenance sessions every six to 12 months to keep the muscle result consistent.

### Will I still need to work out?

Emsculpt Neo is a complement to a healthy lifestyle, not a replacement for it. Normal physical activity, balanced nutrition, and hydration all support and extend your results.

### Does Emsculpt Neo hurt?

Emsculpt Neo is a strange sensation at first. The involuntary muscle contractions are unlike anything voluntary exercise produces, and the intensity ramps up gradually during the session. Most clients describe it as spicy and unusual but easily tolerated, not painful. The 30 minutes goes faster than expected.

### Is there any downtime?

No. You can return to normal activities immediately, including your usual workouts. Some clients feel mild muscle soreness for a day or two, similar to a workout.

### Can I work out after Emsculpt Neo?

Yes. Light activity is fine immediately. Some clients prefer to wait a day before doing intense work on the same muscle group, as the area may feel like it has done a heavy workout.

### What should I do to support my results?

Stay hydrated and eat balanced meals around your sessions. Maintain a regular routine of physical activity to support the muscle build. There is no special diet or supplement required.

### Is Emsculpt Neo safe?

Yes. Emsculpt Neo has been FDA-cleared since 2020 with a strong clinical safety record. At OrangeTwist, every session is performed by a licensed provider trained on the device.

### Who should not have Emsculpt Neo?

Emsculpt Neo is not recommended if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, have an implanted electrical device (pacemaker, defibrillator), have metal implants or medical devices in or near the treatment area, have an IUD with metal components, have a hernia in the treatment area, or have certain cardiac conditions. Always disclose your full medication and health history at your You Review.

### Is Emsculpt Neo safe for all skin tones?

Yes. Emsculpt Neo works on muscle and fat, not skin pigment, and is safe across all skin tones.

### What are the side effects?

Common side effects include mild muscle soreness, temporary muscle fatigue, and minor redness or warmth in the treatment area. All typically resolve within a day or two.

### How do I know my provider is qualified?

All Emsculpt Neo treatments at OrangeTwist are performed by licensed professionals with specific training on the device platform and supervised by our Medical Advisory Board.
